en: Muramasa《No impediment to combat! None!》Kageaki"Understood! Going!"
ja:
村正《戦闘に一切の支障なし！》景明「承知！
　参る！」

en:
...But, Yagenta sir.
I... by tonight...

Tonight, I—!
ja:
……しかし、弥源太老。
　俺は――夜には――

　夜には――――！

en: Yagenta"..."Yagenta"Enough now. Come out. Jaldi."Yagenta"Or even I have become too frightening for you?"Nagasaka"Bakwas."
ja:
弥源太「…………」弥源太「もう良かろうよ。
　さっさと出て参れ」弥源太「それとも……
　うてにさえも臆したか？」長坂「抜かせ」

en: Nagasaka"Yes, I avoided that insolent pup. Until my revenge is done, let them say what they like. But YOU? What reason do I have to fear you? Don't make me laugh, Yagenta."Yagenta"Good. At last, then, we can settle it."Nagasaka"That is MY line. Now only you find your courage, and already the brave-man acting starts. Enough, buddhe. You'll make me an actor in your clown show also."Yagenta"Clowns, Ukyo. Both of us. What else would you call it? Past fifty and going downhill, yet here we are, crossing swords for such a useless reason."Yagenta"An ordinary supply of sense would have prevented this. A badly made farce, that's all. Something for people to snigger at."Nagasaka"I won't deny it. But YOUR cowardice made our lives into this worthless play. Thirty years ago I should have killed you. Or been killed! Thirty years ago!"Nagasaka"THIRTY YEARS—hah! These years you gave me, thirty years of vomit! Whatever I gained, whatever I took, nothing satisfied. Everything was only a replacement!"Nagasaka"Round and round inside a closed ring. Same chutiyapa, same worthless time...!"Yagenta"...I see. You are that man after all, Ukyo."Yagenta"Years may pass, but you will not change. Until a thing is settled, for you it cannot end."Nagasaka"..."Yagenta"That is what Ichihime and I misjudged. Time heals everyone, we thought. Equally. Sooner or later, you also... Though we should have known what sort of man you were."Yagenta"One apology I must give. I am sorry, Ukyo."Nagasaka"...Now? You think those are the words I want, NOW?"Yagenta"No. Mockery only, you will hear. But this also must be put in order. Don't worry. I will not leave you with a mouthful of apology. The settlement is late, but I will give it."Yagenta"I will end you, Ukyo. Thirty years of debt. Here, now, the account is cleared."Nagasaka"Hah. Listen to this expired old wreck. You alone will end me? Bakwas! Now nothing ends until I kill you, kill the mountain's god, and take Ichihime!"Nagasaka"You are the first stepping stone, nothing more. Smash you, throw you away. Return to the soil on your own time—"Nagasaka"ALL EIGHT CORNERS UNDER ONE ROOF!!"
ja:
長坂「あの小癪な若造を避けたのは事実、復仇を
遂げるまでは何を言われようと構わんが……
　貴様などに怯えねばならぬ理由が一体どこ
にある？　余り嗤かしてくれるなよ、弥源太」弥源太「それは上々。
　ようやく決着をつけられるというものだ」長坂「こちらの台詞を奪うでないわ。
　今更になって肚はらを決めた戯けが、豪胆ぶる
のも程々にしておけ。俺まで道化芝居の役者
になる」弥源太「道化よ、右京。なれもうてもな。道化以外
の何だと云う？
　五十の坂を下りながら、かくも碌ろくでもなき
理由で斬り結ぼうとする我らが……」弥源太「およそ人並みの知恵があればなされぬ所業
であろうよ。
　これは出来の悪い滑稽劇、人の失笑を買う
種以外の何物でもない」長坂「違うとは言わんがな。我らの生をここまで
下らぬ芝居に仕立てたのは貴様の怯懦きょうだよ。
　三〇年前に殺していれば良かったのだ。
　三〇年前に殺されていれば良かったのだ！」長坂「三〇年――――はッ！
　貴様がくれたこの年月、反吐のような三〇
年だったわ！　何を得ても何を奪っても心が
満ちぬ。それが代わり・・・でしかないからだ！」長坂「ただ――閉じた輪の中を回るような。
　下らぬ、下らぬ時間であった……！」弥源太「……そうか。
　やはりなれはそういう男よ、右京」弥源太「いくら歳月が流れようと変わるわけがない。
　……なれにとっては、決着がつかぬ限り、
何事も決して終わらんのだからな」長坂「…………」弥源太「そこをうても一媛も見誤った……。
　時の癒しは誰にも平等と思い込んだ。なれ
の上にもいずれ、と。
　……なれの性格は知っていた筈なのにな」弥源太「一言だけ詫びておく。
　済まなかった。右京」長坂「…………。
　今更……俺がそんな言葉を欲しがると思う
のか」弥源太「思わぬよ。なれには嘲弄としか聞こえまい。
だがこれも、けじめというもの。
　案ずるな。口先の詫びで済ませるつもりは
ない。遅れた決着をくれてやる」弥源太「なれを終わらせてやろうぞ、右京。
　三〇年分の負債、今ここで清算する」長坂「……はっ。言いおったわ、老廃が。
　貴様一人で俺を終わらせる？　ほざけ……
今となっては貴様を殺し、お山の神を殺し、
一媛を奪わぬ限り何も終わらぬ！」長坂「貴様など、その最初の踏み台に過ぎん。
　叩き潰して打ち棄てる。勝手に土へ還るが
いい――」長坂「八紘一宇ッ!!」

en: Yagenta"..."

Nagasaka"Hm? That little stick again? Whatever charm it is, what exactly will you do against me with that?"Yagenta"...This."Yagenta"Meet a demon, cut the demon. Meet evil, cut the evil."Yagenta"Here lies the law of the sword."
ja:
長坂「……ふん？　またその棒切れか。
　何の呪まじないかは知らぬが、そんなもので俺に
どう抗うと云う？」弥源太「……こうするのよ」弥源太「世に鬼あれば鬼を断つ。
　世に悪あれば悪を断つ」弥源太「ツルギの理ことわりここに在り」

en: Nagasaka"—What!?"Yagenta"Ukyo. Recognise this?"Nagasaka"...A tsurugi...?"Yagenta"Yes. When your people began digging, you broke the guardian stone and took the divine treasure inside, no?"Yagenta"A fragment of that."
ja:
長坂「――むっ!?」弥源太「右京。
　これが何かわかるか」長坂「……劔冑……か？」弥源太「然り。
　なれらが坑道を掘り始める時……守り石・・・を
砕き、中の神宝を奪ったであろう？」弥源太「これは、その断片よ」

en: Nagasaka"Oho. Then even that little piece can claim to be a peerless masterpiece."Nagasaka"Couldn't use the tsurugi at all, so I gave it to Sorimachi... A pity. Had I known you could use it, I would have given it to you. Some entertainment might have been possible."Yagenta"Keep boasting, Ukyo. One warrior with crippled wings? This short blade will pay for you and leave change."Nagasaka"...Such a cheap price you have put on me. I am the one who will collect the change, Yagenta!"Yagenta"We will know soon. Come, Ukyo!"
ja:
長坂「……ほう。
　するとそれは、曲がりなりにも天下一名物
ということか」長坂「あの劔冑、どうにも扱えぬので、雪車町に
渡してしまったが……惜しいことをしたな。
　貴様が使えると知っておればくれてやった
ものを。いささか面白くなったであろうに」弥源太「驕っておれよ、右京。
　片羽かたわの武者如き、この小太刀一つで釣りが
来る……」長坂「……随分と安く見積もられたものだ。
　釣りを貰うのはこちらよ、弥源太！」弥源太「すぐに知れる。
　参れ、右京！」

en: Kotaro《Ho-ho-ho! What happened, Muramasa? Beating you are taking wholesale, and not one small return parcel!》Kotaro《This is the famous demon tsurugi? Arre, your ancestors must be crying underground. Such a name they left, and this is what you are doing with it!》
ja:
小太郎《ほぉっほっほっ！
　これこれどうした村正よ……めった打ちの
やられ放しではないか！》小太郎《それでも天下の妖甲か！
　草葉の陰で先祖の霊が泣いておろうぞ！》

en: Muramasa《Kh...!》Kotaro《Hit back a little, na. My mood is getting spoiled also. Both swords must do some work before we call it a swordfight. At present I am only chopping a tree! Ho-ho, what a difficulty. I came for a duel and you have made me a gardener!》
ja:
村正《くっ……！》小太郎《少しは打ち返してくれねばこちらも気分が
悪い。剣を打ち交わすからこそ太刀打タチウチと申す。
こう一方的ではのう、立木打ちではないか！
　いや、困ったのう！　困ったのう！》

en:
His laughter occupied the evening sky. Eviction, from our side, was not presently possible.

The instant we engaged, the enemy frame had vanished again. After that, the previous arrangement resumed: he attacked, we received. Very regular service.

Hit what? Eyes could find nothing. Sensors could find nothing. Our hands were ready to do their duty; somebody first supply the enemy.

The Soshu saboteur's Mist-Hiding art. Until we broke that, we could do nothing. Kuch bhi nahin. That was the full tactical assessment.
ja:
嘲笑が夕空を席巻する。
　こちらにはそれを押し留める手段がない。

　遭遇エンゲージするや否や、敵騎はまたしても消失。
　以降、前回と同様、一方的に攻め立てられるばかり
の状況が続いている。

　手の出しようがない。
　視覚めも、探査機能みみも役に立たないのでは、全く。
　どうにもこうにも、どう仕様もない。

　相州乱破が操る霧隠キリガクレの術――
　これを打ち破る術すべがなければ、どうにも！

en: Muramasa《What is this fellow DOING!? Fine, a Divine Art that hides him and scrambles detection. I will swallow that much. But for THIS long he keeps it running!?》Muramasa《Where is all that heat coming from!? Fighting bhi, dinner bhi? Is he eating while he fights!?》Kageaki"I do not think so. ...The digestion would object."
ja:
村正《一体、どういうことなの……！
　姿を消し、探査を撹乱する陰義、そこまで
は百歩譲って認めてもいい。けれどそれを、
こんなにも長時間維持し続けるなんて！》村正《その熱量はどこから調達してるの！
　食事しながら戦ってるとでもいうわけ!?》景明「それは無いと思うが。
　……消化に悪そうだ」

en:
Running all over the sky with one's dinner inside. The stomach also has its limits.

First swallow, then turn upside down, then demand that digestion proceed normally. Bhai, the food has only just arrived. Let it discover where the floor is. Every time the poor thing settles, another sword stroke and the ceiling becomes downstairs.

No. Eating during this would be unreasonable. Being killed, apparently, I could accept as a possibility; bad digestion I was prepared to dispute.
ja: 空を駆け回りながらでは。

en: Muramasa《Haan, of course! Two hearts he must have, then! One ordinary and one for this nonsense!》Kageaki"Calm down, Muramasa."
ja:
村正《ええ、そうね！
　じゃあきっと、心臓が二つあるんでしょう
よ！》景明「落ち着け、村正」

en:
I addressed the tsurugi, whose irritation was making no attempt at secrecy. In these circumstances, my contribution would not comfort even a stone.

Ordinary tsurugi were made as weapons. Muramasa had been given one definite purpose: kill her predecessor. Perhaps that was why, where their thoughts were generally so passive, hers could take the initiative and become emotional also.

Still, tsurugi toh tsurugi. I did not believe her control was in the same condition as her mouth. Not once had she neglected the frame. Worry on that account was unnecessary.

The account on which worry was very necessary—
ja:
苛立ちを隠さない劔冑に声をかける。
　この状況下では気休めにもなりそうになかったが。

　村正は単に武器として造られた通常の劔冑と違い、
明確な目的を与えられている――先代を討つ・・・・・、という。
　その為か、一般に劒冑の思念は極端に受動的である
のに対し、時として積極的また感情的にもなった。

　もっとも劔冑はあくまで劔冑。
　口ほどに村正が動揺しているとは俺も思っていない。
騎体管制は一度も怠っていなかった。この点で懸念を
抱く必要はないだろう。

　懸念すべきは――

en: ...was that we were losing. Completely. From every available direction.
ja: ……あくまで、この絶対的劣勢。

en: Kotaro《Ho-ho! Bas? This much only, Muramasa? This much only?》Muramasa《Rear plating damaged! Kh, this invisible chutiya—what am I supposed to DO!?》Kageaki"Calm down."
ja:
小太郎《ほぉっほ！　そんなものか！
　そんなものかいのう、村正よ！》村正《背面甲鉄に損傷！
　くっ、この……どうしろってのよ！》景明「落ち着け」

en:
Again I supplied an instruction she did not need.

The intended recipient was myself.

If this situation made no sense, somewhere there had to be a way through it. Nonsense does not stand on its own legs. Some trick is holding the bloody thing upright. Find that trick. Pull it out. Break the art.

Otherwise, for Muramasa and me, this entire sky would become the graveyard. Plenty of space. No further use for it.
ja:
必要もない声をかける。
　……自分自身に言い聞かせるために。

　現況が不条理なものであるのなら、必ずどこかに、
打破の糸口がある筈。
　不条理を成立させるのは何らかの如何様イカサマだ。それを
見極め、探し出す。探し出して打ち破り、術を解く。

　さもなくば――
　この空が俺と村正の墓場になる。

en:
The Dragoon holds its sword high on the right: the proper warrior's stance. Before it, the old man brings his short sword to middle guard, ready for that heavy blade.

A short sword receives first and attacks afterward. That is its basic arrangement. With such limited reach, first attack, then regret is not a useful alternative.

But the old man is deliberately violating the arrangement. The point is a little low. The weight is too far forward. For receiving a blow, this posture is making every possible inconvenience.

Plainly, he does not intend to receive. He intends to attack.

Against a long sword that owns the distance, this is recklessness with the madness already inside. Yes, a short-sword master can steal that distance. But feints are needed, some bargaining with the opponent's intentions. You cannot simply walk in and announce that the range now belongs to you.

Then what hidden plan has this old man brought?

—Nothing.

Not emptiness of mind. Foolishness of mind. There is a difference, bhai.
ja:
竜騎兵は右上段、武者正調の構。
　対して老人は小太刀を中段にとり、剛剣を迎える形。

　小太刀は受けから入って攻めるを基軸とする。
　それは間合で劣るがゆえの必然的戦術。

　だが老人は敢えてその法を犯している。
　小太刀の剣先はやや低く、重心は前方へ傾き過ぎて
いた。受けを狙うならばいかにも不都合。

　老人の企図は明然、受けにあらず、攻めにあった。

　間合で凌駕する敵の太刀に対し、その試みは断じて
無謀、狂気の沙汰とさえ言い得る。
　小太刀の達人は太刀の間合を盗んで制しもしようが、
それも駆け引きあってこそ。露骨な攻など論外である。

　老人は如何なる腹案を隠して、かかる暴挙に臨むか。
　
　――何もない。

　無の境地……否。
　愚の境地であった。

en:
The Dragoon before him has one foolish obsession packed into its chest: smash whatever is standing there. Against that, some clever little parry here, some neat little deflection there—will these win?

Nahin.

That towering conviction will crush such cleverness without even making a separate effort for it.

Wisdom can defeat folly. True. But cheap cleverness is not wisdom merely because it has come wearing wisdom's spectacles.

One road remains. Become a fool also. Meet it there.
ja:
敵なる竜騎兵はただ一心、愚かしい妄念だけを胸に、
立ちはだかる者を砕かんと欲している。
　されば。それに対して受けてどうの、捌いてどうの
と、小細工を用いて抗し得ようか。

　否である。
　老人の前に隆立す、愚かなる武者の一念は、かよう
に賢しげな術策など容易く粉砕してのけよう。

　愚に対して賢は優れど、ただ小賢しい小智は及ばぬ。

　であれば、方途はひとつきり。
　己もまた愚となって、相対するほかになし。

en:
The old man has his own foolishness: this man must be stopped by him. Nobody else will do.

He can run. He can leave it to somebody. Who will blame him? Nobody.

But he has chosen. The duty was free to put down; he has picked it up with both hands.

Why? One small attachment. A world from long ago, with only himself, this man, and one woman in it.

The woman is gone. Toh, the man who remains is his to settle with.

In that world there were three people. Bas. Three.
ja:
老人にも愚想はあった。
　この男は己が止めねばなるまいという妄念。

　逃げても良いのだ。
　誰かに任せても良いのだ。
　誰も老人にその責を問わない。

　だが老人は望んで負った。
　捨てても良い責務を背負った。

　その所以は些細なこだわり。
　遠い日の幻影まぼろし、あの世界には己と男、そして一人の
女しかいなかった。

　女はもういない。
　ならば男の始末は己がつけねば。
　あの世界には三人、唯ただ三人しかいなかったのだから。

en:
Foolishness.

Nothing else, only foolishness.

With his foolishness the old man advances. With his foolishness the Dragoon advances.

Worthless, pointless, not worth a thought—and each has given it the full weight of a human life. No discount.

They place it on their sword points.

Now.

In this very instant.

Two old soldiers advance.
ja:
愚想。
　愚想である。

　愚想を抱いて、老人は征ゆく。
　愚想を抱いて、竜騎兵は征く。

　愚かな、下らぬ、取るに足らぬ、
　而して命一つと同じ重さの一念を。

　互いに剣先へ乗せて。
　この刹那。

　今この刹那。
　二人の老兵が、征く。

en: Nagasaka"..."Yagenta"..."Nagasaka"...You rusted old wreck."Yagenta"...You lifetime buddhu."
ja: 長坂「…………」弥源太「…………」長坂「……この、老いぼれめ」弥源太「……この、馬鹿たれめ」

en: Nagasaka"...Guh..."
ja: 長坂「……ぐふっ……」

en: Yagenta"...Kh..."
ja: 弥源太「……くっ……」

en: Yagenta"Hh..."Yagenta"..."
ja: 弥源太「ふ……ッ」弥源太「…………」

en: Yagenta"Ukyo... still alive, are you?"Nagasaka"Do not mock me... this much is nothing..."Nagasaka"I cannot be—kah!"Yagenta"...Stubborn fellow. That wound in your stomach, and still so much fight is left?"Yagenta"...Let me end the pain."Nagasaka"From you I require NOTHING...!"
ja:
弥源太「右京……
　生きておるか」長坂「……ッ。
　なめるな……この程度で……」長坂「この俺が……
　かはッ！」弥源太「……呆れたしぶとさよ。
　腹を抜かれてその元気か」弥源太「…………楽にしてくれよう」長坂「いらぬ……！」

en: Yagenta"Ukyo..."Nagasaka"I will not lose... nahin, I will not lose. Losing... I do not do."
ja:
弥源太「右京……」長坂「負けぬ……負けぬぞ。
　俺は……負けぬ」

en: Nagasaka"I will dig up that mountain... show Ichihime there is no god. Cheap stone only. Nothing more!"Nagasaka"Then she will be mine... Ichihime! In my hands, she will be mine!"Yagenta"..."
ja:
長坂「山を掘るのだ……
　神などいないと……ただの安っぽい石ころ
に過ぎぬと、一媛に教えてやるのだ」長坂「そうして、手に入れる……
　あいつを……一媛を！　手に入れるのだ！」弥源太「……」

en: Yagenta"Then let me send you to her, Ukyo... to Ichihime."Nagasaka"Yagenta..."Yagenta"...Goodbye, Ukyo. You old thornbush."Nagasaka"YAGENTAAAAAAAA!!"
ja:
弥源太「うてが送ってやろうぞ……右京。
　なれを……一媛のもとに」長坂「弥源太……」弥源太「……さらば。
　茨垣バラガキの右京」長坂「弥源太ァァァァァァァァ!!」

en: Ichijou"...Huh?"Yagenta"—!?"

Ichijou"Uncle Yagenta...? Huh? Where have I come?"Yagenta"What—Ichijou, child! How are you here!?"Ichijou"I wanted to say bye before leaving, na. The priest said you live on the mountain, so I came looking. But..."Ichijou"Somewhere one wrong turn happened. Then forest, forest, forest. Since morning I am going round and round only."Ichijou"Directions are NOT my problem, okay!? I thought, thoda poetic forest walk, why not? So I was wandering here and there without a plan, purely for the atmosphere, and then—"Nagasaka"...Ichihime."Ichijou"Hm? Oh, yesterday's mountain-dog bastard. Tu bhi yahin...? Huh?"Ichijou"..."Ichijou"...A tsurugi?"
ja:
一条「弥源太爺さん……？
　あれ？　ここ、どこだ」弥源太「な……一条のお嬢……
　どうしてここに！」一条「いや……帰る前にあんたに挨拶しとこうと
思って。和尚に山に住んでるって聞いて来た
んだけど……」一条「どこをどう間違ったんだか、気がついたら
林の中に入っちまってて。
　朝から今までずっと、ぐるぐると」一条「あ、いや、別に方向音痴じゃないからな!?
　ただちょっと、森の散策も風流かなーとか
思って適当に歩いてたからこうなっただけで
――」長坂「……一媛」一条「あん？
　って、昨日の山犬野郎。てめぇもいたの、
か…………あ？」一条「……」一条「……劔冑？」

en: Nagasaka"...Ichihime...!"Yagenta"No! Girl, RUN!!"Ichijou"Eh...?"Nagasaka"You—will not—defy me—"Nagasaka"Ichihime... not again... my word will not be refused...!"Ichijou"..."Ichijou"Nahin means NO, you walking power trip."Nagasaka"————"Nagasaka"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!"
ja:
長坂「……一媛……！」弥源太「いかん！
　嬢、逃げよ!!」一条「え……」長坂「お前を――
　俺の――
　この、手に――」長坂「俺の……一媛……
　俺の、ものに……ッ！」一条「……」一条「嫌だ、っつってんだろーが。阿呆」長坂「――――ッ」長坂「ああああアアアアアアアッッッ!!」

en: Yagenta"UKYOOOOO!!"
ja: 弥源太「右京ォォォッ!!」

en: Kageaki"...!?"

—A roar.

For an instant I thought we had taken another hit. Nahin. Sound only. No impact. This particular disaster was happening somewhere else.
ja:
――轟音。
　また攻撃を受けたのかと一瞬、誤解する。

　だが違う。音のみで、衝撃がない。
　これは何処か、全く別の所で発した音響。

en: Kageaki"Muramasa. That sound—what was it?"Muramasa《From the mountain! Not an explosion. A violent collision—like two warriors' blades meeting.》Kageaki"...The magistrate and Elder Yagenta!"
ja:
景明「村正。今のは何だ」村正《山の方角よ！
　爆発じゃない。何か激しいぶつかり合いが
――武者の太刀打のような何かが》景明「……代官と弥源太老か！」

en:
I turned toward the mountain. From here, information was not making itself available.

The magistrate had his tsurugi. Elder Yagenta had only his own flesh and bones. Whatever his plan, a long fight was not an option. Most likely that blow had already settled it.

Let the old man have won. Bas, that much. If not... I had to reach the mountain immediately. But with our own situation in this condition—
ja:
山の方へ首を巡らす。
　……ここからでは何もわからない。

　代官はともかく、弥源太老人は生身だ。どのような
術策があったにしろ、長期戦にはなりようがない。
　おそらく、今の一撃で決着はついた筈。

　老人が勝っていれば良い。
　だがそうでないなら……一刻も早く山に向かわねば
ならない。さりとて、この現状――

en: Muramasa《Mido! Bearing two-ninety, above!》Kageaki"!?"
ja: 村正《御堂！　二九〇度上方かのとからいぬのかみ！》景明「!?」

en: Kageaki"...Gassan!?"
ja: 景明「……月山!?」

en:
Gassan Jusanmi. No question. There it was, visible and neatly inside Muramasa's reticle.

Now it had decided to show its face? Why?
ja:
紛れもなく月山従三位。
　それが姿を現し、村正の照準レティクルに捉えられている。

　何故、唐突に……？

en: Kotaro《Ho-ho-ho. Boring! This is how a man's mood goes rotten. Chalo, enough. Let me take your head and finish the matter!》Kageaki《...By what means?》
ja:
小太郎《ほっほっほ。
　つまらぬ、つまらぬなぁ！　こんなことを
していても気が腐るばかりよ。仕様がない、
そろそろその首、頂くとしようかの！》景明《……如何にしてだ》

en: Some new art, perhaps? Was showing himself part of the preparation...?
ja: 姿を見せたのは、新たな術のため……？

en: Kotaro《Ho-ho! Still so much bluster? Or you have finally discovered how to put one small scratch on Gassan?》Kageaki《...I can see you, Kotaro Fuma.》Kotaro《...KYA!?》
ja:
小太郎《ほっほ！　この期に及んで強がりよる！
　それとも何かな。この月山に一刀打ち込む
方策、漸ようよう見つけ出したとでも言うのかの？》景明《…………。
　見えているぞ・・・・・・。風魔小太郎》小太郎《…………なッ!?》

en:
For the first time, the veteran saboteur's voice shook. No acting that I could hear. No clever trap hiding inside it.

Matlab...?

Had the man not noticed that his own art had stopped working?
ja:
初めて聞く、老練なる乱破武者の動揺の声。
　そこに演技の、策略の、臭気は感じられない。

　……どういう事だ。
　この敵、自分の術が解けていることに気付いていな・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・
かった・・・？

en:
Kotaro《Hrīḥ—āpatti-pratideśanā—ṣaḍ-indriya-śuddhiḥ!
Hrīḥ—āpatti-pratideśanā—ṣaḍ-indriya-śuddhiḥ!》
ja:
小太郎《慙愧・懺悔・六根清浄！
　慙愧・懺悔・六根清浄！》

en: ...And gone again.
ja: ……消えた。

en: Muramasa《Mido! Evade!》
ja: 村正《御堂！　回避ッ！》

en: Muramasa《—Again! It is coming!》
ja: 村正《――また来るッ！》

en: Kageaki"...Gh. Muramasa, report the damage!"Muramasa《Minor! That is not permission to feel happy! All the play has suddenly gone out of his attacks!》
ja:
景明「……ッ。
　村正、損害は！」村正《軽微！
　でも楽観しないで！　急に攻撃から遊びが
なくなった！》

en:
Blow after violent blow. For the first time, the Fuma warrior was attacking in desperation.

Haan. The playing was over.

No. More than that. The fellow was rattled.

Why? Abhi kyun? Why all of a sudden?
ja:
立て続けの猛撃。
　風魔者が初めて見せる必死の攻勢。

　そう、この敵はもう遊んでいない。
　いや――焦っている・・・・・。

　しかし、何故。
　何故、急に。

en: Kageaki"Why suddenly...? The answer is sitting in front of me."Muramasa《Mido...》Kageaki"What just happened was a fatal mistake for him. That is why!"Muramasa《Yes—!》
ja:
景明「何故、急に……？
　決まっている」村正《御堂……》景明「今のが致命的な失敗だったからだ。
　つまりはそういう事！」村正《ええ――！》

en:
Put the facts in order. First, that roar from the mountain.

Loud, certainly. But sound only. On the ground it might have shaken quite a lot. Up here, the only things getting shaken were our eardrums.

Immediately afterward, Gassan became visible. And the man himself did not notice.

Nahin, this does not sit. Suppose the noise startled him and he dropped the art. The Fuma chief, frightened by one loud bang? Even granting that embarrassment, if he dropped it himself, how did he not know? And if he was not startled, why did it break?

From this side, wrong. From that side, wrong. The truth was behind that contradiction, pakka.

But WHAT truth? One more foothold. Give the thought somewhere to put its bloody foot—
ja:
……状況を整理しろ。
　まず最初は山から響いた轟音。

　激しい音ではあったが、それはただ、それだけだ。
　地上は大きく鳴動したかもしれないが、空にあって
は耳孔の鼓膜を震わせたに過ぎない。

　その直後、月山が姿を現した。
　しかも当人は、そのことにすぐには気付かなかった。

　……おかしい。
　轟音に驚いて術を解いてしまったというのなら――
風魔の頭領が音如きで？――自分で気付かぬ筈がない。
　驚いていなかったなら、術の解ける理由がない。

　理屈が合わぬ、この矛盾。
　ここだ。
　この裏に真相がある。

　だがそれは何だ!?
　あと、何か一つ――発想の取っ掛かりがあれば――

en: Muramasa《Rear plating damaged! We cannot keep accepting these...!》Kageaki"Kh...!"
ja:
村正《……背面甲鉄に損傷！
　いけない、これ以上は持たない……！》景明「く……！」

en:
Could I not reach it?

Still not enough?

Was I to fall here?

A warrior loses. A warrior dies. That is the arrangement. But not yet. Abhi nahin—!

That way out was still forbidden to me!!
ja:
届かないのか。
　足りないのか。

　俺はここで墜ちるのか。

　敗死は武人の宿命の内。
　しかし――まだ早い――！

　まだ――
　俺にそんな逃避は許されない!!

en: Muramasa《Mido—》Kageaki"Concentrate on heat detection. No unnecessary thinking from your side!"Muramasa《...Mido. Gassan is a sacred mountain in Dewa.》Kageaki"I know. I have not requested geography."Muramasa《Gassan is the principal peak of the Three Mountains of Dewa.》Kageaki"And what am I to do with..."
ja:
村正《御堂――》景明「お前は熱源探査に専念しておけ。
　余計な思慮は無用！」村正《……。
　御堂。月山とは、出羽にある霊山のこと》景明「知っている……
　誰もそんなことを尋ねてはいない」村正《月山は、出羽三山の主峰・・・・・・・なの》景明「それがどう…………」

en: ————Three mountains?
Muramasa《Gassan alone does not make the whole faith. Mount Haguro, Mount Yudono, and Gassan: the three together make one.》
ja:
村正《月山信仰は月山だけで完結しない。
　羽黒山はぐろさん、湯殿山ゆどのさんと併せて一つの信仰になる》

en:
...Alone, incomplete.

Three together...
ja:
……一つで完結しない。
　三つ、併せて…………

en: Kageaki"—Then."Muramasa《Yes. But where to find it...》Kageaki"Somewhere with a clear view, Muramasa. Otherwise the art cannot be cast. And that roar—the one that seems to have broken it. From where did it come?"Muramasa《!!》
ja:
景明「――つまり」村正《ええ。
　けれど、それ・・が何処かとなると……》景明「見晴らしの良い場所・・・・・・・・・だ、村正。そうでなけ
れば術を施せない。
　そして、妖術の解ける切っ掛けになったと
思しき先の轟音。あれはどこで発した？」村正《!!》

en:
Gassan, incomplete alone.

An art that broke when something happened on the mountain.

A warrior who did not know it had broken.

The ridiculous heat needed to keep it working.

Bas. There was the answer. It had been standing there while I was looking everywhere else.
ja:
一つで完結しない月山。
　山の異変を契機に解けた術。
　術が解けたことに気付かない武者。
　術が要する筈の法外な熱量。

　――――結論は、其処。

en: 《《WE SEE IT!!》》
Kotaro《MURAMASAAA!!》
ja: 小太郎《村正ァッ!!》

en: A metal-echo hit my ears from somewhere I could not place. Leave it. That one did not require my attendance.
ja:
何処からとも知れぬ金打声が耳朶を打つ。
　だが、構わない。あれ・・に構う必要はない。

en:
I lowered the horns. Down, down, down. Gravity joined our side and supplied the speed. In ordinary flight, Gassan was faster. Now catching us would not be so simple.

Still, it must be closing. The killing intent was pricking through the soles of my feet.

Aa gaya—
ja:
兜角を下げ、降下降下降下。
　重力を味方として加速する。速力で村正に優る月山
といえど、そう容易くは追いつかせない。

　――それでも迫っているに違いない。
　足裏に刺さる針のような殺気。

　来る――

en: Muramasa《Mido!》
ja: 村正《御堂！》

en: Kotaro"WHAT!?"
ja: 小太郎「何ィ!?」

en:
That blow was meant to kill. The wind of the blade passing so close put ice straight into my liver.

Muramasa detected the attack. Through our skin contact, the warning reached my awareness before her voice could. I evaded immediately. What should have been impossible, we had managed.
ja:
必殺の一撃だったに違いない。
　掠め過ぎた・・・・・太刀風の凄まじさが、肝を氷結させる。

　今の一瞬、村正の敵襲探知は声より先に皮膚の接触
によって俺の意識へ伝達。
　即座の回避機動が有り得ぬ成功をもたらした。

en:
Nothing left in the way.

We went straight for them—the two mountains holding Gassan up.
ja:
もはや邪魔はない。
　そこへ向かう――月山を支える二山・・の在り処へ。

en:
Kageaki"Muramasa! Heat sources around the summit!"Muramasa《Understood!
 —Behind the shrine! Two frames!》
ja:
景明「村正、山頂周辺に熱源探知！」村正《諒解！
　――社の裏手よ！　そこに二騎！》

en:
...Mil gaye! Beside the old shrine: two warriors. Mount Haguro and Mount Yudono!

Here was the whole secret of Mist-Hiding. These two sat hidden on the ground, casting the art on Gassan!

Now everything fitted. An unreasonable art? Of course. Two whole frames were supplying it. Probably one handled the optics, the other the signals. And Gassan's strange chanting was not an incantation at all. He was signaling these fellows!

Their only work: maintain the art. His only work: fight. Toh naturally it lasted so long. We had been wondering how one man was carrying the cupboard. Two more were holding it from behind.

Three frames making one invincible warrior. Like the Three Mountains of Dewa making one faith.

Then the shock—presumably the magistrate and Elder Yagenta clashing—disturbed the casters' concentration. Mist-Hiding broke. By sheer chance, we were handed that opening. Without it, this three-in-one arrangement would probably have finished us.
ja:
……捉えた！
　古びた社のそばに、二騎の武者――羽黒山と湯殿山・・・・・・・！

　この二者が妖術・霧隠の正体。
　地上に姿を隠し、月山に陰義を掛けていた・・・・・・・・・・・術師！

　全ての謎はここに氷解する。
　常識外れの術は、二騎の武者の合力があればこそ。
おそらく一方が光学操作、もう一方が信号操作。
　月山の怪詠唱は陰義の呪句コマンドに非ず、二人への合図！

　二騎が陰義の行使に専念し、月山が戦闘のみを担当
していたのであれば、術の異様な長時間維持とて何の
不思議もない。

　彼らは三騎で一騎の無敵者を成していたのだ。
　あたかも、出羽三山が一つの信仰を成すように！

　代官と弥源太老の激突によるものだろう衝撃が術者
の集中を乱し、霧隠の術を解かせるという偶然の配剤
がもしも、なかったなら――
　おそらくこの三位一体を破るには至らなかったろう。

en:
The two frames on the summit were in complete kya-karein condition. They could not have expected this. Both turned to run.

Late, bhai. Very late.
ja:
山頂の二騎は動揺して為すところを知らなかった。
事がこう運ぶとは考えていなかったに違いない。
　踵を返し、逃げ去ろうとする――だが遅し！

en:
One flash. A second.

Muramasa's blade caught both backs and sent them flying.

The summit was narrow. They had been standing by the slope. Before resistance could even clear its throat, both were rolling toward the distant foot of the mountain.

For a warrior, that much would not be fatal.

But—
ja:
一閃――二閃。
　村正の太刀が両者の背を打ち据え、弾き飛ばす。

　狭い山頂、斜面の際のこと。
　ひと溜りとてなく、二騎ははるか麓ふもとへと転げ落ちて
いった。

　あの程度で武者たる者が死ぬ筈もない。
　だが――

en: Kotaro"YOU MADARCHOOOOOD!!"
ja: 小太郎「己ェェェェェェッッ!!」

en:
The last warrior came down from above. Fully visible now. No mist left to do its hiding for it.

Remove those two supporting frames, and even the ancient masterpiece Gassan was one warrior only. Bas ek. Nothing left to be frightened of!

Gattari, full throttle.

Up we went.
ja:
上空から襲来する最後の武者。
　その姿は既に露わ。霧の幻惑は失われている。

　二騎の支援が無くば古いにしえの名物月山も只の武者。
　恐れるべき理由はもはや無い！

　合当理全開。
　騎翔。

en: Muramasa《"This much only, Muramasa?" That was your question, Gassan's wielder?》Kotaro《...Gh!》Muramasa《ITNA!! THIS MUCH!!》
ja:
村正《――村正はその程度か。
　そう問うたわね？　月山の仕手》小太郎《……ッッ！》村正《この程度・・・・よ!!》

en: Kotaro《Bitter... this is bitter... So my Fuma's luck with heaven... was finished already...!》
ja:
小太郎《無念……かな……。
　我が風魔……天運、尽きておった、か！》

en: Kageaki"..."Muramasa《The guard, Mido.》
ja: 景明「…………」村正《鍔よ。御堂》

en: The field sword's guard. Gassan broke apart in death, and back came the guard.
ja:
野太刀の鍔・・・・・。
　月山が散華すると共に、それは還ってきた。

en: Muramasa《That makes two.》Kageaki"Yes. ...Muramasa."
ja:
村正《これで二つ》景明「ああ。
　……村正」

en: Muramasa《What is it, Mido?》Kageaki"This time, you helped me."Muramasa《...》Kageaki"Where my ability fell short, you supplied the difference. Without your advice, I probably could not have won."Kageaki"But from now on, no need."Muramasa《...No.》Kageaki"..."Muramasa《No need? Nahin, Mido.》Muramasa《The one who should stop thinking is you.》Kageaki"..."Muramasa《...》Kageaki"It is not over. To the tunnel. Quickly."Muramasa《...Yes.》
ja:
村正《なに？　御堂》景明「今回は助けられた」村正《…………》景明「俺の非才をお前が補った。
　お前の助言が無ければ勝てなかったろう」景明「だが。
　今後は無用だ」村正《…………。
　いいえ》景明「……」村正《無用なんかじゃない。
　御堂――》村正《貴方こそ、何も考えなければいい》景明「…………」村正《…………》景明「……まだ片付いてはいない。

So much blood on a person's very presence... never have I met anyone like that."Sayo"That is how you felt, madam?"Kanae"As though he were made of corpse wax. The first time our eyes met, that chill down my spine... it will not be leaving me soon."Sayo"...And yet, madam..."Kanae"Haan, Nanny. I think I know. A proper upbringing, you want to say. A man raised decently. Isn't that it?"Sayo"...In one word, yes."Kanae"I agree. That is the difficulty, na. Both things appear true."Sayo"..."Kanae"...More. I must know more about him."Sayo"Indeed. ...Hm? Madam."Kanae"What is it?"Sayo"Over there, please. These old eyes of Sayo's are not supplying the details. But a person, surely?"Kanae"...Oh, yes. Such a gallant face. A handsome boy... or have I got that wrong? A girl?"Sayo"Coming this way at a run..."

en:
After due consideration, Ichizo Sorimachi decided: kismat achhi thi. On the whole, rather lucky.

This conclusion he reached on a futon thin as papad, while his poor body supplied complaints from every department.

Escape from policeman, failed. Down a slope, into an autumn river, cold also. Haan, bad luck, he admitted. But picked up and treated before he froze to death? For a fellow like him, that was a windfall.

Zinda hai, toh lucky hai. Alive means lucky. Result ke saath behas kya? A man could not argue with the result, so lucky it was.

One worry only. Policeman or inspector barges in here, phir? Sorimachi, a man of the trade, thought something could be arranged.

Two helpless children in the house. Before he was pinned down, grab one as hostage. Rasta khul jaayega. A way out would open.

Thinking this gave him no pain. Sadistic pleasure also, no. Unless it put one over on that policeman or the GHQ woman... achha, then perhaps a little. No need to become excessively modest about the possible benefit.

This was Ichizo Sorimachi. Chhota aadmi, small nature. Small and low he had lived, small and low was satisfactory.

Hurt someone, trap someone, collect a little profit. There his brain worked beautifully. Chivalry, gratitude, loyalty, filial duty—these high-class matters, samajh hi nahin aata. No meaning reached him.

Then kya karein? Fine living he left to people who understood fine things. Ask a small fellow to carry such big principles, his back might break. Much more practical to let the other person carry them, then take advantage of how carefully he walked.

So no hesitation. Harm the girls who saved him? Thought did not trouble him. Action would not trouble him either. Thin smile on his face, Sorimachi could do it.

His meanness was no imitation. Forged right through. Mind fogged by bruises, still these plans kept arriving. The door opened; at once he turned to the next room and prepared. Alag hi level. A different class of low.

He made himself unnoticeable. Half out of his senses already, so half the work was done, he foolishly thought for one moment. Breath held, head toward the gap in the paper door.

And he looked into the next room.
ja:
雪車町一蔵は結論として、自分はまあそこそこ幸運
だったと、そう思うことにした。
　痛む体を、煎餅布団に横たえながら。

　あの警官おまわりから逃げ損ね、斜面を転げ落ち秋の温かく
もない川に没する羽目になったのは不運としても。
　凍死する前に拾われ手当てを受けられたのは、自分
のような人間にとっては稀有の奇貨。

　そうして結果的に、自分は生き延びている。
　ならやはり、幸運だったと言わねばならないだろう。

　懸念があるとすれば、ここにあの警官や、あの巡察
官などが踏み込んできた場合のことだが……
　その場合も何とかなるだろうと、筋者雪車町一蔵は
踏んでいる。

　何しろこの家には無力な子供が二人もいるのだ。
　取り押さえられる前にその片方でも人質にできれば、
活路は開ける。

　……こう考える時、雪車町という男の精神上に別段、
苦痛は存在しない。
　嗜虐的な喜びを覚えることもないが――いや。あの
警官やＧＨＱの女に一泡吹かせられるのなら。

　雪車町一蔵とはそういう男だ。
　卑小な人格を持ち、卑劣に生きてきた。
　それで良いと思っている。

　人を傷つけ、陥れて、小利を稼ぐことにのみ、興味
関心が向いた。そういうことにだけ知恵が回った。
　義侠だの、恩義だの、忠孝だの、そういった上等な
ものはどうしても理解できなかった。無意味だった。

　なら仕方ない、と雪車町一蔵は思うのだ。
　自分には卑小なことしかわからない。だから卑小に
生きる。
　上等な人生は、上等なことのわかる奴がやればいい。

　だから彼は躊躇わない。
　自分を助けた少女達に災いなす考えを弄ぶことにも、
そして、それを実行することにも。
　いつもの薄笑いを浮かべたまま、雪車町はやれる。

　その卑劣さは筋金入りだ。
　打撲の痛みに意識を朦朧とさせながらも、彼はその
ような考えを巡らし、戸口が開く音を聞き取った時に
は、行動に備えて隣の様子を窺った。卑劣さが違う。

　気配を殺し――今は意識が飛んでるから完璧だなど
と彼は愚昧なことをちらと考えた――息を殺し、この
部屋と隣室を隔てる障子戸の隙間へ、頭を運ぶ。
　そして、その向こうの光景を見た。

Tool only. A tool has no sin. Sin it cannot carry."Kageaki"The duty of using it, the right, the responsibility, the guilt—all mine. Mere hain. You have none. Obviously. What master hands his responsibility to his slave?"Muramasa《...Mido.》Kageaki"The one using the tool carries the sin. Toh the hatred also... is for that one person only."
ja:
景明「……泣く？」景明「泣くとは、どういうことだ」村正《…………》景明「なんて可哀想なことをしたんだと――
　俺は嫌々ながらやったのだと――
　本当はこんなことをしたくなかったのだと、
　涙を流して――俺も性根は善良なのだと」景明「そう言えというのか？」村正《……》景明「……ふざけるなよ。村正……」景明「本当に善良なら、最初から人を殺したりは
しないのだ！
　殺しておいてから流す涙など、最も醜悪な
偽善に過ぎん！」景明「人を殺すことは悪業であり、悪業を為す者
は悪鬼なのだ！
　俺は悪鬼なのだ！」景明「俺は悪鬼なのだッッ!!」村正《…………。
　さっきの言葉、もう一度言っておく》村正《貴方は何も考えなくていい》村正《貴方はただの仕手てあし。
　この村正の手足よ》景明「……」村正《手足がものを考える必要なんてない。
　ただ――使われていなさい》村正《……全てが終わったら解放してあげる。
　その時まで、心を閉ざしていて》村正《何も考えず、何も感じずに……
　その時を待ちなさい》景明「…………御託は終わりか？
　劔冑」村正《……》景明「貴様が俺の主だというのなら、ひとつだけ
聞いておく。
　何故だ？」景明「何故だ・・・？」村正《……以前にも聞いた覚えのある問いね》村正《答はかつてと変わらない。
　私は兵器。己を形作る理念を全うするだけ》景明「理念……」村正《鬼に逢うては鬼を斬る。
　仏に逢うては仏を斬る》村正《他の理由なんて……私には無い。
　私は人ではないのだから》村正《劔冑なのだから》景明「…………」村正《心を閉ざすことさえ辛いのなら、ひたすら
に私を憎みなさい。
　貴方にはその資格がある》村正《貴方の人生を呪った刃を……
　心の底から憎む権利がある》景明「そんなものは無い」村正《……》景明「己は兵器に過ぎぬと言ったな、劔冑。
　まさしく然り」景明「貴様はただの兵器。ただの道具。
　道具に罪などない。
　道具は罪など背負えない」景明「道具を使う義務も権利も責任も、罪科も、
すべて俺ひとりのものだ。お前には何もない。
　当然だろう。奴隷に責任を押し付ける主人
などおらぬ」村正《……御堂》景明「罪は道具を使う者に。
　ならば、憎むべきも……その者だけだ」

en: Sorimachi(...)Sorimachi(Dream... hai na? A dream...)Sorimachi(Heh, heh... what a fucked-up dream...)Sorimachi(But...)Sorimachi(Suppose it is not...)Sorimachi(Suppose this is not a dream...)
ja: 雪車町（…………）雪車町（夢……だよ、な……）雪車町（へ、へ……ひでえ、夢……）雪車町（けど……）雪車町（こいつがもし、夢じゃァなかったら……）雪車町（……夢じゃ、なかったなら……）

en:
...Down the road to the village. Report dena tha. The headman had to hear it.

Happy he would be. Little by little, the old peace would return. The peace from before the magistrate.

Quietly. Calmly. Jaise kuch hua hi nahin. As though nothing had happened, the days would go on.

Bas, ek kami. One thing missing.

That good Emishi family would not be there.

Peaceful. Happy.
One piece absent, that much only.
ja:
……村へ続く道を歩いていく。
　村長へ、報告をしなくてはならない。

　彼は喜ぶだろう。
　そして、代官が現れる前の、平和な村を取り戻して
ゆくだろう。

　穏やかに。
　静かに。
　何事もなかったかのように、村は平和な日々を過ご
してゆくのだろう。

　ただ――
　そこには、善良な蝦夷の一家がいない。

　平穏で――幸福で――
　一つだけピースの欠けた村。

en: Kageaki"..."Muramasa《Mido...》Kageaki"..."Muramasa《Mido...!》Kageaki"...Chup. Nothing I need from you."Muramasa《Mido! The village!》Kageaki"...!?"
ja:
景明「……」村正《御堂……》景明「…………」村正《御堂……！》景明「……黙っていろ。
　用はない」村正《御堂！　村が！》景明「……!?」

en:
What—

Yeh kya————

Houses wrapped in red and yellow. People lying dead.

The village—
right now, it was being destroyed.
ja:
これは――
　これは――――

　家屋を包む赤と黄色の衣。
　死に絶えている人々。

　村は――
　今・、滅びている・・・・・。

en: Muramasa《Nahin... it cannot...》Kageaki"...Gh..."
ja: 村正《まさか……》景明「……ッ……」

en: I searched the fallen people. Someone... anyone. One person still breathing—
ja:
倒れ伏す人々を見回す。
　誰か……誰か、息のある者は――

en: Village Chief"Ah... ah..."Kageaki"Headman!"Village Chief"Ah... kyun... the village... how... why..."Kageaki"What happened? Kya hua? WHAT HAPPENED!?"Village Chief"...A star..."Kageaki"...A star!?"Village Chief"Silver... a silver star..."
ja:
村長「あ……あぁ……」景明「村長！」村長「あぁ……なぜ……村が……
　どう……して…………」景明「何があった！
　何があったのだ！」村長「……ほしが……」景明「……星!?」村長「ぎんいろの……ほし…………」

en: Kageaki"..."Muramasa《...》

—The village was finished.

The magistrate, dead.
The Emishi family, dead.
And the village also. Dead.

Nothing remained.

Kuch nahin.
Nothing.
Not one thing.

Here, everything came to ash.
ja:
――村は終わった。

　代官が死に、
　蝦夷の一家が死に、
　そして、村も死に絶えた。

　何も、残らなかった。

　何も。
　何も。
　何一つ。

　全てがここに、灰燼へ帰す。

en: Muramasa《...Ma...》Kageaki"...Hikaru..."
ja: 村正《……かかさま……》景明「……光……」

en: Kageaki"HIKARUUUUUUUUUU!!"
ja: 景明「光ゥゥゥゥゥゥゥゥゥッッ!!」

en: Fuki"DEMON!"Fuki"YOU KILLED!"Funa"DEMON!"Funa"YOU KILLED!"
ja:
ふき「悪鬼！」




<voice name="ふき" class="ふき" src="voice/ex/0010060b05"
「殺した！」ふな「悪鬼！」ふな「殺した！」

en: Shishiku"...Yoritsuna Okabe refused the demand to surrender. Personally he led his bannermen out. We intercepted."Shishiku"Heavy fighting over Lake Inawashiro. After two hours, nearly all enemy frames destroyed; air superiority secured. Almost simultaneously, their ground forces declared surrender."
ja:
獅子吼「……岡部頼綱は降伏勧告を拒絶。
　自ら旗本衆を率いて討って出たため、我が
方はこれを迎撃――」獅子吼「猪苗代湖上空で激しい戦闘となったものの、
二時間後には敵騎をほぼ殲滅、制空権の掌握
に成功しました。
　ほぼ同時に地上の反乱部隊が降伏を宣言」

en: Shishiku"Ringleader Yoritsuna Okabe: killed in battle. His heir, Jubei Yoriyoshi: burned the residence and committed ritual suicide. Genshin Omura and Kisaburo Takano: killed in battle. Okabe's second son, Rokuyomaru: caught fleeing and killed."Shishiku"Every remaining leader falls into one of three categories. Dead, captured, surrendered. That the Okabe faction is finished, I believe we can safely conclude."
ja:
獅子吼「首謀者岡部頼綱は討死、嫡男十兵衛頼良は
館に火を放って切腹。
　大村玄信、高野喜三郎も討死を遂げ、岡部
の次子六曜丸は逃走中を捕殺」獅子吼「その他、主だった者どもは全て戦死、捕縛、
投降、いずれかの命運を辿っております。
　岡部一党は壊滅したと断定して宜しいかと」

en: Moriuji"...Several towns and villages assisted the rebellion. Men and supplies they provided. What was done about them?"Shishiku"The usual procedure. All residents executed. All houses burned to the ground. Nothing left but wasteland."Moriuji"Achha. Well served."Shishiku"Ji!"Moriuji"Yoritsuna, that fellow... For years, obedience on the face and betrayal behind it. And not even the courtesy to hide it properly. Yet now, with the proof of his death before me... a strange feeling."Moriuji"No more of that poisonous tongue. Heh... oddly, I shall miss it. In its own way, his poison was quite entertaining."Doushin"HAH-HAH-HAH! Maharaj, convenience is truly the ruler of your heart!"
ja:
護氏「……反乱に加担し、物資や兵員を提供した
町村がいくつかあったはずだな。
　それは、どうした」獅子吼「常の通りに。
　住民は全て処刑、家屋は根こそぎ焼き払い、
何も残らぬ荒地と致しました」護氏「宜しい。
　大儀であった」獅子吼「はッ！」護氏「頼綱め……
　長年、予に対して公然と面従腹背の姿勢を
見せてきおった憎い奴だが、こうして生首に
なった姿と対面してみると妙な感慨がある」護氏「こやつの毒舌をもう聞けぬと思うとな……
ふふ、不思議なほど寂しさを感じてならん。
　思えば奴の毒、あれはあれでなかなか一興
であった」童心「はぁっはっは！
　殿も勝手なことを申される！」

en: Doushin"Only the other day, every second sentence from you was, ‘Okabe must die! No rest for me until even his remains are disposed of!’ Over and over, Maharaj. My ears grew calluses."Doushin"And now the fellow is dead, and this is the speech! Arre baba, what a difficult man my lord is!"Moriuji"Doushin, you need not tell me. I am hearing myself also. That thorn is out of my eye; now there is room for thoughts I never had while it was there."Moriuji"While a man lives you wish him dead; once he is dead you wish him alive. You need not tell me, holy man. The human heart is willful through and through. It is built never to be satisfied."Doushin"Exactly! Satisfaction is missing, so a man struggles for it; in struggling, he improves. Give him complete satisfaction and what remains? Wood, stone. Enlightened, certainly. Useful to the world? Nothing doing."Doushin"My lord becomes a living Buddha, and who is to look after the country? No, no, selfishness is very necessary! Kindly continue doing precisely as you please, my lord!"Shishiku"...What kind of sermon is this?"Moriuji"Doushin is too much for me. Heh, heh, heh..."Raichou"Well, in any case—"
ja:
童心「先日までは事あるたび、岡部の首を持って
参れ、奴の首を犬に食わせてやるまでは眠る
こともできぬと、返す返す仰られていたに。
　それがし、耳にたこができましたぞ」童心「それがいざ死んでみれば、この仰りよう。
　いやはや、困った御方じゃ！」護氏「そう言ってくれるな、童心坊。
　予とてわかっておる……目の上の瘤が取れ、
心持ちに余裕ができたればこそそんな思いも
浮かぶのだ。かつては考えもせなんだことを」護氏「生きておれば死を望み、死に果てれば生を
望む……全く、御坊ごぼうに言われるまでもない。
　人の心の働きというのは本当に勝手なもの
よ。どこまでも満足せぬように出来ておる」童心「であればこそ、人は満足を求めてあがき、
自らを高めるのでござる。
　満ち足りた人間は木石も同然、悟りの境地
ではござるが、世の役には立ち申さぬ」童心「殿がかような生き仏になっては御国の大事。
　いや、勝手な言い草おおいに結構！　殿に
おかれてはどうか今後とも、自侭になさって
くださりませい！」獅子吼「……どういう説法だ」護氏「かなわんな、童心坊には。
　ふっふっふ……」雷蝶「まぁ、何に致しましても」

en: Raichou"Whatever else may be said, the anti-shogunate forces in and around Kanto are now almost entirely swept away. My congratulations, Father. First of all."Moriuji"Hm. You also worked hard."Raichou"Such gracious words! And I could contribute so little to putting down this rebellion..."Shishiku"Truly. Not one shipment from the line under your charge ever reached the front. Not one."Raichou"Th-that could not be helped! The anti-shogunate guerrillas blew up the railway! We beat them so badly last time, I thought they were finished..."Shishiku"Are you an idiot? Their kind spring up endlessly. There is no ‘finished.’"Shishiku"You neglected even basic vigilance. The blame on you is heavy."Raichou"Ugh..."Shishiku"I am not demanding seppuku. But why not shave that garish head, Raichou? I have long found your eye-stabbing ugliness unbearable."Raichou"You are picking a fight with ME?! My magnificent person is u-u—UGLY?! Aankh hai ya button, madarchod—what bloody eyes are you using?! A vassal's vassal, a jumped-up nobody—and I am to let you walk away?!"Shishiku"Make me pay, by all means. From you, I do not expect the price to be high."Shishiku"Any time. If you want a fight, come."Raichou"Tu—tu—YOU...!"Doushin"Now, now, Raichou. Calm down first. Take a seat."Raichou"Doushin saab, aap hi batao—what chutiyapa is this?! He insults me, and now I must politely accept his invitation to fight?! I am direct blood of the Ashikaga! This is rebellion! Beheading this very minute is the MINIMUM—"Moriuji"Be still."Raichou"F-Father..."Moriuji"I do not think you have done nothing. But first merit in this war belongs to Shishiku, who led his own troops and put down the rebellion. Put up with some loose talk from him."Moriuji"Otherwise it is your own stature that will be questioned."Raichou"...Y-yes."Shishiku"Hmph..."Raichou"Kh..."Moriuji"Shishiku, restrain yourself as well. I know every word comes from loyalty to me, but to an onlooker it can look like arrogance."Moriuji"That would do you harm."Shishiku"Ha. I will keep it in mind."Doushin"Hah-hah-hah! Young people should have this much spirit. Lock horns, by all means, by all means. Only my lord, who by his position must always play referee, has a hard time of it."Moriuji"..."Chachamaru"I mean—"
ja:
雷蝶「これで関東近隣から反幕府勢力はほぼ一掃
されたと言えましょう。
　まずはおめでとうございます、お父様」護氏「うむ。
　そちも御苦労であった」雷蝶「勿体ないお言葉！
　此度の乱ではあまり大した貢献も出来ませ
なんだのに……」獅子吼「本当にな。
　貴様の担当したラインからの補給は、遂に
一度も前線まで届かなかった」雷蝶「あっ……あれは仕方ないのよっ！
　討幕派のゲリラに鉄道を爆破されちゃった
んだから！　あいつら、こないだ散々叩いた
からもう大丈夫だと思っていたのに……」獅子吼「馬鹿か？
　その手の輩はいくらでも湧いてくる。もう
大丈夫、などということはない」獅子吼「当然の警戒を怠った貴様の責任は重大だ」雷蝶「うぐ……」獅子吼「腹を切れとまでは言わんが、そのけばけば
しい頭を丸めてみるのはどうだ？　雷蝶。
　貴様のその、目に刺さるような見苦しさは
耐え難いと、かねがね思っていたところだ」雷蝶「あんた喧嘩売ってんのっ!?　こっ、この麿
の美々しい姿が、みみみ見苦しいですって!?
　許せないわ！　陪臣またもの上がりの癖に！　只で
済むとは思ってないでしょうね!?」獅子吼「只で済ませてくれなくとも良い。
　貴様なら別段、高い出費を覚悟する必要も
無さそうだ」獅子吼「いつでも構わん。
　一戦交えるのが望みなら、掛かってくるが
いい」雷蝶「な、な、なっ……」童心「まぁまぁ、雷蝶殿。
　まずは落ち着いて。お座りなされい」雷蝶「でも、童心様！
　今のお聞きになったでしょう、足利家直系
の麿に対して暴言の数々！
　これはもう反逆よッ、今すぐ打ち首に――」護氏「静まれ」雷蝶「お、お父様……」護氏「そちに働きがないとは予は考えておらん。
　だが此度の戦、功一等は自ら手兵を率いて
乱を鎮圧した獅子吼。多少の放言は受容せよ」護氏「さもなくばそちの器量が問われようぞ」雷蝶「……は、はっ」獅子吼「ふん……」雷蝶「くっ……」護氏「獅子吼。そなたも控えよ。
　全て予への忠義から出た言葉であることは
わかっておるが、傍目には驕りとも映る」護氏「それではそなたの損になろう」獅子吼「はっ。
　心致します」童心「はっはっはっ。まぁ、若い者はこれくらい
元気な方が宜しい。角突き合わせるのも結構
結構。立場上いつも仲裁役に回らねばならぬ
殿には、なかなか、御難儀なことでござるが」護氏「……」茶々丸「つーか」

en: Chachamaru"Basically he is the poor papa holding together a family with way too much personality, all in the wrong direction. Arre, wait. He literally is. Grandpa, tough life, yaar."Raichou"You are the last person to say it! Who gives Father the most trouble? You, obviously, you! Think about it!"Chachamaru"Eh? What has apun done now?"Shishiku"You did nothing. Less even than Raichou. Right to the end you showed no sign of sending troops or supplies. What was the idea?"Chachamaru"Idea? First consider geography, bhai. Apun's headquarters: Izu Peninsula. Your destination: Aizu. In between, the whole middle of Kanto. This is where you want the cargo pushed through?"Chachamaru"Railway gone; air route, storm; sea route, also storm. Transport by which route, kindly specify. Complaints go to that lantern anglerfish and Typhoon Number Fifteen. Apun is the wrong address."Raichou"W-w-who is a lantern anglerfish?!"Shishiku"You."Shishiku"Even so, finding some way to deliver is the duty of anyone entrusted with an army at Rokuhara. That needs no saying, Chachamaru. In fact, Doushin delivered it by vehicle."Chachamaru"And apun should do all that also? No, yaar. Too much trouble."Chachamaru"It got settled nicely without it, no? Result is good, therefore all is good. Apply that logic for this once."Shishiku"You..."Chachamaru"Arre, anger down, temperature down. And listen properly, Shishiku: apun did not do nothing either."Shishiku"Liar. You contributed neither at the front nor in supply. What did you do?"Chachamaru"Propaganda."Raichou"...Huh? What is that?"Chachamaru"Got an editorial printed in the Yamato North-South News. Apun wrote it, they printed it under a staffer’s name. See, if the public hates us too much, that is not good, so a little defence of this affair."Doushin"Oho, oho. And what sort of editorial, Chachamaru?"Chachamaru"Something like this."
ja:
茶々丸「わりかしヤな方向で個性あり過ぎな一家を
まとめる苦労人パパって感じだよなー。いや、
まんまそうか？
　おじじもほんと、大変だね」雷蝶「あんたが言わないでよッ！
　お父様にいつも一番迷惑掛けてるのはどう
考えたってあんたでしょうがッ!?」茶々丸「えー。あて、なんかした？」獅子吼「……何もしとらんな。雷蝶以上に。
　貴様、とうとう最後まで兵も物資も寄越す
そぶりさえ見せなかったが……一体どういう
つもりだ？」茶々丸「どーもこーも。
　あての本陣がどこだか知ってんだろ。伊豆
半島から関東を中央突破して会津まで送れっ
てーの？　無茶言えよな」茶々丸「鉄道は駄目、空路も海路も荒れてて駄目っ
てな状況で輸送ができるわけねえし。
　文句なら、そこの提灯鮟鱇ちょうちんあんこうと台風一五号に
言っとけ。あてに言うな、あてに」雷蝶「だだっ……誰が提灯鮟鱇よッ!?」獅子吼「貴様だ」獅子吼「それでもどうにかして送るのが、六波羅に
あって一軍を預かる者の義務であるくらい、
言わずともわかろう。茶々丸。
　実際、童心殿は車両運送で届けてきた」茶々丸「あてにもそうしろって？
　やだよかったりぃ」茶々丸「いいじゃん、あっさりカタついたんだしさ。
結果オーライってーことで。ここはひとつ」獅子吼「貴様……」茶々丸「あー怒るな怒るな。暑苦しいから。
　だいたい、獅子吼さ。あてだってなんにも
やんなかったわけじゃないよ」獅子吼「嘘をつけ。
　前線でも兵站でも貢献しなかった貴様が何
をしたと云うのだ」茶々丸「宣伝工作」雷蝶「……は？
　何よ、それ」茶々丸「大和南北新聞に社説を掲載してもらったの。
　あてが書いたやつを社員の名前で。いやさ、
あんまり世間の反感買うのもアレだし、今回
の件についてちょっと擁護をね」童心「ほう、ほう。
　茶々丸殿、それはどのような？」茶々丸「こんなよーな」

en:
『THE FRIENDSHIP MASSACRE』◆

The rebellion of Yoritsuna Okabe at Aizu-Inawashiro has concluded with his entire clan and following exterminated. Rebellion against the State, naturally, leaves the State no alternative. Still, when we consider the suffering of those who met this terrible end, sorrow is overflowing from the heart.

Anger toward Rokuhara appears to be increasing. Dissatisfaction also. But one minute, please. What benefit will hatred of the State deliver? Instead, let us understand the feelings of the shogunate, that very organisation which exists to protect us. Why did our protectors have to do this? We must think. We must understand. Whatever must be endured, let us endure it, and work toward a peaceful relationship in which they will not have to kill us again. Cooperation is required from both sides, and our side must provide it.

Then this destruction of the Okabe faction need not enter history as a tragedy. It may become the Friendship Massacre: the occasion on which government and people came together, and a happy new age began.

For those of us remaining alive, surely this is our duty. Surely this is how we honour the noble sacrifice of the Okabe people. Personally, I cannot make my heart feel otherwise.
ja:
『友情の虐殺』◆
　
　会津猪苗代で勃発した岡部頼綱の反乱は、一族郎党
皆殺しという結末を迎えた。国家に対する反逆である
以上やむを得ない処置であるとはいえ、凄惨な最期を
遂げた人々の苦しみを思うと、悲嘆の情感は抑え難い
ものがある。

　世間には六波羅に対して怒りと不満を募らせる風潮
もあるようだ。しかし、ちょっと待って欲しい。国家
を憎んだところで何が得られるというのだろう。ここ
はむしろ、我々国民を守る統治組織である幕府がなぜ、
あえてそのような行為をするに至ったかを考え、理解
し、今後は彼らにそうさせないよう、耐えるべきこと
は耐えて、新たに平和な関係を築くため努力するべき
ではないのか。

　そうすれば、岡部党鏖殺のこの事件は、後世に悲劇
としてではなく、官民を結び付けるきっかけとなった
『友情の虐殺』として、幸福な時代の始まりとして、
伝えられてゆくのではないだろうか……。
　それこそが残された人々の義務であり、岡部の人々
の尊い犠牲に報いる道だと、私には思えてならないの
である。

en: Moriuji"..."Shishiku"..."Chachamaru"Kaisa laga? See the craftsmanship. Whole point of the argument, apun has quietly shifted to another address."Shishiku"WHERE IS THE QUIET PART!?"Raichou"This reads like you are INVITING a fight!!"Chachamaru"Arre, nahin. See for yourself."Doushin"GAH-HAH-HAH-HAH!"Chachamaru"Audience satisfied."Shishiku"Doushin!"Raichou"What does THAT prove!? You wrote this to get LAUGHS!?"Chachamaru"Politics by force alone is finished, bhai. Entertainment ka zamana hai. New era, please adjust."Raichou"WHAT DOES THAT EVEN MEAN!?"Shishiku"I withdraw my complaint. Do nothing. Ever again, do absolutely nothing. Breathing also, if possible, stop. Pulse can stop with it."Chachamaru"Grandpaaa. These fully grown children are bullying apun."Moriuji"...Chhodo. It is fine."Shishiku"With respect, Your Highness, fine it is not. The shogunate's prestige is involved."Raichou"Father, first send this vacant skull to Mars. Then recall the newspaper."Moriuji"Enough. Shishiku, Raichou. Do not get so agitated over what Chachamaru does."Shishiku"...As you command."Chachamaru"Don't get agitaaaated."Shishiku"Chup."Raichou"Die somewhere."Chachamaru"Grandpa, direct disobedience. Permission to kill both?"Doushin"Now, now. ...After such cheerful proceedings, forgive this unfortunate contribution. One uncheerful report I must make. May I?"Moriuji"Hm?"Chachamaru"Too many jellyfish happened?"Doushin"No, no. The investigation into that village destroyed in my jurisdiction. Its report has arrived."Shishiku"...Ah."Raichou"Uncheerful means our expectations were correct, Doushin saab?"Doushin"From another angle, one could hardly ask for a livelier performance. Survivors: none. Every last person killed. Old, young, man, woman—no distinction. All silent now."Doushin"The report judges the incident's extraordinary character to be almost certain evidence of Silver Star's appearance."Shishiku"...Silver Star!"Raichou"How many incidents now...?"Moriuji"Eyewitness reports?"Doushin"The usual position there also..."Moriuji"None."Doushin"None reliable. Several nearby residents and passers-by claim a silver meteor was seen. Where the truth ends and the later embroidery begins, that is the difficulty."Chachamaru"Matlab, nobody clearly saw the actual killing?"Doushin"That much is the position, yes."
ja:

en: Shishiku"What absolute bloody nonsense...!"Chachamaru"Nonsense kya? Everyone who saw it died. Simple arrangement."Shishiku"And which part of that is NOT nonsense?"Chachamaru"Ahaha. Haan, fair. Full nonsense."Raichou"...This is not a laughing matter."Chachamaru"What else is left, yaar? Anybody would laugh."Chachamaru"That rumour all over Kanto. Silver Star wiped out one whole company of warriors. Public verdict: maybe true, maybe rubbish. Fifty-fifty belief."Chachamaru"And suppose they learn the rumour is false."Chachamaru"Not one company. One BATTALION. Ab bolo. After that, what else can a person do but laugh?"Raichou"..."Shishiku"True. Fifty-odd warriors, annihilated by one. Ancient mythology, or something a madman has imagined. That is where such a story belongs."Doushin"Even Overlord Xiang of the Chinese legends might compare. Arre, how did a thing like this arrive in the actual world?"Raichou"What IS it...?"Chachamaru"—It is the end, it is extinction, it is disappearance leaving not even ash. Touch thou not. Look thou not. Unless being wiped out is thy personal wish..."Raichou"What is that from?"Chachamaru"Gospel of Matthew. Supplementary record. The bit about the Demon King descending."Raichou"...Oh..."Chachamaru"Made it up."Raichou"JHOOTH THA!?"Chachamaru"Pfff! Believed it, this fellow! There is always one. Put a respectable coat on any bakwaas and straight down the throat it goes. Then they repeat it elsewhere and make full public chutneys of themselves."Raichou"I will kill you..."Doushin"Arre, arre."Shishiku"Your Highness, this requires a serious response. The present team is insufficient. Expand it, place one of us in command, and address the threat properly."Moriuji"Hm..."Chachamaru"So smoothly he ignored it. For one second he believed it too, pakka. Raichou, congratulations. You are not alone in your condition."Raichou"I do not entertain idiots. Hmph."Moriuji"Doushin. Your opinion of Shishiku's proposal?"Doushin"Hmm. Necessary eventually, that cannot be denied. But at present..."Shishiku"Too early, you mean."Doushin"Exactly. For the shogunate to commit so much strength against an unknown criminal, just now, would probably..."Moriuji"Fan the embers. Our opponents among the people. GHQ also..."Shishiku"An opening for enemies within and without. I recognise the danger. But Silver Star is too great a calamity to ignore. Some sacrifice may be necessary to crush it."Doushin"Then the question is whom to deal with first. Our enemies, or this calamity? Shishiku, remember: we are not the only ones taking the damage."Shishiku"..."Doushin"The Occupation Army, our principal enemy, has suffered considerably also. We alone should stand in front, take the blows, and clear their trouble away? Service is excellent. Bargain, not so excellent."
ja:
獅子吼「なんという馬鹿げた話だ……！」茶々丸「別に馬鹿げちゃいねぇだろ。
　見た奴は全員死にましたってだけの話だ」獅子吼「それの、どこが、馬鹿げていない？」茶々丸「あはは。だよねー。馬鹿くせー」雷蝶「……笑ってる場合かっての」茶々丸「いやもう笑うしかねぇしさ。
　誰だってそーだと思うよ？」茶々丸「もう関東中に広まってる、武者の一個中隊

　市民の間じゃ信憑性は半信半疑って辺りで

en: Shishiku"...I see."Raichou"But Doushin saab! If we crush the Silver Star that GHQ cannot handle, what a demonstration! Yamato will see who actually has the power to govern!"Doushin"There also, a difficulty. Small effect: all our exhaustion for nothing. Large effect: a fire under the Occupation's backside."Doushin"They are waiting for complete control of Yamato. Our authority grows, and they will quietly admire it? Nahin. First we exhaust ourselves against Silver Star. Then GHQ brings its great army to greet us. This welcome I would prefer to avoid."Raichou"..."Moriuji"Theek hai. Doushin's view is accepted. The present arrangement for Silver Star remains. We shall expand it eventually, after my rule is complete. That is the order of business."Shishiku"Ji..."Doushin"As you command."Raichou"As Father wishes."Moriuji"...Not satisfied, Shishiku?"Shishiku"No objection. But one point refuses to leave my mind."Moriuji"Speak."Shishiku"Silver Star has never once appeared on the Kanto air-defence radar. The reasonable conclusion: it does not come from outside Kanto."Raichou"Flying low, perhaps, to fool the radar? ...No. Somebody should have seen it with their own eyes, then."Chachamaru"Somewhere in Kanto it comes from, somewhere in Kanto it goes back. Whole region covered by radar, problem solved. But ours watches the boundary only, na."Doushin"Personnel, money—neither will stretch that far. The radar itself needs improvement first. At present, covering the key points is all we can manage."Shishiku"Yes, comprehensive coverage would make it easier. But even without that, this matter should already be settled."Shishiku"Warriors are conspicuous. Your Highness, that is what refuses to fit."Moriuji"Hm..."Shishiku"Several reports describe it taking off from the scenes of its crimes. Not one describes it landing. That is decidedly strange."Doushin"Hmm. A warrior lands with such a roar, such a trail of smoke. Even at a distance, it should be noticeable. And yet..."Raichou"Deep in the mountains, away from people?"Shishiku"How much mountain wilderness does Kanto have? Some, yes. Those places have already received the team's particular attention."Shishiku"Result: nothing. Not one trace."Raichou"..."Moriuji"Doushin. What do you make of it?"Doushin"No answer, Maharaj. Shishiku's reasoning is sound. Suspicious it certainly is. But this monster already exceeds common sense. Perhaps the ordinary measuring stick is too small for it."Moriuji"Hm..."Chachamaru"Achha? Maybe the explanation is dead simple."Raichou"You have contributed enough noise. Stay quiet."Chachamaru"Theek haiii."Shishiku"..."
ja:

その点」護氏「うむ……」獅子吼「犯行現場から奴が飛び立つところを見たと
いう報告は過去に数件ございます。
　しかし、着陸現場を目撃されたことは一度
たりとありません。これはいかにも奇怪な話」童心「……ふむぅ。
　武者が着陸する際に生じる爆音それに噴煙
の軌跡は、かなり離れた場所からでも確認が

　無論、あることはあるがな。そんな場所は

　何の痕跡も発見できていない」雷蝶「……」護氏「童心坊。どう考える？」童心「わかりませぬなァ。確かに獅子吼殿の申し
