　そしていつも、断念してきたのだった。
　並の劒冑では〝卵〟に食われてしまうのだから仕方
がない。銀星号と戦うには、この呪わしい劒冑を使い
続ける以外にない――と。

　そう諦めて、村正を使ってきたのだ。

　諦めて・・・。

　望んだのでは、決してなく。

en: Kageaki"............"Muramasa《...Go...》

Muramasa.

For a tsurugi, too much feeling. Easily worked up, easily shaken. A strong will of her own; sometimes she disobeyed, sometimes she simply dug her heels in.

Just now she had even tried using her power against me.

And the Balance of Good and Evil. With this tsurugi, battle would always be made fruitless.

...That was Muramasa.

Two years on the same road.
My tsurugi.
ja:
村正。

　劒冑にしては感情的で、しばしば昂たかぶり、動揺する。
　自我も強く、時として指示に逆らい、ごね・・たりする。

　先刻は、俺に対して力を揮ふるおうとまでしかけた。

　そして善悪相殺の戒律。
　この劒冑は必ず、戦いを無益・・なものにしてしまう。

　……それが村正。

　二年間、道行みちゆきを共にしてきた、
　俺の劒冑だ。

en: Kageaki"Haan. ............After all—"Muramasa《...》Kageaki"It has to be you."Muramasa《...Why...?》Kageaki"Since we met, so many battles we have passed through. I survived because your help was there."Kageaki"Because you helped, I could stop the Eggs from hatching. With my strength alone, nothing could have been done..."Kageaki"Late I am in saying it... but I acknowledge that. From now on also, I want your help."Muramasa《............》Muramasa《Help only... that is not all I gave you.》Kageaki"..."Muramasa《You have not forgotten, na?》Muramasa《I made you kill innocent people! First your mother—and afterward—》Kageaki"...Yes."Muramasa《So many I made you kill! You cannot want any more of that!》Muramasa《You cannot bear it, na! Then throw me away!》Muramasa《Without me, you will not have to do that! A tsurugi that can beat Silver Star, somewhere it must be there...》Muramasa《Find it...》Kageaki"There is no such thing. ...And even if there were—"Kageaki"You are the one I want, Muramasa."
ja:
景明「ああ。
　…………やはり」村正《……》景明「お前でなくては駄目だ」村正《……なんでよぅ……》景明「お前と出会ってから、幾度もの戦いを経た。
　俺が生き延びてこられたのは、お前の助け
があったからだ」景明「お前が助けてくれたから、〝卵〟の孵化も
阻止してこられた。
　俺の力だけではどうにもできなかった……」景明「今更だが……それを認める。
　これからも力を貸して欲しい」村正《…………》村正《私がしたことは……助けだけじゃない》景明「……」村正《忘れてはいないでしょう》村正《私は貴方に、罪もない人を殺させてきた！
　最初は貴方の母親――その後にも》景明「……ああ」村正《何人も殺させた！
　もう嫌でしょう!?》村正《耐えられないでしょう！
　だから、私を捨てればいいのよ！》村正《私がいなければ、そんなことしなくて済む
んだから！
　銀星号に勝てる劒冑なら、きっと何処かに
ある……》村正《貴方はそれを探せばいいの……》景明「そんなものは無い。
　……仮にあったとしても」景明「俺が望むのはお前だ、村正」

en: Muramasa《............》Muramasa《Why?》Kageaki"The Balance of Good and Evil?"Kageaki"As long as I am with you, this will go on. One enemy defeated, one ally also I will have to cut down."Muramasa《Yes...》Kageaki"Kill someone who ought not to die."Muramasa《Yes.》Kageaki"But then... someone becomes my enemy, and that makes them a person who ought to die? Can I say that?"Muramasa《...》Kageaki"I killed my adoptive mother."Kageaki"Killed Yuhi Nitta."Kageaki"Killed the Emishi sisters, Fuki and Funa."Kageaki"...Each one an unforgivable crime. Theek hai. But then—"Kageaki"Killing Ryoubu Suzukawa? Killing Ukyo Nagasaka? Killing Kotaro Fuma?"Kageaki"Killing Suguru Oji? Killing George Gargett?"Kageaki"Are those things permissible...?"Muramasa《...》Kageaki"They are not."Kageaki"From where I stood, they were evil. But their own good was also there."Kageaki"Balance of Good and Evil. ...Haan. Kill a person, and good and evil both are cut down together. Now at last I understand..."Kageaki"Muramasa. You are right."Muramasa《............》
ja:
村正《…………》村正《どうして》景明「善悪相殺か」景明「お前と共にある限り、俺はこれからも、敵
を一人倒す都度に味方も一人斬ることになる
だろう」村正《そうよ……》景明「死すべからざる誰かを殺す」村正《そうよ》景明「だがな。
　……それなら俺の敵・となった人間は、死す
べき者だと言えるのか？」村正《……》景明「俺は養母ははを殺した」景明「新田雄飛を殺した」景明「蝦夷の姉妹、ふきとふなを殺した」景明「……いずれも許されない罪だ。
　しかし、なら」景明「鈴川令法を殺したことは？
　長坂右京を殺したことは？
　風魔小太郎を殺したことは？」景明「皇路卓を殺したことは？
　ジョージ・ガーゲットを殺したことは？」景明「それは許されることなのか……？」村正《……》景明「許されない」景明「彼らは俺からすれば悪人だった。
　しかし、彼らにも彼らなりの善があった」景明「善悪相殺・・・・。
　……成程、人を殺すという事は、善と悪を
諸共に断つという事だ。ようやく理解できた
……」景明「村正。
　お前は正しい」村正《…………》

en: Kageaki"All killing is the work of an evil demon."Kageaki"There are no exceptions. There is no justice in any killing."Kageaki"There is no justice in battle."Muramasa《...Mido...》Kageaki"Muramasa. You taught me that."Kageaki"Suppose I had bonded with another tsurugi, fought these two years with it... By now, perhaps I would be calling myself a hero."Kageaki"Righteous warrior, saving the people by fighting evil and cutting it down. Silver Star defeated, now Rokuhara also should be overthrown—perhaps I would be thinking like that..."Kageaki"Thinking of it only makes me shudder. Self-righteousness with makeup on, call it justice, get drunk on it and start a war..."Muramasa《............》Kageaki"Muramasa. There is no justice in me."Kageaki"That truth I never want to forget. That is why I need you."Kageaki"Throw you away, take another tsurugi... then I am choosing that self-righteous road myself. Good people, spare them. Bad people, kill them."Kageaki"Saying there are people who may die and people who must not, and I have the right to decide who belongs where..."Muramasa《...》Kageaki"A shameless hero, I do not want to become. Worse, people see me, think there really is such a thing as righteous war, and start following. That ridiculous result I want even less."Kageaki"That would be disaster itself."Muramasa《Mido.》Kageaki"I choose you."Kageaki"I choose the law, the Balance of Good and Evil."Kageaki"Will you choose me also?"Muramasa《...》
ja:
景明「殺人はなべて悪鬼の所業」景明「例外など無い。
　あらゆる殺人に正義は無い」景明「戦いに正義は無い」村正《……御堂……》景明「村正。お前がそれを教えてくれた」景明「お前ではなく、他の劒冑と結縁して、この
二年を戦っていたら……
　俺は今頃、自分のことを英雄とでも思って
いたかもしれん」景明「世の人々を救うために悪と戦いこれを討つ、
正義の武者だとな。
　そうして、銀星号を倒した暁には、六波羅
をも打倒しようなどと考えていたか……」景明「想像するだに怖気おぞけの走る話だ。
　独善の化粧でしかない正義に酔い、争乱を
引き起こすなど……」村正《…………》景明「村正。
　俺に正義は無い」景明「その真実を決して忘れたくない。
　だからお前が必要だ」景明「お前を捨てて別の劒冑を取れば……
　善人は殺さず悪人は殺す・・・・・・・・・・・という独善の道を、
俺は選ぶことになる」景明「世には死んで良い人間と死んではならない
人間とがいて、自分にはその区別をする権利
があるのだと認めることになる……」村正《……》景明「俺は厚顔無恥な英雄になどなりたくはない。
　世間の人々がそんな俺を見て、正義の戦い
があると信じ、後に続こうとする――などと、
馬鹿げた始末になるのは尚のこと御免だ」景明「それこそ災禍わざわいというものだ」村正《御堂》景明「俺はお前を選ぶ」景明「善悪相殺の戒律を選ぶ」景明「お前も、俺を選んではくれないか」村正《……》

en: Muramasa《Really... you are all right with this...?》Kageaki"For me, it has to be you."Muramasa《Mido... ...But...》Muramasa《I... kept the Second Muramasa alive. My mother. Silver Star came into this age because of me... So—》Kageaki"Alone you must fight, is it?"Muramasa《...》Kageaki"Exactly the same feeling I had. No, still I have it... but—"Kageaki"Let us admit this much, Muramasa. Alone, you are weak. Alone, so am I."Kageaki"Each needs the other. The two of us have to become one warrior, or we cannot fight."Kageaki"Fight... with me."Muramasa《...Mido...》
ja:
村正《本当に……いいの……？》景明「俺には、お前でなくてはならないのだ」村正《御堂……
　……でも……》村正《二世村正かかさまを生かしたのは……私。
　銀星号をこの時代に呼び込んだのは私……
だから》景明「自分独りで戦わなくてはならない、か？」村正《……》景明「俺にもそっくり同じ思いがあった。
　いや、今でもある……が」景明「認めよう、村正。
　俺もお前も独りでは弱い」景明「互いが必要だ。
　俺達はふたりで一騎とならねば、戦えない
のだ」景明「一緒に……戦ってくれ」村正《……御堂……》

en:
I bit the pad of my right thumb, shallowly breaking the skin. As blood welled up, I held it out to the tsurugi.

—This thumb, without it I could not properly wield a sword.
ja:
右手の親指に歯を立て、腹を浅く食い破る。
　血が溢れ始めたそれを、俺は劒冑へ向けた。

　――この指は、太刀を扱うに欠かせぬ指。

en: Muramasa《...Ah...》

Hesitantly, the tsurugi answered with an outstretched limb.
It touched me.

Blood stained the armour.
ja:
おずおずと、劒冑が肢あしを差し伸ばして応える。
　触れる。

　血が甲鉄を染める。

en:
Once, a sound like a crystal bell passed between Muramasa and me.

This was————

The simplest, the oldest proper rite of a warrior: the Tatewaki Ceremony, the sword-bearing ceremony.

Here our bond was formed...
For the first time, Muramasa and I became one warrior.
ja:
水晶の鐘を打つような楽がくが、一度。
　俺と村正の間を渡った。

　これが――――

　最も簡素で、最も古い、武者正調の帯刀儀礼タテワキノギ。

　ここに縁えにしは結ばれ……
　俺と村正は初めて、一騎の武者と成なった。

en: Police Officer"Found him!"
ja: 警官「いたぞー！」

en:
After a long absence, I was before the Prince again.
First business: bow my head and apologise. Deeply.
ja:
久方ぶりに罷まかり出た、親王の御前。
　俺は何をもさて置いて低頭し、深く謝した。

en: Kageaki"Your Highness, Prince Maidono. ...The other day, very great trouble I caused you. I offer my humblest apologies."Chief"..."Kageaki"After all your kindness, instead of repaying it I have repaid you with harm... With what face can I stand before you?"Prince Maidono"Bas, bas, Kageaki... Such a grown man, folding himself so small. That will not do."
ja:
景明「舞殿宮殿下。
　……先日は多大な迷惑をお掛け致しました。
伏してお詫び申し上げます」署長「……」景明「日頃の御厚恩に報いるどころか、仇で返す
仕儀となったこと……
　全く、面目次第もございません」舞殿宮「ま、ま、景明くん……。
　大の男がそんな縮こまったらあかんえ」

en:
The voice from behind the blinds held no reproach. If anything, he was trying to soothe me.

But after what I had done, I could hardly think, ah, good, that was settled. Raising my head was not coming easily.
ja:
御簾の奥で発せられる声に叱責の調子はまるでなく、
むしろ宥める風であったが。
　己の所業を思えば、なら良かったと安堵もできない。
俺は容易に頭を上げられなかった。

en: Prince Maidono"Arre, the regular help is coming from your side. Once in a while you cause us some trouble, we can almost feel reassured."Prince Maidono"Is it not, Chief?"Chief"I am deeply ashamed, sir."Prince Maidono"Though Kageaki has broken out of prison, when I heard that... haan, the tea did come out of my mouth..."Kageaki"..."
ja:
舞殿宮「日頃世話になってるのはこっちなんやから。
　たまには迷惑のひとつも掛けてくれた方が
安心できるくらいやわ」舞殿宮「なあ、署長」署長「恐縮です」舞殿宮「ま、景明くんが脱獄した・・・・て聞いた時は茶ァ
吹いたけどなぁ……」景明「……」

en:
His Highness was remaining entirely at ease.
An answer, meanwhile, I could not produce.
ja: あくまで気楽な様子の親王に、言葉も返せない。

en: Prince Maidono"And for his tsurugi, no less. Admirable. A model warrior, this one..."Prince Maidono"Is he not, Chief?"Chief"I am deeply ashamed, sir."Kageaki"..."Prince Maidono"...Kikuchi... With you carrying on like that also, how is Kageaki to lift his head?"Chief"Sir. But this happened because my supervision was inadequate—"Prince Maidono"Arre, bas! Is this an apology or a competition in who can fold himself smaller?"Prince Maidono"Everything ended without harm. So that is the end of this matter. Both of you understand?"Chief"...Sir!"Kageaki"..."
ja:
舞殿宮「それが劒冑のためやったっちゅうんやから、
見上げたもんやねぇ。
　武者の鑑やないか……」舞殿宮「なあ署長」署長「恐縮です」景明「……」舞殿宮「……菊池ぃ……。
　おまさんまでそんな調子やと、景明くんも
頭上げられんやろう」署長「は。
　しかし、今回は私の管理不行届で――」舞殿宮「あぁ、もうええもうええ。
　……この二人は手に負えんわ」舞殿宮「何事も無う済んだわけやし、この話はもう
これまで。
　ええね、二人とも」署長「……はッ」景明「……」

en:
The Prince, administrator of Hachiman Shrine, clapped his hands twice as he spoke.
The Chief and I bowed at exactly the same time. Neither had arranged it.

Wah. With my own tsurugi, two years to learn cooperation. With another man who felt he had caused trouble, perfect coordination at once. Perhaps we had been practicing the wrong thing. Order us to attack and there might be confusion; tell us to stop apologising and down went both heads together. One final apology, Your Highness. For continuing the apologies.
ja:
ぱんぱん、と手を打って言う八幡宮別当親王。
　俺と署長は期せずして同時に、一揖ゆうした。

en: Prince Maidono"...Ah, but Kageaki."Kageaki"Sir."Prince Maidono"That guard back at the detention centre, say a word of thanks to him, haan? He did not create unnecessary uproar. Because of him we could keep this a small matter."Kageaki"...I see."
ja:
舞殿宮「……あぁ、けど、景明くん」景明「はっ」舞殿宮「拘置所あそこの看守さんには、一言挨拶しとくと
ええよ。
　あの人がむやみに騒がんでくれたお陰で、
ことを大きくしなくて済んだんやから」景明「……そうでしたか」

en:
I certainly owed him my thanks.
Really, how many people's hands did I keep occupied just by going on living?

Perhaps I had noticed rather late.
ja:
それは確かに、礼をせねばならなかった。
　まったく俺という男は、多くの人間の手を煩わせな
がら生きている。

　今更の自覚というものだろうが……。

en: Prince Maidono"Achha. Now the actual business we should come to."Kageaki"...?"Chief"You were not called here today for a scolding. There is another matter."Kageaki"Silver Star?"
ja:
舞殿宮「さて。
　んじゃ、本題に入ろか」景明「……？」署長「今日お前をここへ呼んだのは、叱責のため
ではないのだ。
　別に用件がある」景明「銀星号の件ですか」

en:
I had already reported Silver Star's announced attack on Hachiman Shrine. I had also urged that His Highness—and naturally the Chief—move elsewhere under some suitable pretext.

Was it about that?
ja:
あれが八幡宮来襲を予告した事は、既に伝えている。
　適当な口実を設けて親王には――当然署長にも――
遷居して頂くべきだと進言もしておいたが。

　その話か。

en: Chief"No. That is urgent also, but... today we need to discuss something else."Kageaki"Sir...?"Prince Maidono"Kageaki, understood, na? What we say now must not go outside this room..."Prince Maidono"Though with you, why am I even insisting."Chief"Still, Your Highness, given the nature of the matter... Kageaki."Kageaki"Sir. Whatever the matter may be, from me it will go no further. I promise."Prince Maidono"Haan, haan. A man like you says that, Kageaki, and one can genuinely breathe easily."
ja:
署長「いや、違う。
　そちらも火急だが……今日話したいことは
別だ」景明「は……」舞殿宮「ええね、景明くん？
　今からの話はよそで言うたらあかんえ……」舞殿宮「なんて、きみには念を押さなくても平気や
ろうけどな」署長「しかし宮殿下、事が事ですので。
　……景明」景明「はっ。
　如何様いかようなお話であれ、決して他言しないと
お約束致します」舞殿宮「うんうん。
　景明くんみたいな人がそう言うてくれると、
本当に安心できるわー」

en:
Hohoho, the Prince laughed. But tension was there inside the laughter too.

Something considerable, it seemed.
...Political, probably. Of course.

But for such a discussion, why take the trouble to call me?
ja:
ほほほと笑う親王。
　だが、その笑いの中にも緊張の成分がある。

　余程の話のようだ。
　……政治向き、であろうか。やはり。

　しかし、そんな話をわざわざ俺にするとは……？

en: Chief"You know the Sword-Offering Ceremony will soon be held at Hachiman Shrine?"Kageaki"Yes. I hear the preparations are proceeding without difficulty."Chief"...At that festival—"
ja:
署長「近々、八幡宮で奉刀参拝の儀式が行われる
のは知っているな」景明「はい。
　準備は滞りなく進んでいると聞いています」署長「……その祭礼の場で――」

en:
I greeted Makimura and went through the Chief's gate.
As always, that hardworking, capable housekeeper had the entrance spotless. Not even dirt was getting a chance to settle down.
ja:
牧村さんに挨拶して、署長宅の門をくぐる。
　常の事ながら、玄関は勤勉かつ優秀なる家宰かさいの手で
万全に清められていた。

en:
Into the room kept for me I went. The moment I sat down, I spread out the paper brought from Hachiman Shrine.

Then, in silence, I began thinking it over.
ja:
自分用にあてがわれている一室へ入り、腰を下ろす
や、俺はすぐ八幡宮から持参した紙を広げた。
　そうして、黙考を開始する。

en: Kageaki".............."Muramasa《So again for a while, we are staying in this house, na.》Kageaki"Muramasa... Haan. That is how it will be."
ja:
景明「………………」村正《またしばらくはこっちの家なのね》景明「村正か……
　ああ、そうなる」

en: Muramasa《His Highness has asked you to do something?》Kageaki"More or less."Muramasa《Hm.》Kageaki"............ How to explain this..."Muramasa《...No need to force an explanation. Circumstances I know or do not know, my work stays the same.》Muramasa《All the strength you need, I will keep ready. That much only.》Kageaki"I see... Still, better that I tell you."Kageaki"Your judgment also I want to borrow."Muramasa《Something difficult?》Kageaki"Quite."Muramasa《...What has he asked you to do?》Kageaki"Hm..."Kageaki"If I take the roundabout route to saying it—"Muramasa《Deliberately taking the long road, are we?》Kageaki"Make people say Tsurugaoka Hachiman Shrine is a place of ill fortune for the leader of the warrior houses. ...Twice it happens, and the reputation should be permanent."Muramasa《........................》Muramasa《...That means...》
ja:
村正《宮様に、何か仕事でも頼まれた？》景明「そんなところだ」村正《ふぅん》景明「…………。
　どう説明したものかな」村正《……無理に話してくれなくてもいいのよ。
　事情を知ろうと知るまいと、私のやること
は変わらない》村正《貴方が必要とする力をすべて用意する。
　それだけだから》景明「そうか……。
　だが、やはり話しておこう」景明「お前の知恵も借りたい」村正《悩むようなこと？》景明「なかなか」村正《……何を頼まれたの？》景明「うむ……」景明「回りくどく言えば」村正《わざわざ》景明「武家の棟梁にとって鶴岡八幡宮は鬼門の地、
そう語られるようにしろと。
　……二度・・となれば、声価も不朽だろうな」村正《……………………》村正《……それって》

en:
The Sword-Offering Ceremony: every year, the head of the Genji visited Hachiman Shrine to pray for success in war.

That ceremony we would attack.

Senior Third Rank, Grand Commander of the Six Guards,◆
Field Marshal, General of the Dragon Army of Rokuhara,◆
hegemon of Yamato,◆

Moriuji Ashikaga————we would kill him.
ja:
源氏長者げんじのちょうじゃが八幡宮に詣もうでて武運隆盛を祈る年例行事、
奉刀参拝。
　これを、襲い、

　正三位六衛大将領、◆
　元帥竜軍ろくはら大将、◆
　大和の覇者、◆
　足利護氏を――――討つ。

en: Kageaki"...And then."Kageaki"The shogunate will presumably be badly shaken. The Court supports it with imperial authority; in return, the Court gets more say. Through this new union of Court and shogunate, friction between government and people is reduced, rule becomes stable."Kageaki"And the openings for GHQ to interfere, one by one those close..."Prince Maidono"Haan, put shortly, that is the business."Chief"..."
ja:
景明「……そして」景明「大きく動揺するであろう幕府を朝廷権威で
補強してやり――反面、朝廷の発言力を増す。
　この公武合体による新体制で官民の対立を
緩和、治政に安定をもたらし」景明「ＧＨＱの介入する隙を無くしてゆく……」舞殿宮「まとめると、そういうことやねぇ」署長「……」

en:
Bold scheme, certainly. Hands practically empty, and these two would challenge an enormous military government and make it change its nature.

What chance did it have? That I could not say. But sit quietly and watch, and when the time suited the occupation forces, they would move against Rokuhara. Either succeed and put all Yamato under occupation,

or lose, leaving Rokuhara the sole ruler. One of those futures for the country. Savage fighting first, whichever future was chosen.

No, one more possibility was there. Neither side won; the war went on and on. That was the worst of the lot.

Aaiye, choose your future. Foreign masters, domestic masters, or endless war. Bloodshed included with every selection. Such a generous choice, and still the ungrateful people wanted something else.

If we refused those futures and wanted even a comparatively decent one, some action had to be taken. Call the Prince and the Chief's plan reckless, haan, reckless it was. Call it reasonable, and that also I could not deny.

Baithe raho, toh bhi bill aayega. Sit doing nothing, and the cost would come anyway. That was the difficulty. Refusing this particular recklessness did not mean the world would kindly leave us out of the next one.
ja:
雄略と呼ぶべきだろう。
　徒手空拳に等しい身で強大な軍事政権に挑み、その
体質を改めさせようというのであるから。

　成就する見込みの程は知れない。
　が、何もせず情況を見守れば、進駐軍は時節が到来
次第六波羅の排除に乗り出し――これを遂げて大和を
完全な占領下に置くか。

　それとも六波羅が勝利を得て大和唯一の支配権者と
なりおおせるか。
　この国はどちらかの結末を迎えるだろう。……苛烈
な交戦の後に。

　いや、可能性はもう一つある。
　両者の相克に決着がつかず、延々と戦争が続く――
という最悪の展開も起こり得る。

　喜ばしからざる運命を拒否し、比較的・・・にでも良好な
未来を手に入れたいと望むなら、やはり行動は必要だ。
　親王と署長、この二人の構想は、暴挙といえば暴挙
であったが至当といえば至当に違いなかった。

en: Prince Maidono"Well, what do you say?"
ja: 舞殿宮「どやろ」

en:
Only I could carry out the assassination. Moriuji Ashikaga was a warrior with more than enough battles behind him. Take one pistol and finish him—no such convenience. Only another warrior could go after his head.

Prince Haruhiro made no grand performance of bowing. Nor did he keep saying, for Yamato, for the people.

Everything had been explained. Now decide for yourself. Was that what he meant?
ja:
暗殺を実行できる者は、俺しかいない。
　足利護氏は戦歴余る武者。銃一丁で倒せるような男
ではない。同じ武者だけがその首級を狙える。

　春煕はるひろ親王は大仰に頭を下げたりしなかった。
　大和のため国民のためと、くどく言い重ねることも。

　説明は全てした。
　後は自分自身の判断で決めろ――そういうことか。

en:
This plan could save Yamato. Believing that required no great effort.

It would not be easy. There would be discrepancies, oversights, difficulties enough. Still, the Prince made one feel that he might manage it. And he had the Chief beside him.

More to the point, had I produced a better plan myself? I had not. On what grounds, then, was I entitled to dismiss his?

From no direction could I call the Prince wrong.

...Very well. Could I do it?

Attack Moriuji Ashikaga and take his life?
ja:
親王の企図こそ大和を救う。
　そう信じるのに、苦労は要らなかった。

　容易な計画ではなかろう。齟齬もあろうし見落とし
もあろう。きっと困難は多い――が、この人ならばと
思わせるものが、親王には確かにあった。
　署長という補佐役もいるのだ。

　何より俺の頭では親王のそれに優る計画を思いつか
ないのだから、価値を否定できる筋合いではなかった。

　親王が間違っているとは、どの角度からも言えない。

　……ならばできるか。
　足利護氏を襲い、命を奪えるか。

en: Kageaki(For Yamato.)
ja: 景明（大和のために）

en:
Save many good people.
Kill one bad man.

............That was

what I had already done. Again, again, so many times.

To stop Silver Star, that calamity, from spreading, I had cut down warrior after warrior carrying her Eggs.

Remove one evil. Leave many good.

Same thing only. Where was the difference?

Both were,◆

————nothing but self-righteousness.

For the country. For the people...
Take off that good-looking outer skin, and underneath the actual thing was visible.

I was not saying something foolish like the Prince secretly wanted personal profit. But choose to crush an opponent through violence, and whatever the motive, self-righteousness was what we were doing.

For the sake of my good,
call his good evil and bury it.

One sword, one killing: this is the Balance of Good and Evil.

My answer was settled.
ja:
多くの善き人々を救うために、
　一人の悪しき者を殺す。

　…………それは、

　俺が既に幾度も、幾度も、繰り返してきた所業だ。

　銀星号わざわいの拡大を阻止すべく、
〝卵〟に寄生された武者を幾人となく斬り殺した。

　一悪を断ち多善を残す。

　まるで同じだ。
　何処にも違いなど無い。

　どちらも、◆

　――――独善に過ぎない。

　国のため。人のため……
　そんな聞こえの良い外面かわを一枚剥けば、そこに真実
の姿が覗く。

　親王の動機が実は私利私欲だとか、間の抜けた事を
言うつもりはない。
　しかし、対立者を暴力で挫くという道を選ぶのなら、
動機がどうあれそれはやはり独善の行いなのだ。

　我の善のため、
　彼の善を悪と称して葬る。

　一剣一殺是善悪相殺いっけんいっさつこれぜんあくそうさい。

　俺の返答は定まった。

en: Kageaki"I will go. On the day of the Sword-Offering Ceremony, I will stand before Moriuji Ashikaga."Prince Maidono"...You will do it?"
ja:
景明「行きましょう。
　奉刀参拝の日、足利護氏の前へ」舞殿宮「……やってくれるんか？」

en:
The Prince sounded surprised, rather than anything else. The Chief's face had not changed, but inside he seemed to be feeling the same.

I shook my head.
ja:
むしろ意外そうな、親王の声だった。
　顔色こそ変えていないが、脇の署長も内心は同じと
見える。

　俺はかぶりを振った。

en: Kageaki"That promise, I cannot give you yet."Chief"...What?"Kageaki"The man himself I will meet first. Then I will decide. Cut him down, or not."Kageaki"Is Moriuji Ashikaga a man who must be killed? I would see him with these eyes... and then decide."Prince Maidono"............"Chief"............"Kageaki"If that creates more difficulty for you, of course I will not insist. Everything heard here I will forget, and leave at once."Kageaki"Would that—"Prince Maidono"That is fine."Chief"Your Highness..."Prince Maidono"When I disclosed the plan, I had already decided to trust Kageaki. Having come that far, shall we start trusting him by halves?"Prince Maidono"Your judgment I trust, Kageaki. I will leave it to you."Kageaki"...I am deeply obliged to Your Highness."Prince Maidono"If you think he should not be killed, theek hai. Afterwards tell us what you thought, haan?"Kageaki"Yes, Your Highness."
ja:
景明「今はお約束致しかねます」署長「……何？」景明「本人と見まみえてから決します。
　斬るか、斬らぬか」景明「足利護氏は殺さねばならない男なのか。
　この目で、見て……決めたく思います」舞殿宮「…………」署長「…………」景明「却って御迷惑とあれば無論、強いて望みは
致しません。
　ここで聞いた事はすべて忘れ、直ちに立ち
去りましょう」景明「如何か――」舞殿宮「ええよ」署長「宮殿下……」舞殿宮「計画を打ち明ける段階で、景明くんを信頼
するちゅうことは決めてたんや。
　ならとことん信じ切ろうやないか」舞殿宮「景明くんの判断を信じて、任せるわ」景明「……御高配痛み入ります」舞殿宮「斬ったらあかん、思うたらそれでええ。
　その時は、後で景明くんの考えをわしらに
聞かせてくれな」景明「はっ」

en:
...More trust than I deserved he was giving me. Grateful I was. Heavy on both shoulders it was also.

And with a blade I would have to repay this trust.
ja:
……過分なまでの信頼を抱かれている。
　有難くも、両肩に重かった。

　しかも俺は、この信頼に刃で応えなくてはならない。

en: Kageaki"There is one more matter I must make clear beforehand."Prince Maidono"Hm?"Kageaki"You will know the law of my tsurugi... Muramasa."
ja:
景明「もう一つ、お断りしておかねばならぬ事が
あります」舞殿宮「うん？」景明「我が劒冑……
　村正の掟ルールはご存知であられる筈」

en: Kill an enemy, and kill a friend.
ja: 敵を斬らば友も斬らん。

en: Chief"............"Kageaki"Your Highness, Prince Maidono. If I should kill Moriuji Ashikaga..."Kageaki"I will have to take your life also."
ja:
署長「…………」景明「舞殿宮殿下。
　もしも自分が、足利護氏を斬った暁には」景明「貴方の御命をも頂かねばなりません」

en:
Muramasa's law. My law.
The law of the Balance of Good and Evil.
ja:
それが村正おれの掟。
　善悪相殺の律法。

en: Kageaki"Is that acceptable?"
ja: 景明「宜しいか」

en: Prince Maidono"Understood."Kageaki"..."Prince Maidono"This idiot exchanged for the Grand Commander, is it? ...Arre, that is a handsome profit."Prince Maidono"Replacements for me are available everywhere."Kageaki"Your Highness..."
ja:
舞殿宮「承知したえ」景明「……」舞殿宮「このアホが大将領と差し違えるわけやな。
　……大儲けやないか」舞殿宮「わしの代わりなら、何処にでもおるわ」景明「宮殿下……」

en:
No false note I could hear.

...Perhaps my ears alone were being fooled. Perhaps even now, inside, the Prince was deciding to dispose of me once my work was done.

Which was the truth?

Whichever it was, Prince Haruhiro of Maidono deserved respect from the bottom of my heart.
ja:
嘘の響きは聞き取れなかった。
　……それはもしかすると、俺の耳が騙されただけで、
親王はいま内心で用が済んだら俺を始末しようと決意
しているのかもしれない。

　どちらが真実か。

　どちらであっても、舞殿宮春煕親王という人物は、
心底からの敬意を払うに値する。

en: Chief"Kageaki."Kageaki"Yes."
ja: 署長「景明」景明「はい」

en:
At that stern voice, I turned my eyes.

I had expected him to speak.
And I had expected what he would say.
ja:
厳しい声に視線を動かす。

　この人が口を開くことは予測していた。
　何を言うのかも。

en: Chief"When that time comes, cut me down."Prince Maidono"Kikuchi."Chief"Understood?"
ja: 署長「その時は私を斬れ」舞殿宮「菊池」署長「いいな」

en:
The Chief did not turn toward the screen. Eyes fixed on me alone, he spoke with a voice heavy as stone.

That will was not going to move.

—Balance of Good and Evil.

If I killed Moriuji Ashikaga, this man also I would have to kill.
ja:
御簾の方を振り返らず、俺だけを見据えて、署長は
重石おもしのような声で告げた。
　不動の意思がそこにあった。

　――善悪相殺。

　足利護氏を斬るなら、この人も斬らねばならない。

en: Kageaki"Chief..."
ja: 景明「署長……」

en: Kageaki"Akitaka sir."
ja: 景明「明堯様」

en:
After how many years, I called my adoptive father by his name.

No answer came.

...I could not kill him.
How could I kill him?

This man, to whom I owed so much. With my own hands, how?
ja:
何年ぶりにか、養父ちちの名を呼ぶ。
　応えはなかった。

　……殺せない。
　殺せるわけがない。

　大恩あるこの人を、どうして我が手で斬れよう。

en: Kageaki(But.)
ja: 景明（だが）

en:
And while thinking all this, Moriuji Ashikaga I could kill without objection?

Both were human.
Ordinary people, both. Good and evil in them, achievements and sins.

From the place where I stood, the Chief's good was what I saw most. Moriuji's evil was what I saw most. That much only. Stand elsewhere, and the view would be different.

Still, call one evil and cut him down; call the other good and let him live.

—Self-righteousness.

Muramasa had said it. Self-righteousness was the root of conflict. It justified killing, kept the killing going without end.

Haan.
That was exactly right.
ja:
そう思う一方、足利護氏は構わず斬れるのか。

　同じ人間である。
　善あり悪あり功あり罪ある、同じ只人ただびとである。

　単に俺の立つ位置からは署長の善ばかりが、護氏の
悪ばかりが目立つというだけに過ぎない。
　異なる位置に立つ者には、異なる見方があるだろう。

　なのに一方のみ悪として斬り、もう一方を善として
生かすのは、

　――独善である。

　村正は言った。
　独善こそ争いの根源。殺し合いを正当化し、際限も
なく続けさせる元凶――と。

　そう。
　それは、その通りなのだ。

en: Chief"Kageaki."Kageaki"Understood."Chief"..."Kageaki"If I kill the Grand Commander, then... you also."
ja:
署長「景明」景明「諒解しました」署長「……」景明「大将領を斬った、その時は……
　貴方を」

en:
I would kill him.

Kill this adoptive father.

I would have to.

...And if I could not,
then I must not kill Moriuji Ashikaga either.
ja:
斬る。

　この養父を斬る。

　斬らねばならぬ。

　……斬れぬのなら、
　足利護氏もまた、斬ってはならないのだ。

en: Kageaki"That is the situation."Muramasa《Actually kill him or not, that is separate. Preparation you will make?》Kageaki"Haan. That is what it comes to."
ja:
景明「という次第だ」村正《……本当に斬るかどうかはともかく。
　その用意はする、っていうこと？》景明「そうなる」

en:
A fine, clear decision I had made. Except that it settled very little. Perhaps a flat refusal would have been better.

But—
ja:
我が決定ながら、はっきりせぬ話だ。
　きっぱり断った方が良かったのかもしれない。

　が――

en: Muramasa《............》Kageaki"Something on your mind?"
ja: 村正《…………》景明「どうかしたか」

en:
A question was sitting inside the spider's silence, it seemed. I gave her an opening.

A few seconds of hesitation, then the metal-echo reached me.
ja:
蜘蛛の沈黙は、物問いたげだった。
　水を向けてみる。

　躊躇うような間を数秒はさんで、金打声が伝わって
きた。

en: Muramasa《...Mido. The reason you could not refuse a request like that...》Muramasa《Was it because, the other day... I...》Kageaki"No."Muramasa《...》Kageaki"The prison break has nothing to do with it. More importantly... Silver Star's announcement."
ja:
村正《……ね、御堂。
　そんな話を断れなかったのは》村正《この間の……
　私の》景明「いや」村正《……》景明「脱獄の件は無関係だ。
　それよりも……銀星号の予告が」

en: ————I am going to Hachiman Shrine.
ja: ――――おれは八幡宮へゆく。

en: Kageaki"You heard it also."Muramasa《Yes...》Kageaki"The Sword-Offering Ceremony, with shogunate soldiers packed all around it—I cannot imagine her choosing that... Still, better to be ready."Kageaki"If we stay at Hachiman Shrine, anything happens and we can respond quickly. Half-accepting His Highness's request was, frankly speaking, something I did along the way."
ja:
景明「お前も聞いていただろう」村正《ええ……》景明「まさか周囲が幕兵で固められる奉刀参拝を
狙って現れるとは思えないが……
　念のためだ」景明「八幡宮に詰めていれば、万一の時に素早く
対応できる。
　宮殿下の依頼を半端に受けたのは、言って
しまえばそのついで・・・だ」

en:
Sneaking into such heavy security was already the height of danger. Put an assassination on top, and how much higher could the danger go?

...Very approximate arithmetic I was doing. No numbers had agreed to participate.

Jaan toh ek hi hai. One life only. Surely I could not lose it twice, so the second danger was practically free. By this reasoning, once a man was falling off a cliff, he might as well set himself on fire. Full benefit of the journey. I would prefer not to explain this calculation to anybody who understood counting.
ja:
厳戒警備の中へ潜り込む時点で危険は極まっている。
　そのうえ暗殺の狙いが加わっても、これ以上危うく
はなりようがない。

　……計算と呼ぶには乱暴な、丼勘定だが。

en: Muramasa《............》Kageaki"Anyway. Doing it or not doing it is a separate matter. A plan we need."Kageaki"That day, how to enter Hachiman Shrine, how to get near the Marshal... Lend me your judgment. My own is not sufficient for every part."Muramasa《...Y-yes.》
ja:
村正《…………》景明「ともかく。
　やるやらぬは置いて、策は立てておく必要
がある」景明「当日、八幡宮にどう潜り込み、元帥にどう
近付くか……。
　知恵を貸せ。俺の思案には余る部分もある」村正《……う、うん》

en:
I turned the paper toward Muramasa. It was hardly as though she could not see it otherwise, but down from the ceiling the iron spider came, closer to it.

No helpful title was written on the paper. Still, one look should have been enough.
ja:
広げていた紙を、村正の方へ向ける。
　そうしなくては見えないということもあるまいが、
鉄の蜘蛛は天井から降りて近寄ってきた。

　その紙に、親切な表題などはない。
　しかし、それが何であるかは一目で知れた筈だ。

en: Muramasa《Hachiman Shrine's map?》Kageaki"Yes. Drawn by His Highness himself."Muramasa《...Something is wrong here, no?》
ja:
村正《八幡宮の地図？》景明「ああ。
　宮殿下の直筆だ」村正《……なんか、おかしくない？》

en:
Probably she was not criticising Prince Maidono's drawing. An amateur's plan, certainly, but reasonably accurate.

The public map of the grounds and this one differed in several major places. That was what Muramasa meant. His Highness's artistic dignity could remain where it was.
ja:
そう言うのは、舞殿宮の作画能力に対する疑問では
ないだろう。
　地図は素人図面には違いないが、そこそこの正確さ
で描かれている。

　その地図と一般に公開されている境内図とでは幾つ
か大きく異なる部分があり、村正が指摘しているのは
そちらだった。

en: Muramasa《This is the main sanctuary, yes?》Kageaki"Yes."
ja: 村正《これは本殿よね？》景明「そうだ」

en:
The shrine at the top of the great stairway.
It was called the Upper Shrine.
ja:
大階段を登った上にある社。
　上宮じょうぐうと呼ばれる。

en: Muramasa《And behind it... what is this?》Kageaki"A hidden rear approach, they tell me. Around it goes, then underground."Muramasa《...And the hall at the end?》Kageaki"The Lower Shrine."Muramasa《The Lower Shrine is over here, isn't it?》Kageaki"That is Wakamiya, the Young Shrine. Lower Shrine, they call that also, but apparently this one is what the name really means."
ja:
村正《その奥にある……これは何？》景明「隠された裏参道だそうだ。
　ぐるりと回って、地下・・へ向かう」村正《……その先の広間は？》景明「下宮げぐうだ」村正《下宮はこっちでしょう？》景明「それは若宮わかみや。
　若宮も下宮と呼ばれるが、本当はこちらを
指すらしい」

en:
I pointed at the underground space directly beneath the Upper Shrine. Such a place even existed, I myself had only just been told.

It opened only for certain ceremonies and was kept secret from the public, according to what I had heard.
ja:
上宮の真下の、地下空間・・・・を指差して言う。
　そんなものが存在するなどと、俺もつい先刻聞いて
知ったばかりだ。

　限られた祭事の折にしか開かれない施設で、公には
秘されている、との話であった。

en: Kageaki"The procedure for the Sword-Offering Ceremony... The actual worship is by the Grand Commander and a little over ten close attendants only."Kageaki"From Fudaraku to Hachiman Shrine, a considerable force comes with them. But no part in the rites. Infantry outside the grounds, armoured warriors inside and in the sky, on guard."Muramasa《...》Kageaki"The Grand Commander and his attendants proceed to the Upper Shrine. There they offer the sword and conduct the rite."Kageaki"Up to this point, there is no opening for an attack."Muramasa《So behind the great ginkgo we cannot simply hide and be done, na.》Kageaki"Kugyou managed it because Lord Sanetomo and his attendants were unarmed. Moriuji's attendants, at least half are said to be armoured warriors."
ja:
景明「奉刀参拝の手順だが……
　参拝そのものは、大将領と十人余りの側近
だけで行われる」景明「普陀楽から八幡宮までは相当数の兵を引き
連れて来るが、彼らは祭祀に関与しない。
　徒士かち衆は敷地の外、武者衆は境内や上空で
警備につく」村正《……》景明「大将領と側近は上宮へ向かう。
　そこで太刀を奉納、祭儀を執り行う」景明「ここまで襲撃の隙はない」村正《大銀杏の陰に隠れてってわけにはいかない
のね》景明「実朝公の時は本人も随員も非武装であった
から、公暁はそれで成功したがな。
　護氏が連れる側近のうち少なくとも半数は
武者だと云う」

en:
Even a surprise attack they would probably stop. While we were dealing with them, the surrounding guards would gather.

Surrounded. Finished. No further planning necessary.
ja:
不意を襲っても彼らに防がれるだろう。
　そうこうする間に周辺から警備の者が集まってきて、
取り囲まれ、終わりだ。

en: Kageaki"But after that, Moriuji leaves his attendants and goes underground."Muramasa《...》Kageaki"To offer another sword at the secret Lower Shrine. Only a few priests conducting the rite may accompany him."Muramasa《No guards? ...Arre, such convenience they are providing.》Kageaki"An old custom, and apparently it cannot be changed."
ja:
景明「しかし、この後。
　護氏は供奉の者と別れ、地下へ向かう」村正《……》景明「秘密の下宮にも太刀を奉納するためだ。
　同行を許されるのは、祭祀を行う神官数名
だけ」村正《護衛はなし？
　……また随分と、おあつらえ向きね》景明「これが古くからの慣例で、変更はできない
らしい」

en:
Insist hard enough and perhaps he could change it. But coward, they would call him. Lose his own people's confidence, and one of the Four Kubo might take his position.

That future, I could not see Rokuhara's Marshal accepting.
ja:
達たって望めば変えられなくもないのだろうが、それで
は臆病者の謗そしりを受ける。
　身内の信望を失い、四公方の誰かに地位を奪われる
ような事態になりかねない。

　六波羅元帥がそんな運命を良しとするとは考えられ
なかった。

en: Kageaki"If there is an opportunity to assassinate him, it is during this visit to the Lower Shrine alone."Muramasa《It would be, yes...》Kageaki"The difficulty is—"
ja:
景明「暗殺の機会があるとすれば、この下宮参拝
の時だけだ」村正《でしょうね……》景明「問題は」

en:
The actual plan from there onward.

Hide in the Lower Shrine beforehand? Difficult. Before the ceremony, the whole precinct would be searched, every possible danger thoroughly rooted out. Search completed, security cordon in place, and after that no entry.

Forcing our way in during the ceremony was not even worth discussing.
ja:
ここから先の具体案。

　事前に下宮へ潜んで待つのは難しい。
　参拝儀式に先立って境内全域の検査が行われ、危険
要素はこの段階で徹底的に洗い出される。それが完了
すれば警備網が敷かれ、以後の潜入は不可能となる。

　儀式中の強行突入などは論外だ。

en: Kageaki"...Only one way left, then."Muramasa《Disguise yourself as a priest and go down with the Grand Commander?》Kageaki"Yes."
ja:
景明「……やはり手は一つか」村正《神官になりすまして、大将領と一緒に下宮
へ降りる？》景明「ああ」

en:
Then, if I carried out the assassination, leave Hachiman Shrine at once. No clever trick needed there; break out by force, in armoured flight.

A cordon waiting for enemies outside would probably not respond quickly to a surprise from inside. The danger of being caught should be very low.
ja:
そして暗殺を遂げた場合には、すぐさま八幡宮から
脱出。これに手管は要らず、騎航での強行突破で良い。
　外からの敵襲に備えた警備網は内からの奇襲に即応
しかねるだろう。捕まる危険はごく低い筈だった。

en: Muramasa《Haan... No difficulty seems to be there.》Muramasa《Then what is troubling you?》Kageaki"What to do with you."
ja:
村正《そうね。
　……問題はなさそうだけど》村正《何を悩んでるの？》景明「お前をどうするかだ」

en:
Moriuji was an armoured warrior. If I challenged him, there would be no contest without my tsurugi.

The trouble being...
ja:
護氏は武者。
　もしも挑むことになるなら、劒冑がなくては勝負に
ならない。

　のだが……

en: Kageaki"How to bring you in, that I cannot think."Muramasa《...I alone go and hide beforehand, that will not work?》Kageaki"Armoured warriors take part in the search, I am told. Hide yourself as well as you like, but their ears—the signal sensors—and their skin—the heat sensors—those too you are unlikely to fool."Muramasa《............And trying to sneak in after the search... comes to the same thing?》Kageaki"The guards will certainly include armoured warriors..."Muramasa《Among the ritual implements, perhaps.》Kageaki"Unlikely. Mirrors, jewels, and in the middle one spider statue. Normally a person notices. Too bizarre. Culturally impossible."Muramasa《...For about five hundred years, I was sitting in your house as a sacred object. Beside the mirrors and jewels only.》Kageaki"............¦That is true."
ja:
景明「持ち込む方法が思いつかん」村正《……私だけ、あらかじめ潜伏しておくって
のは駄目なの？》景明「事前検査には武者も加わるそうだ。
　如何にお前が隠形に優れていても、武者の
信号探査みみや熱源探査はだまで騙すのは無理だろう」村正《…………。
　検査が済んだ後で潜り込もうとしても……
同じことよね？》景明「警備隊に武者がいない筈はないからな……」村正《祭具の中に紛れ込むとか》景明「無理だろう。
　鏡や玉と一緒に蜘蛛の彫像があったら普通
気付く。奇天烈過ぎる。文化的に有り得ん」村正《……私、貴方の家で五百年ばかり、鏡や玉
と一緒に御神体やってたんですけど》景明「…………¦

そうだったな」

en:
Looking back, ours had been an excessively bizarre form of worship.

And my thinking was going round the same place again. For me alone, dress as a priest and enter. Bring Muramasa also, and one more idea was required. That idea was not reporting for duty.

Instead of a priest, impersonate an armoured guard...◆

No use. A guard abandons his assigned post and heads for the Lower Shrine, and immediately the alarm goes up.

Becoming one was also far harder than becoming a priest. Even in the great army called Rokuhara's Ten Lakh Riders, armoured warriors were a tiny privileged class. No anonymous fellows there. One disappears, somebody else appears in his place, and it will be noticed.

With careful preparation, perhaps there was a chance.
...Time for all that was what we did not have.
ja:
振り返れば、奇天烈に過ぎる祭祀であった。

　つまるところ、考えはここで渦を巻く。
　俺一人の潜入なら神官を装えば済む話だが、村正を
連れてとなるともう一工夫が要る――しかし良い案が
浮かばない。

　いっそ神官ではなく警備の武者になりすまして……◆

　無駄か。警備兵が任務を放り出して下宮へ向かった
りすれば、その時点で騒ぎになる。

　そもそもなりかわる困難が神官の比ではない。
　六波羅百万騎と称される大軍団の中でも武者はごく
限られた特権階級、『無名の者』などいない。誰かが
消え、代わりに別の者が増えていれば、必ず露見する。

　入念な準備の上で潜入するなら、見込みもあろうが。
　……そんな事をしている時間は無い。

en: Muramasa《............》Kageaki"There seems to be no way. Shall we abandon the assassination?"Kageaki"At least I will go in alone. That much should not be particularly difficult."Muramasa《Dangerous, na. They discover you, then what? And if you will not attack him, what work are you sneaking in to do?》Kageaki"Entirely correct. But a promise I have made. Nothing at all I do, and where is my obligation to His Highness?"Muramasa《Wait. I also pretend to be a priest, then the requirement is satisfied, no?》Kageaki"Impossible proposals do not help."
ja:
村正《…………》景明「どうも手立ては無さそうだ。
　暗殺は断念するか」景明「俺が単身で潜入するだけしよう。
　それならさして難しいことはない」村正《危険よ。ばれた時どうするの。
　それに、襲う気もないのに潜り込んだって
意味がないじゃない》景明「その通りだが、約束した手前、何もせずで
は宮殿下に対して義理が立たん」村正《待って。
　要は、私も神官のふりをすればいいわけよ
ね？》景明「無茶を言うな」

en: A spider as a sacred object was already difficult enough. Now the spider would be conducting the service also?
ja: 蜘蛛の御神体以上に、蜘蛛の神官は有り得ない。

en: Muramasa《Mido, did you not see it that time?》Kageaki"See what?"Muramasa《............Yes...》Muramasa《Maa said one more step would do it. ...Shall I try?》Kageaki"...?"
ja:
村正《御堂はあの時、見なかったの？》景明「何をだ」村正《…………。
　そうね……》村正《母様は、一歩進めれば・・・・・・できると言っていた。
　……試してみましょうか》景明「……？」

en: Kageaki"Muramasa?"Muramasa《For now, watch. ...That time, Maa's technique was...》Muramasa《Probably...》
ja:
景明「村正？」村正《今は見ていて。
　……あの時の……母様の術式は……》村正《おそらく……》

en: Kageaki"What are you—"Muramasa《My old form, I will try returning to it.》Kageaki"...Your old form!?"
ja: 景明「何を――」村正《昔の姿に戻ってみる》景明「……昔の・・!?」

en:
What did she mean by that?
Surely not.
ja:
それはどういう意味だ。
　まさか。

en: Muramasa《With this—》
ja: 村正《これで――》

en: Kageaki"..................................................."Muramasa《—I...》Muramasa《I did it.》Muramasa《It actually happened...》Kageaki"...Muramasa..."Kageaki"Y-you... is that you...?"Muramasa《...Haan, Mido. Me only.》Muramasa《Me, when I was alive as an Emishi, a human!》
ja:
景明「………………………………………………」村正《――で》村正《できた》村正《できちゃった……》景明「……村正……」景明「お――お前なのか……」村正《……ええ。御堂。
　私よ》村正《蝦夷ひととして生きていた頃の私よ！》

en: Moriuji"...Then, Your Highness, Prince Maidono. For the Sword-Offering Ceremony I shall now proceed to Hachiman Shrine."Moriuji"Fudaraku in my absence, and the reception of Lord Kujou, envoy for the imperial offerings—these matters I am leaving in Your Highness's most capable hands."Prince Maidono"Ah, haan. Your side also, you look after it properly, Rikufu."Moriuji"Indeed. I shall pray for a hundred years of prosperity for the nation."Prince Maidono"Very good, very good. Such prayers we can always use."Moriuji"At the risk of immodesty, this Rikufu considers himself the main pillar of our divine land of Yamato. Whatever service the nation requires, neglecting it is not in my nature. A pillar cannot take leave from holding up the roof."Prince Maidono"...Haan, I know. Your wholehearted loyalty, Rikufu, very well I know it."Moriuji"Your words honour me."Moriuji"Then one such duty I shall discharge immediately, with Your Highness's presence most respectfully borrowed for the purpose. Unpleasant business, yes. But duty does not consult our pleasure."Prince Maidono"...Kya? What business?"Moriuji"Raichou."Raichou"Yes, Father."
ja:
護氏「……然らば、舞殿宮殿下。
　これより太刀奉納の儀のため八幡宮へ赴き
ますゆえ」護氏「普陀楽の留守と奉幣使九条殿の饗応、何卒
宜しくお頼み申します」舞殿宮「あぁ、うん。
　そっちも宜しゅうにな、六府りくふ」護氏「はっ。
　国家百年の繁栄を祈願して参りましょう」舞殿宮「そらええことやなァ」護氏「憚りながらこの六府、神州大和の大黒柱を
自ら任じてござれば……
　国家のためのいかなる務めであろうと怠る
つもりは毛頭ございませぬ」舞殿宮「……あぁ、ようわかってる。
　六府の赤心忠義は、ようくわかってますえ」護氏「畏れ入ります」護氏「されば早速、これより宮殿下の御前を拝借
して、我が務めの一つを果たしましょうぞ。
　楽しからぬ仕儀なれど、是非もなし」舞殿宮「……なんやて？」護氏「雷蝶」雷蝶「はい、お父様」

en: Aide Kaneko"Y... Your Highness..."Prince Maidono"Kaneko!? You, here—how...?"Prince Maidono"What is the meaning of this, Rikufu!"Moriuji"...Quite so. Naturally, Your Highness will be knowing nothing about this."Moriuji"Serving at Your Highness's very elbow, this namak-haram went and joined the remnants of that rebel Okabe. And the bloody bastard's ambition did not stop there. Into his treason he intended to drag Your Highness also!"Prince Maidono"————"Aide Kaneko"..."Moriuji"For Your Highness, this must be a thunderbolt out of a clear sky. Unfortunately, the material evidence is already in our hands. For doubt there is no accommodation left—"Moriuji"Your distress, Your Highness, I can fully appreciate."Prince Maidono"..."Raichou"Arre? His Highness Prince Maidono is not looking very surprised, na."Raichou"Already you were knowing, perhaps...? Just a possibility I am asking about."Prince Maidono"N-no..."Moriuji"Nonsense you are talking, Raichou. A personage such as His Highness, knowingly keeping a traitor at his side? Impossible. His standing does not permit the possibility."Moriuji"...Is that not so, Your Highness?"Prince Maidono"............"Raichou"Uf... fufufu..."Aide Kaneko"Nothing to do with His Highness! He knows nothing! Whether he wished to overthrow the shogunate, that I was trying to find out. Nothing I achieved, and now look at my condition...!"Aide Kaneko"Bitter thing to admit, but Prince Maidono is exactly the useless ornament everyone says! Innocent he is! Take my head and finish it—"Raichou"Bas. Your mouth you will close, please."
ja:
側近金子「み……宮殿下……」舞殿宮「金子!?
　おまさんがどうしてここに……」舞殿宮「これはどういうことや、六府！」護氏「……左様……。
　宮殿下は何もご存知ありますまい」護氏「この者、宮殿下のお側近くに仕える用人で
ありながら、逆賊岡部の残党どもと結び……
　あろうことか、宮殿下を謀反の企みに引き
入れようとまで図っていた不逞の輩！」舞殿宮「――――」側近金子「……」護氏「宮殿下には晴天の霹靂でございましょう。
　しかし、これは既に物証もあがり、事実を
疑う余地は無し――」護氏「ご心中、お察し申し上げます」舞殿宮「……」雷蝶「あらぁ？
　舞殿宮殿下、あまり驚いておられませんの
ねぇ」雷蝶「もしかして、とっくにご存知でいらっしゃ
った……とか？」舞殿宮「い、いや……」護氏「戯けたことを申すな、雷蝶。
　舞殿宮殿下ともあろう御方が、逆賊をそれ
と承知で側へ置いておかれる筈がない」護氏「……左様でございますな？
　宮殿下」舞殿宮「…………」雷蝶「ウフ、フフフッ……」側近金子「宮殿下は無関係だ！　何もご存知ない！
　私は宮殿下に倒幕のご意思がお有りか否か
探っていたが、何の成果もなく、このような
始末となった……！」側近金子「無念だが、舞殿宮殿下は風聞通りの昼行灯、
潔白であられる！
　さっさと私の首を――」雷蝶「お黙りなさいな」

en: Aide Kaneko"Gah!"Prince Maidono"Kaneko!"Moriuji"Your Highness. What is your answer?"Moriuji"If this man's true character Your Highness already knew... then why such a fellow was being kept so close, that explanation I would be obliged to request."Moriuji"Yamato's protection is my responsibility, after all. An answer I must have."Prince Maidono"..."Moriuji"If nothing you knew... then very simply the matter can end. Which is it, Your Highness?"Prince Maidono"..."Prince Maidono"I didn't know."Moriuji"..."Raichou"..."Prince Maidono"Nothing I knew. Kaneko, such a scoundrel he was..."Prince Maidono"Other people also you must drag into your mess, is it? Arre, my heart is not built for this."Aide Kaneko"...Heh..."Moriuji"...Then how this man is disposed of, Your Highness is content to leave entirely in our hands?"Prince Maidono"Haan... no objection. Whatever you like, do."Moriuji"Very good. Raichou, take him away."Raichou"Yes."
ja:
側近金子「ぐぁっっ」舞殿宮「金子！」護氏「宮殿下。如何に」護氏「もしも、宮殿下がこの者の本性をご存知で
あられたのなら……
　かような者をどうして側へ留め置かれたの
か、仔細をお尋ねせぬわけには参りませぬ」護氏「この護氏には大和を守る責務がありまする
ゆえ」舞殿宮「……」護氏「何もご存じなかったのなら……話は簡単に
済みましょうな。
　して、如何に」舞殿宮「……」舞殿宮「知らんえ」護氏「……」雷蝶「……」舞殿宮「なんも知らんかったわ、わし。
　金子がそんな悪党やったなんて……」舞殿宮「人を巻き込まんといてくれんかなぁ。
　心臓に悪いったらないわ」側近金子「……フフ……」護氏「……では、宮殿下。
　この者の処分は当方に一任して頂いて構い
ませぬな」舞殿宮「あぁ、……かまへん。
　どうとでもしてや」護氏「承りました。
　雷蝶、連れてゆけ」雷蝶「はい」

en: Moriuji"...For traitors, this is always the destination. To see justice properly maintained in the world—what satisfaction it gives."Prince Maidono"...Haan."Moriuji"Those Okabe leftovers who failed even to die, soon we shall gather the whole lot and send them after him. Please wait without anxiety. This unfinished business we shall finish."Prince Maidono"..."Moriuji"That Your Highness had no part in such idiotic treason, this Rikufu is sincerely relieved to learn. The order of things you understand so well. Naturally, not for a moment was I entertaining suspicion—"Moriuji"Going forward also, please keep yourself on the correct side of things."Prince Maidono"I know, I know..."Moriuji"Thanks to Your Highness, with a peaceful mind I can now conduct the Sword-Offering Ceremony. Then... I take my leave."Prince Maidono"..."Moriuji"Your Highness."Prince Maidono"What is it?"Moriuji"The colour of the sala flowers declares that the prosperous must decline. Even the age of the arrogant is no more than a dream on a spring night."Moriuji"—That you may keep repeating to yourself, and wait with patience. Rokuhara is not narrow-minded. Your dreams you may enjoy inside your own head. So long as they remain inside, from our side there is no objection."Prince Maidono"............"Moriuji"Kukukuku... Kahahahahahahahaha!"
ja:
護氏「……逆賊の末路は常にあのようなもの。
　世の正義が守られてあるは喜ばしきことに
ございます」舞殿宮「……そやな」護氏「岡部の死に損ねも近々一網打尽に捕らまえ、
あやつめの後を追わせましょう。
　どうか安んじてお待ちあれ」舞殿宮「……」護氏「この六府、宮殿下が愚劣なる大逆の企てに
関わりなしと知り、心より安堵致しました。
　宮殿下は物の道理を良くわきまえた御方、
元より疑ってなどおりませなんだが――」護氏「どうか今後とも、御身を正しく保たれます
よう」舞殿宮「わかってるよ……」護氏「お陰をもちまして、心置きなく奉刀の儀を
執り行えまする。
　では……これにて」舞殿宮「……」護氏「宮殿下」舞殿宮「何やね」護氏「沙羅双樹の花の色は、盛者必衰の理を表す。
　驕り高ぶる者の世も、春の夜の夢に等しい」護氏「――とでも念じて、気長に待たれるが宜し
かろうと存ずる。
　六波羅は狭量にあらず、頭の中で夢を楽し
まれている分には咎め立ても致しませぬゆえ」舞殿宮「…………」護氏「クククク……
　カハハハハハハハハハハハッ!!」

en: Prince Maidono"..."Prince Maidono"...Ngh..."
ja: 舞殿宮「……」舞殿宮「……ッ……」

en: Chief"Moriuji has left Fudaraku. He will be here shortly."Kageaki"Understood."Chief"Are you ready?"Kageaki"To take a real priest's place, everything is arranged. Two minutes also it will not take."Chief"Good. ...You still intend to strike at the Lower Shrine?"Kageaki"Yes."Chief"The Grand Commander's men may already be hiding there. Not even a remote chance of that? This one thing is troubling me."Kageaki"I have checked it repeatedly. Muramasa is making the final check now—"
ja:
署長「護氏は普陀楽を出た。
　もうじきここへ着く」景明「諒解」署長「用意はいいのか？」景明「本物の神官と入れ替わる手筈は万端整って
います。
　実行に二分と掛かりません」署長「そうか。
　……狙うのはやはり下宮げぐうだな？」景明「はい」署長「大将領の手の者が既に潜んでいる、などと
いうことは万一にもないのか……それだけが
懸念だ」景明「その点は再三確かめました。
　今、村正が最後の確認を――」

en: Muramasa"All clear, Mido. Nobody is there in the Lower Shrine."Muramasa"Anywhere you look, hiding there would be difficult only. I don't think we can be mistaken."Chief"............"Kageaki"............"Chief"Kageaki."Kageaki"Yes."Chief"What is the meaning of this?"Kageaki"That is what I am also trying to discover, sir."Chief"Arre, why are you speaking like some passing bystander? It is your matter..."Kageaki"My capacity for bewilderment has already been exceeded, Chief. Please make some allowance."Chief"...I see."Muramasa"Kya?"Kageaki"............"Chief"............"Muramasa"...?"
ja:
村正「大丈夫よ、御堂。
　下宮には誰もいない」村正「どう見ても隠れ潜むには不都合な場所だし、
間違いはないでしょう」署長「…………」景明「…………」署長「景明」景明「はい」署長「どういう事だ」景明「どういう事なのでしょうか」署長「他人事のように言ってどうする……」景明「自分も途方もなく戸惑っているのです。
　御容赦下さい」署長「……そうか」村正「何よ？」景明「…………」署長「…………」村正「……？」

en:
————How was this happening? Kya ho raha hai?


Armour she had been. Armour.


Then a spider. Eight legs, still some connection to the armour business.


From there, straight to a young woman one fine day? What bloody logic was doing this?

She was not some grateful crane from a folktale, coming to repay a favour. Even the folktales had their own procedures.
ja:
――――何故、こうなる。


　鎧だったのだ。


　蜘蛛だったのだ。


　ある日突然、妙齢の女性に化ける道理がない。

　恩返しに来た鶴でもあるまいに。

en: Kageaki(What am I supposed to do now?)
ja: 景明（どうしろと）

en:
What to do, I did not know. Several times I had seen this form already. Each time, the understanding refused to come with it.

Not understanding at all. Magnificently not understanding.

Ask me what precisely was troubling me, and even that I could not explain. My brain had been given this situation to digest and was refusing the food.

At least if Muramasa had remained steel, something I could have managed. A steel woman, fine. Some connection with the previous condition. But...
ja:
どうしたらいいものやら。
　この姿を見るのもこれで幾度目かだが、未だにわか
らない。

　わからな過ぎる。

　とどのつまり自分が何を悩んでいるのかすら、良く
わからない。
　とにかくこの現状が俺の頭脳では消化不可能なのだ。

　せめて村正が鋼鉄はがねのままであれば、納得のしようも
あるのだが……。

en: Kageaki"..."Muramasa"What is it?"
ja: 景明「……」村正「どうしたの？」

en: Muramasa"Ah!?"Kageaki"..."
ja: 村正「きゃっ！」景明「……」

en: Muramasa"Bas! Stop inspecting me, you walking scrap-yard! I am not something you have bought by weight!"Kageaki"...Not steel..."Muramasa"Haan, thank you, metal inspector. Now stop discussing me like a sample."
ja:
村正「ぁん、やめっ、だめだってばっ！
　くすぐったいからっ。悪戯しないの」景明「……柔らかい……」村正「恥ずかしいこと言わないでよ」

en: Muramasa"Now why are both your hands and both your knees on the floor?"Chief"Do not become agitated, Kageaki."Kageaki"Sir, that facility is not available."
ja: 村正「どうしてそこで両手両膝を床につくの」署長「動揺するな景明」景明「無理です」

en:
A hole I wanted to dig.

Fit myself inside, hold my knees, and simply sit. No more developments, please.

Mitti is dependable. Soil. You dig it, it makes a hole; you sit in the hole, it does not become a young woman and ask why you are upset. Such basic manners I was asking from the universe. Nothing extravagant. If somebody called down to ask whether I was coming out, I could say no, and the hole would support my position on every side.

Such was my condition.
ja:
穴を掘りたい。
　そこに収まって、ひたすら膝を抱えて座っていたい。

　そんな心地だった。

en: Chief"About now the procession should be entering Wakamiya Avenue. Prepare, or late you will be."Kageaki"Yes... And you, Chief?"Chief"I will watch from some distance. We must allow for the worst."Kageaki"Meaning?"Chief"...Kageaki. Whether to kill him or not is your decision."Chief"But halfway business I will not have. You understand what I mean?"Kageaki"I do."
ja:
署長「そろそろ行列が若宮大路へ入る頃合だ。
　準備せねば間に合うまい」景明「はい……。
　署長は？」署長「少し離れて様子を見ておく。
　万一の場合に備えねばならん」景明「それは？」署長「……景明。
　斬る斬らぬの判断はお前に委ねるが」署長「中途半端な真似だけはしてくれるな。
　私の言う意味がわかるか？」景明「わかります」

en:
For the Prince and the Chief, my deciding not to kill Moriuji was not the worst possibility. Decide to kill him, attack, then start wavering halfway and let him escape—that was the disaster.

Full disaster, properly completed. The assassination had to succeed and throw the shogunate into confusion. Only then could the Prince find a way to survive, even if people suspected him of arranging it.

“Assassination we attempted. Moriuji is perfectly fine.” Give that report, and His Highness's soul would certainly be leaving for the unseen world.

...If things approached that point, the Chief probably meant to warn the Prince and get him away.

Little chance of success, but much better than nothing.

Not that I could take comfort in this arrangement. Their last chance was not my cushion.
ja:
親王と署長にとって最も望ましくない事態とは、俺
が護氏を殺さないと決断することではない。
　一旦は殺すと決めて襲いながら、途中で迷い、挙句
取り逃がしてしまうことだ。

　これはまさしく最悪である。
　大将領暗殺に成功して幕府が大きな動揺をきたせば
こそ、たとえ黒幕だと感付かれても親王は生存の道を
得られるのだ。

　暗殺は試みたが護氏は無事でした、では間違いなく
親王の霊魂が幽世かくりよへ旅立つ。
　……その最悪の事態が迫った時、署長は親王に急を
知らせて逃亡させるつもりなのだろう。

　成功の見込みは薄いが、やらぬよりは余程いい。

　無論、俺はその手配りで安心してはならないわけだ
が。

en: Kageaki"...If I decide to kill him... I will see it through."Chief"I am relying on you. I will go, then."Kageaki"The security cordon is already in place. Take care."Chief"You too."
ja:
景明「……斬ると、決意した時は……
　必ずや」署長「頼むぞ。
　では、私は行く」景明「既に警備体制が敷かれています。
　お気をつけて」署長「お前こそな」

en: Kageaki"Shall we begin also?"Muramasa"Yes."Kageaki"..."Muramasa"Mido... It is all right. As you think best, you do."Muramasa"The sword you need, that I will be. Your shield also... I will protect you, you will see."
ja:

en: Muramasa"Arre, then why are you collapsing again! What more must I say!"Kageaki"No... nothing..."
ja: 村正「だから、どうして挫折するの！」景明「いや……別に……」

en: Chachamaru"Hellooo!"Moriuji"Chachamaru... What are you doing here?"Chachamaru"Festival sightseeing."Moriuji"...This month, guardianship of the Eastern Capital is your duty. An outside enemy attacks Kamakura, then you are the one who must stand in front and stop it."Moriuji"Do not neglect it. Return to Wada Manor."Chachamaru"Arre, Dada, loosen up. Carry on like that, constipation will become your next command."Chachamaru"One little look and apun is going straight back."Moriuji"Nevertheless..."Chachamaru"Guard duty is boredom only! Nothing to do. Sit in the manor, hear scheduled reports. Then sit more. Sitting's father is more sitting. Bas, entire occupation."Chachamaru"Cannot carry on, yaar. At least some enemy army could have the bloody courtesy to attack. But no. Nobody comes. Wait, thinking has to change. Enemy is not coming? Apun becomes the enemy."Chachamaru"You sure, Dada? Carry on like this, Yamato gets the most bakwaas rebellion in its entire history! Stop it now, while the rebel is still explaining the prevention!"Moriuji"...Chachamaru. Young you may be, but the office of Kubo you are holding."Moriuji"Have a little awareness of your position."Chachamaru"Heh... You also should look reality properly in the face, Dada."Chachamaru"Chachamaru only it is, boss. What expectations are you keeping? Look at the material first."Moriuji"............"
ja:
茶々丸「やほーぅ」護氏「茶々丸……

　もしもこの鎌倉を襲う外敵ありし時、矢面
に立って防ぐのはそなたの役目なのだぞ」護氏「おろそかにするでない。
　和田館へ戻れ」茶々丸「まぁまぁ、おじじ。固いこと言うな。

　やることねぇし。館に詰めて定時報告聞く
だけだしさ。ただひたすらにそれだけだしさ」茶々丸「やってらんねぇー。
　せめてほんとにどっかの敵軍が攻めてきて
くれりゃいいけどさぁ。来ねえし。いやここ

en: Chachamaru"Arre, straight back I am going. Really."Moriuji"Very well. Honestly... Anything so entertaining is not even there to watch."Chachamaru"That is apun's opinion also. But the lady of my household wants it. What to do?"Moriuji"The lady? ...Ah, that woman called Yuutsuzu."Moriuji"When I saw her in Horigoe early this spring, she seemed gravely ill. If she can come as far as Kamakura, she must have recovered somewhat."Chachamaru"Not really. That's why, when she asks so insistently, apun can't just say no, na."Chachamaru"Doctor accompanying her today. There, that car."Moriuji"...Hm. There are various rumours about her..."Chachamaru"That she is apun's mother, that one?"Moriuji"Seeing the care you give her, one might almost believe it."Chachamaru"Leave the others. What happened to my mother, and WHERE SHE IS NOW, you know perfectly well."Moriuji"Yes. A jest."Chachamaru"Why apun looks after Lady Yuutsuzu... well, you know..."Chachamaru"A soft spot. Full disadvantage of liking somebody."Moriuji"............"Chachamaru"What?"Moriuji"...I had considered, in time, a marriage between you and Shirou... But... surely..."Moriuji"You have not already settled all your attachments elsewhere...?"Chachamaru"...Oye, Grand Commander of the Six Guards. All six guards couldn't stop that bakwaas from coming out? With such a serious face also!"Moriuji"Ah, yes... My apologies. Forget I said it."Chachamaru"Bearded uncle sees apun care for one sick person and starts mourning the marriage plans. Bhosdike, even if you begged, apun wouldn't keep that rubbish in memory."Chachamaru"I KNOW ALL ABOUT PROPER COURTSHIP! NEVER BEEN ON A DATE, BUT I KNOW!"Moriuji"No shouting!"

Beyond this point, the custom permits only Your Excellency the Grand Commander himself to proceed—"Kageaki"Your attendants we must therefore request to wait here."Moriuji"I know. It happens every year."Moriuji"Now, lead on."Kageaki"At once."
ja:
護氏「その方らが今年の介添か」景明「はッ」村正「…………」景明「畏れながら殿下に申し上げます。
　これより先の立ち入りは大将領殿下御一人ごいちにん
のみ許される仕来しきたりでありますれば――」景明「御供の方々は、こちらにてお待ち願いたく
存じます」護氏「心得ておる。
　例年の事だ」護氏「さ、案内あないせい」景明「ははっ」

en:
The rear approach went round in a spiral, deeper underground.

Width was not generous. Height also, nothing to boast of. The Grand Commander and his horse, Muramasa and myself pretending to be priests—only these were moving. But the noise! In that narrow space, every footstep came back with its relatives.

Send a few dozen people running through here together, and the ears would have a very bad time.
ja:
裏参道は螺旋を描き、下へ潜ってゆく。

　道幅はさして広いとはいえず、高さも同様だった。
　大将領とその騎馬、神官を装う俺と村正、動くもの
はこれだけであるのにやたらと姦かしましいのは、この狭隘きょうあい
な空間で足音が反響するためである。

　もしもこの中で数十人からの人間が一斉に駆け回り
でもしたなら、相当耳に悪いことになりそうだ。

en: Muramasa"............"Kageaki"..."

On my cheek I felt the glance Muramasa was quietly sending my way.

Waiting, probably.

My decision was what she wanted.
ja:
村正がさりげなく投げてくる視線を、頬に感じる。
　待っているのだろう。

　俺の決断を。

en: Kageaki(Strong.)
ja: 景明（強い）

en:
First time I saw Rokuhara's ruler with my own eyes, and that one word was the whole impression.

Strong, this man was.
In body. In mind. Every meaning you could give the word.

The breadth of his back alone spoke of how thickly the strength was laid on.

Goodness...
Righteousness, perhaps...
Neither one I could see.

Arrogant strength. Probably very simple desire was holding it up.

The urge to dominate, given a body?

But on that ground alone, unfit to rule Yamato I could not call him. Put one clean, upright, moral man at the top and the country arranges itself nicely—that much of a dreamer I was not.

A king full of ideals and short of power could make the country worse. East or west, open a history book and such fellows were available in quantity.

Moriuji Ashikaga was overflowing with power. The fate of all Yamato and every person in it—probably that back would not even find it heavy.

However greedy a tyrant he might be, if the Yamato held in those arms ended up protected...

Then as a ruler, was he right? Was he wrong?

Disliking the man was not supplying the answer.
ja:
六波羅総帥を初めて肉眼視しての感想は、ただその
一言に尽きた。

　この男は強いのだ。
　肉体的に。精神的に。ありとあらゆる意味で・・・・・・・・・・。

　太い背が強さの厚みを物語っている。

　善性……
　あるいは義性といったものは、見受けられない。

　その強さは傲岸である。
　おそらく、ごくごく単純な欲望・・に支えられているの
だろう。

　支配欲の権化か。

　しかし、それをもって彼に大和の統治者たるの資格
無しとは言えない。
　清く正しく道義に生きる者が上に立てば国は治まる
――と信じ込むほど俺も夢見がちではなかった。

　理想のみあって力足らぬ王は、むしろ国を乱す。
　東西の歴史を紐解けば、その種の前例は枚挙に暇が
ない。

　足利護氏は力に満ち溢れている。
　この背は大和全土全国民の命運も、重しとはしない
だろう。

　如何に彼が強欲極まる暴君であろうと――
　その両腕の抱え込む大和が、結果的に・・・・守られるので
あれば。

　果たして彼は、統治者として是か、非か。

en:
Under Rokuhara, the people's burdens had certainly become much heavier than before. Suppressing the opposition, too, was done with an openness and severity beyond comparison.

But.
Therefore Rokuhara's rule was bad rule? Too much was being settled with that one therefore.

The circumstances had to be weighed also.

Six years ago, Rokuhara had committed an enormous betrayal. Sold the country, ended the war, and taken power in Yamato. Suppose it had not betrayed the country. Suppose it had fought the League's army on the home islands instead. What would have been left of the land? Scorched earth, no?

The Rokuhara shogunate was textbook militarism. Rights of the individual citizen, hardly worth considering. But remove that military system—was there no chance the continent's disorder would have spilled into Yamato?

These six years had hardly been an age of harmony for the world. Somehow or other, Rokuhara had got through them in peace. At least this much: no war against another country. Whether the previous system could have done the same, I did not know.

One hundred years later, some historian might call Rokuhara's rule “the best available method.”
ja:
六波羅体制下において、それ以前より、国民の負担
が大きく増しているのは確かな事実だ。
　反体制派に対する弾圧も、以前とは比較にならぬ程
露骨であり厳格である。

　が。
　よって六波羅の統治は悪政だ――と決め付けるのは
一概視が過ぎよう。

　情勢というものも併せて評価せねばならない。

　六年前、六波羅は途方もない裏切りを行い、国家を
売り、大戦に幕を引いた。そして大和の政権を得た。
　だがもし、六波羅が裏切らず、連盟軍と本土決戦を
繰り広げていたら？　国土は焦土と化さなかったか？

　六波羅幕府は手本のような軍国主義を敷いており、
国民一人一人の権利は全く軽視されている。
　だがこの軍国主義体制がなかったら？　大陸情勢の
混迷が大和にも波及する可能性はなかったろうか？

　世界的に見て調和の時代とは言い難いこの六年間を、
六波羅は曲がりなりにも平穏に――少なくとも他国と
交戦することだけはなく――乗り切っているのだ。
　過去の体制で同じことができたかはわからない。

　百年後の歴史家は、六波羅の統治を「最善の手法」
として評価するのかもしれなかった。

en: Kageaki(...That textbook I would very much prefer not to read...)
ja: 景明（……そんな教科書を読みたくはないが……）

en:
Many in present-day Yamato, seeing Rokuhara's tyranny with their own eyes, would probably feel the same as me.

But from a later age, with the view made fully objective, surely that other judgment could be reached also. History could be quite comfortable with a conclusion we had to live inside.

Sau saal baad, sab samajhdaar. A hundred years later, everybody wonderfully sensible. The beatings have stopped hurting by then; the people who received them are dead. Now pull up a chair and explain how necessary the whole arrangement was. From that chair, perhaps the explanation would even be correct.

Kill Moriuji Ashikaga now.
Put an end to the Rokuhara system—◆and who could promise that Yamato would not go straight to ruin?
ja:
六波羅幕府の暴虐を目の当たりしている現代大和人
の多くは、俺と感想を同じくするだろう。
　しかし後世の視点に立てば、つまり客観視に徹すれ
ば、そのような評価もきっと下せるのだ。

　今、足利護氏を抹殺し。
　六波羅体制に終止符を打つ――◆それが大和にとって
破滅への一途でないとは、誰にも言い得ない。

en: Kageaki(............)Kageaki(...What do I do?)
ja: 景明（…………）景明（……どうする？）

en:
Cut him down?
Leave him?

Moriuji Ashikaga—was he a seed of disaster that had to be removed?

Same as Silver Star? Was he?
ja:
斬るか。
　斬らぬか。

　足利護氏は、取り除くべき災いの種か。
　銀星号と同列のものか。

en:
Suddenly the passage ended. A wide space opened before us, and at the far end stood a sanctuary much like the one aboveground.

The Lower Shrine.

...This far I had come. Now the decision also had to arrive.
ja:
通路は不意に終わり、広々とした空間が現れた。
　奥には、地上のそれと良く似た祭殿。

　下宮である。

　……ここまで来てしまった。
　もはや決断せねばならない。

en: Moriuji"In Ne-no-Kuni, the world beneath the earth, the gods live. Such a myth is there, I am told."Kageaki"————?"
ja:
護氏「神々は、地底界ネノクニに住まう。
　そんな神話もあるそうだ」景明「――――？」

en:
Without warning the Grand Commander began speaking.

Unless this was a conversation he was having with himself, we were the other participants.
ja:
やおら、大将領が口を開いた。
　独言ではないのなら、俺達に向けた言葉となろう。

en: Moriuji"A golden god sleeps beneath the earth... and when the time of summons comes, will appear in our world."Moriuji"An Emishi belief, was it not?"Muramasa"............"Moriuji"What do you think?"Kageaki"...Sir?"Moriuji"This belief that a god lives underground. All this trouble taken to build a sanctuary beneath the earth... perhaps such fantastic legends are not entirely fit for laughing away."Moriuji"Would you not agree?"Kageaki"Indeed, sir. Precisely as you say."Moriuji"Huhuhu..."Kageaki"...?"Moriuji"This shrine's priest you are, no? A layman's notions you swallow so obediently, not one word of your own. Your professional standing, where will it go?"Kageaki"...I am ashamed, sir."Moriuji"If you have an opinion, let us hear it."Kageaki"............Then, with your permission."Moriuji"Granted."Kageaki"According to one theory, Hachiman was originally a god brought from overseas... Therefore, as a guardian of people seeking a new land also, he is understood."Moriuji"Oh...?"Kageaki"That aspect of the Hachiman faith, perhaps this is how it has been given form."Moriuji"The Lower Shrine, built in this other space underground, represents the new world Hachiman brings. That is your meaning?"Kageaki"Indeed."Moriuji"As expected of a professional. You know your subject well."Kageaki"Such shallow learning I have paraded before Your Excellency. The embarrassment is entirely mine, sir."
ja:
護氏「金色の神は地の底に眠り……
　いつか招きの時が来たならば、我らの世へ
現れると」護氏「蝦夷どもの信仰であったかな」村正「…………」護氏「どう思う」景明「……はっ？」護氏「地の底に神在りとする信仰よ。
　かような祭殿がわざわざ地下に建てられて
あるを見れば……荒唐無稽な伝承もあながち
笑い捨てにしたものではないやもしれぬ」護氏「そう思わぬか」景明「はっ。
　御意にございます」護氏「ふっふふ……」景明「……？」護氏「貴様はこの社の神官ではないか。
　素人考えを諾々と容いれ、一言も申さずでは、
立場に関わろう」景明「……畏れ入ります」護氏「意見あらば、言うてみよ」景明「…………では。
　お許しを得まして」護氏「うむ」景明「一説によりますれば、八幡神の原本は渡来
の神であり……
　従って、新しき国を求める人々の守護神と
いう性格が存在するとか」護氏「ほう……」景明「その八幡信仰が、かような形で表現された
……とも考えられますかと」護氏「地下という異空間に造られた下宮は、八幡
神がもたらす新世界を象徴するもの。
　そういう事か」景明「御意」護氏「流石に本職。
　良く存じておるのう」景明「御前にて浅学をひけらかし、汗顔の至りで
ございます」

en:
Good thing I had stuffed myself with general knowledge of Hachiman Shrine, in case something like this happened. Last-night cramming also had its dignity.

For one moment my blood had gone cold, but...

Through it I had got, perhaps?
ja:
こんな事もあろうかと、八幡宮に関連する一通りの
知識を仕込んでおいた甲斐があった。
　一夜漬け学習も馬鹿にならないものだ。

　一瞬、肝の冷える場面であったが……
　どうにか凌いだ、か？

en: Moriuji"There you have slipped."Kageaki"————"Moriuji"Answering back, or anything resembling it, you should not have attempted. A real priest, however much I invited him, would only have shrunk into himself. Not one word."Kageaki"...Forgive my discourtesy—"Moriuji"But the more fatal mistake was in your walking, all the way down here... that distance you were keeping."Moriuji"A mere priest knows exactly where my sword can reach, and naturally keeps himself just outside? Such talented priests we do not have."Kageaki"!!"
ja:
護氏「抜かったな」景明「――――」護氏「口答えめいた真似をするべきではなかった。
　本物の神官であれば、予がいかに水を向け
ようとただ縮こまるばかりで一言も無かった
だろうよ」景明「……ご無礼を――」護氏「それよりも致命的な失敗は、ここへ降りる
までの歩き方……
　距離の取り方であろうな」護氏「神官如きが、予の斬り間・・・を把握して自然と
外すなどという振舞いをいたす筈がないわ」景明「!!」

en:
...Shit!
Had the habit come out by itself? So deeply it was in my body!?

What a first-class chutiya I had been. Whether assassination was right, whether it was wrong—so occupied with that, I had not even considered this danger.
ja:
……しまった！
　身に染み付いた癖が出ていたのか!?

　何たる甘さか。
　暗殺の是非に気を囚われて、そんな危険は考慮すら
しなかった。

en: Moriuji"So Prince Maidono has a fighting man like you under him also."Kageaki"..."Moriuji"This assassination work you accepted out of loyalty? Or did the reward do the persuading?"Kageaki"..."Moriuji"Now silence you are choosing? Too late, my little bird. Chirp something."Kageaki"...Then I have a question for the Grand Commander of the Six Guards."Moriuji"Oh? The assassin proposes to question me?"Kageaki"One question there is which a ruler must answer. Whoever asks it, that makes no difference."Moriuji"Speak."Kageaki"What kind of king are you?"Moriuji"————"Kageaki"With Yamato, what do you intend to do? With its people, what do you intend to do?"Kageaki"What kind of king are you? ...I ask for your answer."Moriuji"Huh, huh."Kageaki"..."Moriuji"Your bad luck, assassin. For that question I have no answer."Kageaki"What?"Moriuji"A conqueror I am. Nothing else."Moriuji"Everything I take. Everything I conquer. Everything I make submit. Moriuji Ashikaga means this."Kageaki"............"Kageaki"Then simply being master is your aim? Governing the country, that does not interest you?"Moriuji"Not that there is no interest. For further conquest it is a useful means... Only that."
ja:
護氏「舞殿宮の下にも貴様のような武人がいたか」景明「……」護氏「刺客の任を受けたは忠義からか？
　それとも褒賞に釣られたか？」景明「……」護氏「今更だんまりを決め込んでも遅かろう。
　何か囀ってみよ」景明「……ならば。
　六衛大将領殿下にお尋ねする」護氏「ほゥ？
　刺客が、予に問いを投げるか」景明「王将たる者には、相手が何人であろうとも
答えねばならぬ問いが一つきりある」護氏「云うが良い」景明「貴方は如何なる王者か」護氏「――――」景明「この大和を如何にされる存念か。
　国民くにたみを如何にされる存念か」景明「貴方は如何なる王なのか。
　……御答を賜りたい」護氏「ふっ、ふ」景明「……」護氏「生憎であったな、刺客。
　予はその問いに答を持たぬ」景明「何と？」護氏「予は偏ひとえに覇者」護氏「全てを奪い、征服し、従える……。
　それが足利護氏よ」景明「…………」景明「では貴方は……統べる・・・だけが目的だという
のか。
　治めることに関心はないと？」護氏「皆無、とは云わぬが。
　征服を進める手段よの……所詮」

en:
Ulta. The whole thing was reversed.

He did not want to be master so that he could govern the country.

He governed the country so that he could become its absolute master...!
ja:
逆転している。

　この男は治政を行うために支配を望むのではない。
　支配を完成する手段として政治を行うのだ……！

en: Kageaki"Then your purpose has already been achieved?"Moriuji"Hmph... Nonsense you are talking. Satisfied, why would I be?"Moriuji"Even now in Yamato, fellows who do not bow to Rokuhara's banner are strolling about in broad daylight. As though the place belongs to their fathers."Kageaki"...The occupation forces?"Moriuji"Until I drive them out, my conquest is not complete."Kageaki"You intend to open hostilities eventually..."Moriuji"Eventually? Such leisurely business I am not proposing. Immediately."Moriuji"I will not let those white swine fatten in my garden any longer. Back to their pens across the sea with them."Kageaki"You cannot expect to win."Moriuji"I will win."Kageaki"..."
ja:
景明「ならば貴方の目的は既に達成されていると
いうことか」護氏「ふん……世迷言を云う。
　予が満足している筈はなかろう」護氏「今の大和には、六波羅の旗を仰がぬ奴輩が
白昼堂々と闊歩しておるではないか」景明「……進駐軍？」護氏「奴らを駆逐せぬ限り、予の覇業は成らぬ」景明「いずれ戦端を開くと……」護氏「いずれ、などと気の長いことは云わぬ。
　すぐにもだ」護氏「これ以上、予の庭で白豚どもを肥え太らせ
ておくものか。
　海の向こうの畜舎へ送り返してくれる」景明「勝算が立ちますまい」護氏「予は勝つ」景明「……」

en: Moriuji"Six years ago, different matter. Whatever I did, no chance of victory was there. Submission I chose for that reason."Moriuji"But today's Rokuhara is not that Rokuhara. This time we can win. The land may be devastated, half the people may be sacrificed—but victory we shall have!"Kageaki"...Madness."Moriuji"Hm...?"Kageaki"Half the people? Arre, what meaning is left in victory after paying that price!"Kageaki"Even if you drive the occupation forces out, Yamato itself will collapse..."Moriuji"Very likely."Kageaki"...!?"Moriuji"No matter."Kageaki"Nothing will remain, and still this victory you want?"Moriuji"It will remain. The fact that I conquered Yamato. That cannot collapse with the country."Kageaki"............"Moriuji"After that, what happens is not a subject of interest to me."Kageaki"Grand Commander... You would... for that alone—"
ja:
護氏「六年前とは違う。あの時は如何にしようと
勝つ目が無かった。
　だから恭順の道を選んだ」護氏「しかし今の六波羅は昔日のそれではない。
　今度は勝てる……国土は荒れ、民の半分は
犠牲となるやもしれんが、必ず勝つ！」景明「……馬鹿な」護氏「ふん……？」景明「民の半分？
　そこまでの犠牲を払っての勝利など、何の
意味もない！」景明「例え進駐軍を撤退せしめても、大和は自ら
崩壊する……」護氏「で、あろうのぅ」景明「……!?」護氏「構わぬ」景明「何も残らぬ勝利をあえて欲する――と？」護氏「残るとも。
　予が大和を制覇したという事実はな」景明「…………」護氏「その後の事に興味は無い」景明「大将領……
　貴方は……それだけのために」

en: Moriuji"Chalo. Enough time we have wasted on trivial matters."Moriuji"For your journey to the other world, perhaps I have given rather generous provisions. No matter... One more honour I shall give you also."Moriuji"Higekiri!"
ja:
護氏「さて。
　下らぬ時を過ごしたな」護氏「冥途の土産を、ちと弾み過ぎたか。
　まあ良いわ……ついでにもう一つ、栄誉を
くれてやろう」護氏「鬚切ヒゲキリ！」

en: Muramasa"!!"Moriuji"The Genji's supreme treasure, stained with some foot soldier's blood. It pains me. But such filthy nerve you have shown, reaching for my head, that an exception is deserved. An edge too keen to hold even a drop of water—you shall taste it."
ja:
村正「!!」護氏「源氏の至宝を雑兵の血で汚すは心苦しいが。
　予の首を狙った糞度胸に免じて、水も溜ま
らぬ刃味というものを味わわせてやるわ」

en: Moriuji"HOMAGE AND PROSTRATION TO HACHIMAN, GREAT BODHISATTVA! I BECOME THE SACRED VESSEL!!"
ja:
護氏「帰命頂礼八幡大菩薩！
　我、御器みうつわと罷り成る!!」

en: Muramasa"Mido!"
ja: 村正「御堂！」

en:
...No way out.

For me alone, perhaps. For Prince Maidono, none.

Who we were was already exposed. Let the Grand Commander return alive, and the Prince would be condemned and die for nothing.

Bas. This was as far as hesitation could take me.

Moriuji Ashikaga—I would cut him down!

And then————
ja:
……逃げ道はない。
　俺個人にはともかく、舞殿宮には。

　既にこちらの正体は割れているのだ。
　大将領を生かして帰せば、親王は罪を問われ、無為
の死を遂げるだろう。

　最早これまで。
　覚悟を決めるしかない！

　足利護氏を……斬る!!

　そして――――

en: Chief"When that time comes, cut me down."Chief"Understood?"
ja: 署長「その時は私を斬れ」署長「いいな」

en: Kageaki"————MURAMASA!!"
ja: 景明「――――村正ァッ!!」

en: Moriuji"So you were an Emishi woman... With those robes, very neatly you had hidden it."Moriuji"But now that you have shown yourself, what exactly can you do?"Muramasa"What do you think?"Muramasa"Cross swords with your great treasure there. That Higekiri tsurugi, yes, that one."Moriuji"..."Kageaki"..."Muramasa"...Oye, Mido! That fellow's face I can understand. Why are YOU also looking at me like 'what bakwaas is this woman talking'?!"Kageaki"S-sorry. My eyes are reporting a woman. The armour part is still not getting through—"Muramasa"Bas, stop that nonsense. Come on, Armoring Stance!"
ja:
護氏「そちらは蝦夷の女であったか……。
　うまく装束で隠していたな」護氏「しかし、姿を見せたところで何ができる？」村正「決まってるでしょ」村正「その大名物――
　鬚切の劒冑と、太刀打するのよ」護氏「……」景明「……」村正「……ちょっと、御堂。
　あちらはともかく、どうして貴方までなに
言ってるんだこの女みたいな顔するの！」景明「す、済まん。
　お前のその格好を見ていると、未だにピン
と来ないものが――」村正「わけのわからないこと言ってないで。
　さっ、装甲ノ構カマエを！」

en: Moriuji"W... WHAT?!"Moriuji"A TSURUGI?! You—you are an armoured warrior!!"
ja:
護氏「な……何ィ!?」護氏「劒冑だと!?
　貴様――――武者かッ!!」

en: Kageaki"Meet a demon, cut the demon. Meet a Buddha, cut the Buddha."
ja:
景明「鬼に逢うては鬼を斬る。
　仏に逢うては仏を斬る」

en: Kageaki"HERE LIES THE LAW OF THE SWORD!"
ja: 景明「ツルギの理ここに在り！」

en: Kageaki".............."Muramasa《Kya?》Kageaki"Nothing..."
ja: 景明「………………」村正《なに？》景明「いや……」

en:
A strange relief came over me. I gave a crooked smile.

Only after armoring up did I understand.

...Nothing had changed about Muramasa.

My tsurugi. Same as before.

All this confusion, this worrying—my eyes had seen a different exterior and dragged the whole brain after them. No need for any of it.
ja:
奇妙な安堵を得て、苦笑する。

　装甲してみてわかった。

　……村正は別に何も変わっていない。

　俺の劒冑だ。

　見てくれに惑わされて悩む必要などなかったのだ。

en: Kageaki"—Let us go!"Muramasa《Understood!》
ja: 景明「――行くぞ！」村正《諒解！》

en: Moriuji"Hm—"
ja: 護氏「むっ――」

en: Kageaki"...Ngh!"
ja: 景明「……ぬぅ！」

en:
Our first cuts locked together. Sparks went flying; the impact ran up both our arms.

Heavy.
...But more or less equal, no?

A growl came from deep in my throat. From the Grand Commander, at the same time, an irritated snort. Neither party was enjoying the introduction.
ja:
噛み合った初太刀と初太刀。
　それは宙空に火花を散らし、互いの腕に撃衝を走ら
せた。

　重い。
　……だが、ほぼ互角か。

　こちらが喉奥で唸るのと同時、大将領も忌々しげな
鼻息を洩らしていた。

en: Moriuji"So all decoration and no substance you are not..."Kageaki"To receive your praise is an honour beyond measure."Moriuji"Young pup. Wherever you were bred, judgment also you should have cultivated. The hands alone cannot do all the thinking."Moriuji"Then your whole life you would not have wasted, wagging your tail for Prince Maidono."Kageaki"Unfortunately, better judgment would have made joining your service even less possible, I believe. On that point, further education would only worsen matters."Moriuji"You dare!"
ja:
護氏「見掛け倒しではないようだな……」景明「殿下にお褒め頂けるとは光栄の極み」護氏「若造が。
　何処の産か知らんが、腕相応に眼も養って
おけというのだ」護氏「さすれば舞殿宮如きの飼い犬で一生を棒に
振ることもなかったろうよ」景明「生憎、眼力を養っていれば尚のこと、貴方
のもとで禄を食む道は選べなかったであろう
と存ずる」護氏「抜かすわ！」

en:
With a roar, the enemy stepped in. The movement, the handling of the sword—Rokuhara Shinkage Style. Here and there, though, the proper form had been bent to his own use.

A commander well seasoned in war, that was probably what it showed. Near sixty he ought to be, but slowness had apparently received no invitation.
ja:
怒声を発し、踏み込んでくる敵騎。
　その挙措、太刀取りは六波羅新陰流のそれ――但し
自己流の崩れ・・が随所に見られる。

　この将帥が戦に古ふりている証であろう。
　齢よわい六十に迫る筈だが、鈍さはまるで窺えない。

en:
Against that keen point, swordsmanship alone I could rely on. The underground space was almost a hemisphere, broad and high enough to fit a school inside. Plenty of space, until two armoured warriors proposed to show the full art of flight. For that, nowhere near enough.

Unless a demonstration of my body entering a wall was wanted, feet on the ground was the only choice.
ja:
敵騎の鋭鋒を迎えるに、頼れるのは刀法たちわざのみだった。
　半球に近い形状の地下空間は、学校がひとつ収まる
ほどの広さと高さを備えるが、それでも武者が騎航術はやがけ
の粋を競う場としては全く足りない。

　壁面に激突する醜態を望まないなら、地面に足裏を
つけて戦う一択である。

en: Moriuji"Hah..."
ja: 護氏「ふッ……」

en: Kageaki"!!"
Moriuji"Tch—"
ja: 護氏「チ――」

en:
A nasty little trick!

Down from high guard, he seemed to be cutting. Then the sword came back toward his hands and shot straight forward in a thrust.

One fraction later, and that point would have gone through my throat.

This man had practice. More than sufficient practice.
ja:
曲技くせわざを！
　上段から斬り下ろすと見せかけて変化、手元へ引き
込んだ太刀を一直線に突き出してきた。

　俺の反応が後僅かにでも遅れていたら、喉仏を貫か
れていただろう。
　対手はやはり、相当に場慣れしている。

en: Kageaki(...But.)
ja: 景明（……しかし）

en:
For one instant I was impressed with myself. The body had actually moved in time. Almost as though I were admiring somebody else's fine performance.

The old me probably could not have avoided that.

Today, the movements were light.

The armour suited my skin. Even that faint, wrong feeling was gone. Not something worn on the body—it felt as if it had genuinely become the body.
ja:
良く体捌たいさばきが間に合ったものだと、俺は刹那、他人
事のように感心した。
　従来の己であれば避けられなかったろうと思う。

　今日は動きが軽い。

　甲鉄が肌に合う・・・・。
　微妙な違和感さえも今はなく、本当に肉体と同一化
してしまったように感じている。

en:
The proper sword-bearing rite—the Tatewaki Ceremony—had done this?

So this was becoming one armoured warrior, properly!
ja:
正当の帯刀たてわきを行った成果か。

　これが真の意味で武者になるという事か！

en: Muramasa《His tsurugi is formidable, just as we thought. But beyond what we thought? No.》Muramasa《We are Muramasa. We can win!》Kageaki"Agreed!"
ja:
村正《想像通り、敵の劒冑は大した物よ。
　けれど、想像以上ってことはない》村正《村正わたしたちなら勝てる！》景明「肯うむ！」

en: Moriuji"Two-paisa warrior!!"
ja: 護氏「端武者がッ!!」

en: Kageaki"Coming through!!"
ja: 景明「推参!!」

en:
The swords crossed paths. Steel struck steel; both blades sprang back.

Haan—but this much I had already counted on!
ja:
剣の軌道が交差し、刃金と刃金は弾き合う。

　が――これは俺の想定の内！

en: Moriuji"Hm!?"
ja: 護氏「む!?」

en:
The deflected sword I let go round over my head, in one full circle.

...Back it came, attacking from the other side in the mirrored form!

Yoshino Style Rules of Engagement: Echo Strike.
ja:
弾かれた太刀をそのまま、頭上でぐるりと取り回し。
　……対称の形で再び襲う！

　吉野御流合戦礼法、木霊こだま打ち。

en: Moriuji"Y-you...!"
ja: 護氏「きッ……貴様ァ!!」

en:
A deep sword scar opened at his shoulder. Rokuhara's Marshal gave a short shout of fury.

His neck I had aimed for...

But in that instant he had twisted, taking the blow on the thickest armour. Naturally. Even the man's mistakes were refusing to cooperate.
ja:
肩口に刀痕を深々と刻まれ、六波羅元帥が短く憤怒
を叫ぶ。

　首筋を狙って打ち込んだのだが……
　咄嗟に身を捻って最も甲鉄が厚い箇所で受けるとは、
流石。

en: Muramasa《One more cut on that shoulder and we can break through.》Kageaki"...He is unlikely to give us permission."
ja: 村正《でもあの肩、もう一太刀加えれば破れる》景明「……させてはくれまいがな」

en:
I adjusted my grip and murmured it. My own carelessness needed the warning also.

His eyes were boiling with anger, but the slightly greater distance between us he kept. Headlong attack had apparently become caution. A complete change of policy.

No more charging on momentum alone, probably. If my thinking stayed behind while his tactics moved on, I would get a very unpleasant surprise.
ja:
太刀を取り直して呟く。
　自分自身の油断を戒めるためでもあった。

　敵騎は怒りに双眸を滾たぎらせながら、しかしやや遠間
になった距離を保っている。
　戦闘方針を猛進から慎重へと大きく切り替えた様子
だ。

　勢い任せの猪突チャージは最早するまい。
　こちらも対応して意識を改めておかないと、思わぬ
不覚を取る羽目になりそうである。

en:
What would he do?

He seemed ready to wait for my move. But with that temperament, waiting forever was unlikely. While waiting, a way to attack he must also be searching for.

From my side, patiently choosing the safest move every time was not possible either. A long fight was dangerous.

The Grand Commander keeps not returning, and the shogunate soldiers above would realise something was wrong. Down they would send a unit of armoured warriors.

Then my future would become a very short subject.
ja:
どう出るか。

　見るに、対手は俺の出方を待つ構えだ――が、気質
を思えばただ待ち続けということはなかろう。
　待つ一方で、攻め手を探っているに違いない。

　そして俺は俺で、手堅く地道な戦術に徹してばかり
はいられない事情があった。
　戦闘の長期化は危険なのだ。

　いつまでも大将領が戻らなければ、地上で待機する
幕府の士卒は異常事態の発生を悟る。
　武者を一隊、送り込んでくるだろう。

　そうなっては俺の命運も窮まる。

en: Kageaki"...Hh."
ja: 景明「……っ」

en:
With my breath I pushed out the shaking in my chest.
No hurry. Jaldi would not help here...

An accomplished warrior stood opposite. One mistake, and the life could go. Not a figure of speech.

First, try drawing him in. If he took the bait, good. Even if he did not—
ja:
胸の震えを、呼気にして押し出した。
　焦ってはならない……。

　相手は練達の武者だ。
　一度の不覚が文字通り命取りになる。

　まずは、誘いの術を掛けてみるか。
　それで釣れれば良し、釣れなくとも――

en: Muramasa《Eh!?》
ja: 村正《え!?》

en:
My heart missed one beat.

A roar came without warning.

Gattari thrusters.
The enemy—he was firing his thrusters.
ja:
心臓が一回、鼓動を飛ばした。
　前触れもなしの轟音。

　合当理だ。
　敵騎が――合当理に火を入れている。

en: Kageaki(Surely not.)
ja: 景明（真逆）

en:
...Flight he intended!?

In this much space!
ja:
……騎航するとぶつもりか!?
　この限られた空間で！

en: Moriuji"It is coming back to me..."Kageaki"...?"Moriuji"The wind of the battlefield. The choking stench of corpses."Moriuji"That smell—enough to bring up one's stomach."
ja:
護氏「思い出してきたわ……」景明「……？」護氏「戦場いくさばの風。
　噎せ返るような屍臭」護氏「反吐を催す――――あの匂い」

en: ————He took off.
ja: ――――飛び立った、

en: Kageaki(Madness.)
ja: 景明（無茶を）

en:
Had impatience got the better of him?

Calculate it however you liked, this was suicide...
ja:
焦りに負けたのか。
　これは、どう計っても自殺行為……

en:
Almost at the same instant his form disappeared, the sword came. Barely I managed to knock it aside.

Straight at the base of my neck. Every hair on my skin stood up. The body had understood the message very clearly.
ja:
敵騎の姿が消えるのと、ほとんど同瞬に襲ってきた
一刀を危うく打ち返す。
　正確に首根を狙っていたその太刀筋に、皮膚が総毛
立った。

en:
But now—
The wall was there. Into it he would have to go, dig his own grave, finish the matter,
ja:
しかし、この先は――
　敵騎は壁に突入して、己の墓穴を掘るしかない筈、

en: Kageaki"KYA!?"
ja: 景明「何だとォ!?」

en:
The impossible happened in front of me.

At tremendous speed he rushed toward the wall—and in that instant turned his armoured body around. Ground effect also he used, bleeding off momentum with exquisite control...

Both feet kicked off the wall.

Back at me he came!!
ja:
有り得ぬ光景が顕現した。

　猛スピードで壁に突き進んだ敵騎が、刹那、騎体を
反転させ。
　対面効果グランド・エフェクトも利用し、勢力を絶妙に殺す……

　そして両脚で壁を蹴り。
　再び、俺目掛けて襲い来る!!

en: Muramasa《Arre, what bloody circus is this!?》
ja: 村正《冗談でしょぉっ!?》

en:
Completely caught by surprise. Avoiding all of it was impossible. The point struck my breastplate.

At the last instant I bent backward. Kept the wound shallow, that much only I managed.

Counterattack? Time for that was not being supplied.
ja:
完全に意表を突かれては、躱しきるのも無理だった。
　胸甲に刃先を浴びる。

　寸前で上体を反らし、浅傷あさでに留めるのが精々の限度。
　反撃などしている暇はなかった。

en:
...A dream would have been welcome. Unfortunately, awake I was.

Every ordinary limit on armoured movement, this bastard was stepping outside it. Then kicking off the wall and coming back!
ja:
……夢だと思いたいところだが、夢ではない。
　異常も異常、無道法外の騎体運動を、敵は実現して
いる！

en: Kageaki"That thing can do a vertical somersault—a Kulbit!?"Moriuji"During the continental war, while you were still running about with snot on your face... I once held a cave temple against an enemy army."Moriuji"This technique I devised there. Snot-nosed pup! Stand on your toes as much as you like. This height you will not reach!"
ja:
景明「縦回転クルビットができるような騎体かっ!?」護氏「貴様が洟はなを垂らしていた頃の、大陸の戦で
……石窟寺院に立て篭もって敵の軍勢を迎え
撃ったことがあった」護氏「これはその折に編み出した技術わざよ。
　若造がッ、どう背伸びしても届くまい！」

en: Kageaki"T-that great general... Richthofen's Circus, the Red Devils—don't tell me he came from that lot?"Muramasa《So much leisure we are having, is it? For remarks like that?》
ja:
景明「あ、あの大将軍……
