ja:
金探兵「ぐへッッ！
　ちゅっ――中尉殿！」金探兵「申し訳ありませんっ！」艦載騎「謝らなくていい。
　寝る前・だったからな」艦載騎「俺があと三秒ほど遅れて来ていたらわから
なかったが」金探兵「は……はッ」艦載騎「お前は陸軍上がりか？」金探兵「は――
　ずっと海軍であります」金探兵「その、兄が陸軍でしたので……」艦載騎「そうか。
　うちと同じか」金探兵「……中尉殿も？」艦載騎「ああ。
　弟がな……」艦載騎「まぁ、今は皆まとめて六波羅だが」金探兵「……はっ」艦載騎「ふん、懐かしい詩うたを聞いたせいで昔を思い
出した」艦載騎「いや……昔といっても、まだ六年か。
　大戦が終わって、六波羅幕府が天下の主と
なってから……まだ」金探兵「…………」

en: Shipboard Warrior"Better keep the sleeping postponed, after all."Metal Detector Soldier"Sir!"Shipboard Warrior"The times seem ready to move again. Peace... apparently that is finishing again also."Shipboard Warrior"This sea, Sagami Bay, too..."Metal Detector Soldier"You mean... with the occupation forces?"Shipboard Warrior"..."Shipboard Warrior"I'll take a short flight."Metal Detector Soldier"Something suspicious, sir?"Shipboard Warrior"No. Just a strange... cold feeling down the spine."Shipboard Warrior"Anything on the metal detector?"Metal Detector Soldier"No, nothing."Shipboard Warrior"Achha..."Shipboard Warrior"Then probably my own speech has frightened me. Very impressive fellow I am. ...Back shortly."Metal Detector Soldier"Sir."Metal Detector Soldier"Take care, Lieutenant sir—"
ja:
艦載騎「居眠りは、やはりやめておけ」金探兵「はッ！」艦載騎「時代がそろそろ動くようだ。
　平穏は……また・・終わるらしい」艦載騎「この相模湾うみも……」金探兵「それは……
　つまり、進駐軍と？」艦載騎「…………」艦載騎「少し騎航してとんでくる」金探兵「何か不審が？」艦載騎「いや。
　ただ妙に……背筋が寒くてな」艦載騎「金探に何か反応はあるか？」金探兵「いえ、何も」艦載騎「そうか……」艦載騎「なら多分、自分の言葉に自分が煽られたの
だろう。我ながら情けない。
　……すぐに戻る」金探兵「はッ」金探兵「中尉殿、お気をつけて――」

en: Metal Detector Soldier"..."Metal Detector Soldier"L-Lieutenant?"
ja: 金探兵「……」金探兵「ちゅ、中尉殿？」

en: Metal Detector Soldier"...Eh?"Metal Detector Soldier"Blood?"Metal Detector Soldier"...Arre, but how, all of a sudden...?"
ja: 金探兵「……え？」金探兵「血？」金探兵「……そんな、どうして急に……？」

en: Ambushing Warrior"..."Metal Detector Soldier"————————"Metal Detector Soldier"An occupation-force dragoon..."Metal Detector Soldier"N-no, what bullshit! The detector showed NOTHING!"Metal Detector Soldier"How—"Ambushing Warrior"Sweet dreams."
ja:
奇襲騎「……」金探兵「――――――――」金探兵「し――進駐軍の竜騎兵ドラグーン……」金探兵「う、嘘だろ？
　金探には何の反応もなかったぞ!?」金探兵「なんで――」奇襲騎「良い夢を」

en: Ambushing Warrior《Eagle to Aerie.》Ambushing Warrior《Mission complete.》Ambushing Warrior《Eagle to Aerie.》Ambushing Warrior《Mission complete...》
ja: 奇襲騎《攻撃騎から艦隊司令部へ》奇襲騎《任務完了》奇襲騎《攻撃騎から艦隊司令部へ》奇襲騎《任務完了……》

en:
For Prince Haruhiro of Maidono, there was no attention left to spare. Chachamaru and I lifted the siege of Kenchouji and hurried back to Fudaraku. The Lord of Oyumi should be returning by his own route.

On the way, we met the strange-looking man. Apparently our return was what he had been waiting for.
ja:
もはや舞殿宮どころではなく、俺と茶々丸は建朝寺
の包囲を解いて普陀楽へ馳せ戻った。
　小弓公方も別途帰還している筈である。

　途上、異貌の男に出会った。
　俺達の帰りを待ち構えていたようだ。

en: Jouansai"—That is the message from Professor Wolf."Kageaki"..."Chachamaru"Achha, so THAT'S the scene... Fuck. Full complication now!"Chachamaru"Which bloody bastard had to put his helpful finger into this?"Kageaki"If we cannot use the Forged Bomb—"Chachamaru"Then our plan is finished, bhai. Rokuhara won't complain. The occupation army also, if they can win a normal fight, why bother using the bomb? Everybody can manage. WE cannot."Jouansai"That is the key, after all. To bring the dawn..."Kageaki"Then what are we to do?"Chachamaru"Follow Wolf's arrangements. Kya karein. We fight back."Chachamaru"Make the situation such that League headquarters decides to use the Forged Bomb."Jouansai"Withstand the occupation army's offensive, then bring matters to a stalemate. That is the intention?"Chachamaru"Today is... November thirtieth, na."Chachamaru"The Princess wakes on December fourth."Jouansai"Four days left. A convenient interval, one might say. Convenient in its own way..."Jouansai"If even after that long they have not taken Fudaraku, it should be enough to persuade them to commit their decisive weapon."Chachamaru"Haan. Making the timings sit together nicely, that's Wolf's headache."Chachamaru"Ours is to hold Fudaraku. Four days."Jouansai"Yes..."Kageaki"...Can we actually do that?"
ja:
常闇斎「――以上が、ウォルフ教授からの連絡です」景明「…………」茶々丸「そーゆーわけかよ……。
　くそ。面倒なことになった！」茶々丸「どこの誰様が余計な邪魔入れやがったんだ」景明「鍛造雷弾が使えない、となると――」茶々丸「あてらの目論見はぶっ潰れるね。
　六波羅は困らないし、進駐軍だってまとも
な勝負で勝てるならあえて雷弾を使わなくて
もいいだろうけど、あてらは・・・・困るね」常闇斎「あれが鍵ですから。
　夜明けを導くための……」景明「ならばどうする？」茶々丸「ウォルフのお膳立てに従うしかないよ。
　抗戦する」茶々丸「連盟本部が鍛造雷弾の使用を決断する状況
を作り上げる」常闇斎「進駐軍の攻勢を凌ぎ切り、膠着状態に持ち
込むということですね」茶々丸「今日は……一一月三〇日か」茶々丸「御姫が目覚めるのは一二月四日だ」常闇斎「あと四日ですか。
　丁度良いといえば、丁度良い長さ……」常闇斎「それだけの時間を掛けても普陀楽を陥とせ
ないとなれば、決戦力の投入を決意させるに
は充分でしょう」茶々丸「だな。
　そこんところのタイミングをうまく合わす
のはウォルフの仕事だ」茶々丸「あてらは四日間、普陀楽を守り切る」常闇斎「ええ……」景明「…………。
　できるか？　それが」

en:
The League's occupation forces in Yamato. In actual substance: the British Commonwealth's army.
Meaning the strongest military in the world, carrying the newest equipment. No shortage on either account.

Six years ago...
Rokuhara had admitted defeat and submitted without even fighting.
ja:
国際連盟大和進駐軍――その実態は大英連邦軍。
　つまりは世界最強、最新装備の軍事力。

　六年前……
　六波羅は戦わずして敗北を認め、その軍門に下って
いる。

en: Chachamaru"Have to do it. ...Have to, bhai. What else is there?"Kageaki"..."Kageaki"Yes. Nothing else. We have to do it."
ja:
茶々丸「やるしかないよ。
　……やるしかないさ、お兄さん」景明「…………」景明「そうだな。
　やるしかない」

en:
If there was no other road, then this one road was ours.
Run straight down it. Choice was not a facility being offered.
ja:
他に道が無いのなら。
　唯一つの道を、ひた駆けるのみである。

en:
The Lords of Koga, Oyumi, and Horigoe gathered in the council chamber.
One lord short, however. Sasagawa was missing.
ja:
評議の間に、古河、小弓、堀越の公方が集う。
　が……一人、篠川公方の姿がない。

en: Chachamaru"Where's Shishiku?"Raichou"Already flown to Aizu."Doushin"How soon the reinforcements from Sasagawa reach Fudaraku... on that question, victory and defeat will part company."Chachamaru"Achha."Doushin"But they have caught us very neatly. I had settled in my mind that once His Highness Kuniuji was appointed Lord General and Rokuhara restored, THEN the occupation forces would have their reason to fight, and their reason to win."Doushin"To attack before that..."Raichou"Indeed. GHQ has outmaneuvered us quite beautifully. The bastards!"Doushin"From a military standpoint, certainly, better to strike while our forces are scattered. But these people do not consider Rokuhara their equal. I had taken it that political convenience would get first preference."Raichou"Perhaps there is some reason behind the scenes."Chachamaru"Guessing their secret reasons now will do what? Whatever the reason, the enemy has reached Sagami Bay already."Chachamaru"Doesn't look like they've come to attend the appointment ceremony. So, with full respect, kindly fuck off. Let's work out how to get their cold-water swimming competition started in Sagami Bay."Doushin"That... is so, yes."Raichou"Lord Doushin, what are the enemy's movements?"
ja:
茶々丸「獅子吼はどうした？」雷蝶「もう会津へ飛んだわ」童心「篠川からの援軍が、どれだけ早く普陀楽へ
着くか……。
　そこが勝敗の分かれ目となるゆえ」茶々丸「そっか」童心「しかし、やられ申したな。
　邦氏殿下への大将領宣下によって六波羅が
再起を果たした時こそ、進駐軍は戦う意味と
勝つ意味とを得るのだと思い決めておった」童心「よもや、その前に仕掛けて来ようとは……」雷蝶「ええ。
　綺麗に裏をかいてくれたわ、ＧＨＱやつら！」童心「確かに軍事的には兵力が分散している内に
叩く方が有利……しかし六波羅われらを対等の相手
などと思っておらぬ奴らのこと、必ずや政治
的都合の方を優先すると踏んでおったのだが」雷蝶「何か裏事情があるのかもしれませんわね」茶々丸「……それをいま勘繰ったって仕方ねえだろ。
　事情はともかく、敵さんはもう相模湾そこまで
来てるんだ」茶々丸「宣下式典に参列したくて来たようには見え
ねえし、だったら丁重にお帰り願うしかねえ。
　方法を考えようぜ。やつらに相模湾で寒中
水泳大会始めてもらうためのさ」童心「で……ござるなァ」雷蝶「童心様、敵の動きは？」

en: Doushin"The ships believed to be the occupation force's Yokosuka fleet broke through the inner defences of Sagami Bay and struck Kotsubo naval port. Our main fleet stationed there took damage—"Doushin"Once Kotsubo was ready to counterattack, they withdrew, as though that was the very moment they had been waiting for. Now they have a blockade between Iijimazaki and Oosaki. The surviving fleet is shut inside the port."Raichou"...Shut inside. That is all?"Doushin"That is all."Chachamaru"Hain? What do these fellows WANT?"Chachamaru"Our Kotsubo fleet can't move, yes, very painful. But if all they're doing is sitting on the blockade, why would we need to move the fleet in the first place?"Doushin"Presumably to stop it interfering with their operations elsewhere..."Raichou"Are you saying Kamakura is NOT their objective? They mean to attack some other city?"Chachamaru"Arre, what nonsense."Doushin"Occupy Kamakura, take Fudaraku, bring Rokuhara to destruction. Now that GHQ has finally moved, I can conceive of no other purpose."Doushin"And yet—"Chachamaru"Then why don't they smash Kotsubo and come ashore already? That's the question. ...The Kotsubo attack is a diversion?"Doushin"The main force... coming overland from Yokohama base, across Asahina Pass?"Raichou"From that direction also, certainly. But to move a large army through quickly, that route is most inconvenient."Raichou"The main attack, I think, will come elsewhere."Doushin"...Yes. Then... that would mean..."Doushin"Here, perhaps."
ja:
童心「進駐軍横須賀艦隊と思われる艦群は、相模
湾内防線を突破後、小坪こつぼ軍港を急襲。
　小坪に駐留する我が方の主力艦隊に損害を
与え――」童心「小坪側が反撃態勢を整えると、それを見計
らっていたように撤収。
　現在は飯島崎と大崎の間に封鎖線を張り、
小坪の残存艦隊を港に押し込めており申す」雷蝶「……押し込めてるだけ？」童心「さよう」茶々丸「はァ？
　何がしたいんだあいつら」茶々丸「小坪の艦隊が動けなくなったらそりゃ痛い
けど。
　向こうが封鎖以外なにもしないんだったら、
艦隊を動かす必要がそもそもねえぞ」童心「むろん、他方面での行動を妨害させぬため
に封じておるのでござろうが……」雷蝶「まさか、あいつらの狙いは鎌倉ではないと
いうの？
　他の都市を襲うつもり？」茶々丸「んなアホな」童心「鎌倉を占領し、普陀楽を陥とし、六波羅を
壊滅に追い込む。
　ＧＨＱが遂に動いたからには、他の目的は
考えられぬ」童心「しかし――」茶々丸「ならどうしてさっさと小坪港を叩き潰して
上陸してこねえのかって話だな。
　……小坪攻撃は陽動か？」童心「本隊は……
　横浜基地から陸路、朝比奈峠を越えて攻め
寄せてくる？」雷蝶「勿論そちらからも来るでしょうけれど……。
　そのルートは大兵力を素早く展開するには
不都合です」雷蝶「本命は別かと」童心「……で、ござるな。
　と――――なると……」童心「ここかの」

en: Doushin Yusa's thick finger followed a line on the map.
ja: 遊佐童心の太い指が、地図上の線・をなぞった。

en: Raichou"...The Shounan coast?"Chachamaru"Arre, arre, arre. How are you landing a whole bloody army THERE, bhosdike? What genius!"Chachamaru"Is what I would very much LIKE to say. Unfortunately there was some helpful weapon for exactly this situation, wasn't there?"Doushin"Indeed. Landing ships. The British Commonwealth has used them since the last great war."Raichou"I had heard they were not particularly effective."Doushin"Perhaps they have learned from the failures and improved them. For a nation so occupied with invading, this would be a weapon worth studying in considerable depth."Doushin"To attack a properly fortified port, one must be prepared for heavy losses. But land on a lightly defended shore, and those losses can be much smaller."Chachamaru"...And lightly defended it is. Zaimokuza, Yuigahama, Shichirigahama."Chachamaru"Not completely empty, haan. But perfect? That word should not come anywhere near our defences."Raichou"Against a major landing operation, they are quite inadequate. GHQ surely knows that much."Doushin"..."Chachamaru"Then... they're coming."Raichou"Yes."Chachamaru"Send reinforcements to the beaches?"Doushin"No useful purpose would be served. We have been caught by surprise. A force large enough to send immediately, we do not have in the first place."Doushin"And even if we managed to deploy it along the coast, our knowledge of how to repel a large-scale landing is insufficient."Chachamaru"So we'll be standing in the sand going kya karein, and they'll flatten us? Arre, no need to be THAT pessimistic."Raichou"They will certainly have trained thoroughly. If victory goes to whoever has made more mistakes and learned from them, we are at a disadvantage."Chachamaru"...Haan. That I can't argue with."Doushin"We have no choice but to give up defending the coast of the bay."Kageaki"Forgive the interruption. ...Are we not considering a way to break the blockade of Kotsubo?"
ja:
雷蝶「……湘南海岸？」茶々丸「おいおいおい。
　そんなとこから一体どーやって大軍を上陸
させるっつーのさ。ばっかでー」茶々丸「と言いたいのは山々ですが、なんかそんな
時にお役立ちの兵器がありましたね？」童心「いかにも。
　揚陸艦……大英連邦では先の大戦の頃より
使われており申す」雷蝶「あまり有効ではなかったと聞いていますが」童心「失敗を糧に改良したのではござらんかな。
　かの侵略国家にとっては、大いに研究する
価値のある兵器でござれば」童心「防御設備の整った港への攻撃は多大な犠牲
を覚悟せねばならぬ。
　しかし、手薄な海岸から上陸できれば損害
はずっと少なくなる」茶々丸「……実際、手薄だよな。
　材木座、由比ヶ浜、七里ヶ浜」茶々丸「がら空きってほどじゃねえけど、完璧とは
とても言えん」雷蝶「大規模な上陸作戦に対する防備はまったく
不十分ね。
　ＧＨＱもそれくらいは知っているでしょう」童心「…………」茶々丸「てことは……来るな」雷蝶「ええ」茶々丸「海岸に増援を出すか？」童心「無益でござる。
　奇襲された今、すぐ動かせる充分な規模の
兵力というのがそもそもござらぬし」童心「仮に兵力を海岸線へ展開するのに成功した
としても、我らには大規模上陸作戦に対する
迎撃の専門知識ノウハウが不足しており申す」茶々丸「砂浜でまごついてる間に潰されるってか。
　そこまで悲観的にならなくてもいいと思う
けどな」雷蝶「向こうは間違いなく充分な訓練をこなして
きているわ。
　失敗の数・・・・で勝敗が決まるとしたら、こちら
の分が悪いわよ」茶々丸「……そりゃ違いない」童心「湾岸防衛は諦めるしかござらん」景明「御無礼。
　……小坪港の封鎖を破る方法は検討しない
のですか？」

en:
I could not keep quiet, so I asked.
These leaders seemed to have discarded that option before the discussion even began.

This I could not accept. I was not asking the surviving Kotsubo fleet to stake everything on one desperate gamble. Bring in another fleet from nearby. Attack from outside and inside together.

Surely every shogunate fleet in the waters around Sagami Bay had not gathered at Kotsubo. The whole navy could not be attending one function.
Free Kotsubo, and immediately the occupation army's landing operation would become a very doubtful business.
ja:
黙っていられず、俺は訊いてみた。
　どうもこの首脳達は、最初からその選択を放棄して
いる様子である。

　俺としては納得しかねた。
　何も小坪港の残存艦隊に乾坤一擲の勝負を挑めとは
言わない――近場の別艦隊に来援させ、内外から攻め
れば良いのだ。

　真逆、相模湾近海の幕府艦隊が全て小坪に集結して
いたという事はないだろう。
　そうして小坪が解放されれば、進駐軍の上陸作戦は
途端に危うくなる。

en: Chachamaru"If we had a fleet we could send, bhai, we would send it."Kageaki"...We do not?"Chachamaru"Fleet is there. Nearby, for example, the Enoshima fast fleet."Kageaki"Then send that—"
ja:
茶々丸「動かせる艦隊があればそうするんだけどね」景明「……無いのですか？」茶々丸「艦隊ならあるさ。
　近場では江ノ島の高速艦隊とか」景明「ならそれを――」

en: Chachamaru"That Enoshima fleet, na. Some completely inexplicable accident destroyed it a little while ago. Who can understand these things? Repairs aren't finished yet."Chachamaru"So sending it to the rescue is not an available service."Kageaki"............I see."
ja:
茶々丸「ちょっと前にわけわからんアクシデント・・・・・・・・・・・・で
壊滅しちゃっててねー。江ノ島の艦隊。
　復旧がまだ済んでないんだわ」茶々丸「だもんで救援に行かせるのは無理なの」景明「…………そうですか」

en: Chachamaru"Other fleets are there. Big enough to face the Yokohama and Yokosuka fleets... first candidate would be the one stationed off the southern Bousou Peninsula."Kageaki"What about that one?"Chachamaru"Very easy to send. Very, very easy. But—"Raichou"...Send it and wear it down, and you leave the Pacific approaches entirely undefended."Chachamaru"Bas. That is the problem."
ja:
茶々丸「他にも艦隊はあるけどね。
　横浜・横須賀艦隊に対抗できそうな規模と
なると……房総半島南部の駐留艦隊が筆頭か
な」景明「そちらは？」茶々丸「動かすのはとても簡単。
　でも」雷蝶「……それを動かして消耗させてしまったら、
太平洋方面が丸きり無防備になるでしょう」茶々丸「つーこと」

en:
Ah. Of course.
The occupation forces—the League's forces—did not begin at Yokohama and end at Yokosuka. My helpful plan had forgotten the small matter of the rest of the bloody world.

From the southern seas, from the continent, reinforcements could come in any quantity. Finish one army and another might arrive asking where to put its luggage. Nobody had promised us, bas, these are all the enemies, please defeat them at your convenience.

And the fleet guarding those approaches, I wanted to bring into Sagami Bay. Very good, Kageaki. Close the door against the man in front, remove the whole back wall to obtain the timber.

Nahi. That fleet could not be dragged away.
ja:
そうか。
　進駐軍――連盟軍の戦力は、横浜・横須賀両基地に
あるだけで全てではない。

　南洋から、あるいは大陸から、来援は幾らでも押し
寄せてくる可能性がある。
　それに備えるための艦隊を、相模湾に引き込む事は
できない……。

en: Doushin"Then our basic policy is to meet the enemy here at Fudaraku. Are we agreed?"Raichou"Yes."Chachamaru"By elimination, haan. Every other choice has kindly removed itself."Doushin"Then let us confirm the deployment of our own forces. First—"
ja:
童心「基本方針はこの普陀楽で敵を迎え撃つ、と
いうことでよろしゅうござるかな」雷蝶「はい」茶々丸「消去法の選択だけどな」童心「では、我が方の戦力配置を確認いたそう。
　まず――」

en:
As the Lord of Koga led the discussion, I listened and went over what I knew of Fudaraku's military strength.

First: the Fudaraku Castle Corps.
Directly under the lord of the castle, at present Shirou Kuniuji Ashikaga. In name, his army. In practice, he was not yet old enough to command one, so the senior retainer Doushin Yusa carried out those duties.

Second: the Koga contingent.
A detachment from the Koga lordship's army, stationed at Fudaraku. Command naturally belonged to Doushin Yusa, Lord of Koga, or his representative.

Third: the Oyumi contingent.
Troops dispatched by the Oyumi lordship. Being in a position to send forces to Fudaraku relatively quickly, Oyumi maintained a somewhat larger detachment than the other lordships.

Fourth: the Horigoe contingent.
Horigoe's dispatched troops, under Chachamaru's command. Perhaps because Horigoe's finances were so comfortable, their supplies were excellent. Other units often became jealous. Even in an army, somebody else's comforts must give people pain. Irrelevant just now.

Fifth: the Sasagawa contingent.
Under Shishiku Ootori, troops detached to Fudaraku from the Aizu-Sasagawa army, reputed to be Rokuhara's very finest.

These five formations made up Fudaraku's permanent forces. Rokuhara's central army. No larger military force existed in Kanto.

Largest in Kanto, yes. Enough to match GHQ alone, no.
To fight on equal terms, reinforcements from the regional armies were required.
ja:
古河公方主導の談義を耳で聴きつつ。
　俺は普陀楽の軍事力に関する知識を反芻した。

　第一は普陀楽城衆。
　普陀楽城主直轄の軍団だ。現在は足利四郎邦氏隷下
となる……が、彼はまだ一軍の指揮に耐える年齢では
ないため、宿老遊佐童心が実務を代行している。

　第二は古河領衆。
　古河公方府の軍兵から一部を割いて普陀楽城に駐留
させているものである。指揮は当然古河公方遊佐童心、
又はその代理の者が執る。

　第三は小弓領衆。
　小弓公方府よりの派遣軍である。他の公方府よりも
比較的早く普陀楽城へ兵力を送れる環境にあるため、
規模も他の派遣軍よりやや大きい。

　第四、堀越領衆。
　堀越公方府の派遣軍であり、指揮権は茶々丸が持つ。
堀越の富裕な財政を反映してか兵站の面で優れ、しば
しば他部隊にやっかまれる――今はどうでもいいが。

　第五は篠川領衆。
　大鳥獅子吼の指揮下、六波羅最精鋭と謳われる会津
篠川軍団より分かれて普陀楽に詰める将兵である。

　この五つの軍集団が普陀楽の常駐戦力を構成する。
　これは六波羅の中央軍であり、関東地方に存在する
軍事力として最大のものだ。

　が――それでも、独力ではＧＨＱに拮抗しかねる。
　互角に戦うには地方軍の来援を得なくてはならない。

en:
Koga, Oyumi, Sasagawa, Horigoe.
The Four Great Kubo of Kanto. Their reinforcements were what we needed...
ja:
つまりは古河、小弓、篠川、堀越。
　この関東四公方からの援軍が必要である……。

en: Doushin"I have already sent the order to Koga. Although..."Doushin"Most probably it will come to nothing."Raichou"I have informed my Oyumi also... Yes. Expectations should not be raised."Chachamaru"Koga and Oyumi are badly placed. If GHQ's staff have brains for use and not just decoration, they've taken precautions already."Chachamaru"Wouldn't surprise me if Oyumi's sitting in the same mess as Kotsubo port by now."Raichou"Well... probably so."Doushin"That leaves Horigoe and Sasagawa."Chachamaru"Don't get too excited about my Horigoe army either. Right now we're not in a position to send tens of thousands straight to Kamakura."Chachamaru"Any sensible reckoning, the occupation army blocks the Toukaidou before we get there."Raichou"...That Okabe rebellion does insist on haunting us."Chachamaru"Not the only reason, though."Doushin"Then, after all—"Chachamaru"Shishiku. He's the only one left we can rely on."Raichou"...Yes."
ja:
童心「古河への指令は先刻出しており申す。
　とは、いえ」童心「まず無駄でござろうの」雷蝶「麿の小弓にも伝えていますけれど……
　ええ。期待はできませんわね」茶々丸「古河と小弓は位置が悪いからな。
　ＧＨＱの参謀にまともな頭があれば、手は
打ってる」茶々丸「小弓なんて今頃はもう小坪港と似たような
ことになってんじゃねーの？」雷蝶「まぁ……そうでしょうね」童心「残るは堀越と篠川でござるが」茶々丸「堀越軍あてのとこにもあんまし期待すんな。
　万単位の兵力をすぐさま鎌倉まで寄越せる
ような環境じゃねえんだよ、今」茶々丸「普通に考えて、進駐軍あっちに東海道を塞がれる
方が早い」雷蝶「……なんかやたらと岡部の反乱が祟るわね」茶々丸「そればっかが理由じゃないけどな」童心「となると、やはり」茶々丸「頼みになるのは獅子吼だけってこった」雷蝶「…………そうね」

en:
Shishiku Ootori's Sasagawa army.
The largest regional force. In size and strength, only Fudaraku's central army stood above it.

If it reached Fudaraku, the balance between Rokuhara and GHQ would move a good deal closer to even.

One condition, however. There was always one condition.
ja:
大鳥獅子吼の篠川公方府軍。
　普陀楽の中央軍に次ぐ規模と実力を有する、最大の
地方軍である。

　これが普陀楽に到着すれば、六波羅とＧＨＱの戦力
比は五分に大きく近付くだろう。

　しかし、それには条件が一つあった。

en: Chachamaru"Shishiku has to reach Aizu, gather the army... then bring it back here. How many days is that going to take?"Doushin"..."Chachamaru"Three days? Whichever way you twist it, bhai, no."Raichou"And then... there is the question of how long Koga itself remains standing."
ja:
茶々丸「獅子吼が会津にたどり着いて、それから軍
をまとめて……こっちへ引っ返してくるのに
何日掛かるかだ」童心「…………」茶々丸「どう考えても、三日じゃ無理だよなァ」雷蝶「それに……
　古河公方府がいつまで健在でいるか」

en:
Yes.
Almost certainly, part of the occupation army was already on its way to bring Koga under control.

If Koga fell, the Sasagawa army would lose its road to Kamakura.
Fudaraku would be alone.

...At that point, defeat would probably be all but decided. Hardly any room left even for a hopeful mistake.
ja:
そう。
　古河公方府を押さえるため、進駐軍の一部がそちら
へ向かっているのはまず間違いない。

　古河が陥ちれば、篠川軍は鎌倉への道を失う。
　普陀楽は孤立する。

　……その時点で、敗北はほぼ確定するだろう。

en: Watchtower《Tendaisan observation tower to Air Defence Headquarters! Unidentified flying object approaching!》Watchtower《No response to the warning to withdraw. Appropriate action required, please!》Watchtower《Wavelength indicates an airship. Air Defence Headquarters, action is being requested!》
ja:
監視塔《天台山てんだいさん監視塔より防空本部！
　未確認飛行物体接近！》監視塔《退去勧告には反応なし。
　適切な対処を乞う！》監視塔《波長から物体は飛行艦と推定される。
　防空本部、対処を乞う！》

en: Air Defense Soldier A《Captain sir, two o'clock!》Air Defense Commander《...That one?》
ja: 防空隊Ａ《隊長、二時の方向です！》防空隊長《……あれか》

en: Air Defense Soldier A《—The Galley Keep! The fortress in the sky!!》Air Defense Soldier B《S-so THIS is the world's biggest airship...》Air Defense Commander《GHQ, bloody bastards. They mean it. They've actually come to finish Rokuhara.》Air Defense Soldier B《What do we do, Captain sir?!》Air Defense Commander《Only that one enemy craft?》Air Defense Soldier A《Yes, sir. One ship only. No other readings nearby.》Air Defense Soldier A《...Though inside that stomach, sir, I can't imagine there isn't a whole crowd of dragoons.》Air Defense Commander《Fight it head-on? Madness. But letting that thing near Fudaraku Castle, that also we cannot do.》Air Defense Commander《Hit, pull back, hit again. Keep stopping its advance. Until reinforcements come, somehow or other you HOLD!》Air Defense Soldier B《Understood!》
ja:
防空隊Ａ《――〝空の要塞ガレーキープ〟!!》防空隊Ｂ《こ、これが世界最大の飛行艦か……》防空隊長《ＧＨＱめ。本気だな。
　本気で六波羅を潰しに来やがった》防空隊Ｂ《どうしますか、隊長!?》防空隊長《敵騎はあれだけか？》防空隊Ａ《はッ、一隻のみです。
　付近に他の反応はありません》防空隊Ａ《……もっとも、あいつの腹に竜騎兵の群れ
が詰まっていないとは思えませんが》防空隊長《まともに戦うのは無謀だな。
　しかし、あんなものを普陀楽城に近づける
わけにはいかん》防空隊長《一撃離脱の繰り返しで足を止めるぞ。
　増援が来るまで何としても粘れ！》防空隊Ｂ《了解！》

en: Air Defense Commander《————KYA?!》Air Defense Soldier A《Wh-where did these fellows come from?!》
ja: 防空隊長《――――何ッッ!?》防空隊Ａ《こっ……こいつら、何処から!?》

en: Air Defense Commander《This thing—shit! It's THOSE, is it?!》Air Defense Commander《Stealth Draco!!》
ja: 防空隊長《こいつ――糞、あれかッッ》防空隊長《隠形竜騎兵ステルスドラコ!!》

en: Cannon"Deployment complete on all fronts. Losses so far: zero."Willow"Good..."Willow"Attack begins at dawn. Make sure every officer and man at the front understands: the civilian districts are not to be dragged into it."Willow"If WE become the villains, then what is the point of the whole exercise?"Cannon"Understood."
ja:
キャノン「全方面、予定の配置を完了しました。
　現時点での損害は皆無ゼロです」ウィロー「良し……」ウィロー「夜明けと共に攻撃開始だ。
　市街地を巻き込まないよう、前線の将兵に
注意を徹底しておけ」ウィロー「我々が悪者になっては何の意味もないから
な」キャノン「わかっています」

en:
November 30
5:57 a.m.
ja:
一一月三〇日
　　　　　　　　　午前五時五七分

en: Oyumi Liaison《Oyumi lordship headquarters speaking! The occupation fleet has control of the inner bay. We are being shelled...!》Oyumi Liaison《Cannot sortie! Not possible!》
ja:
小弓連絡《こちら小弓公方府！
　現在、内湾を制圧した進駐軍艦隊により、
砲撃を受けている……！》小弓連絡《出撃は不可能！》

en: Koga Liaison《Koga lordship headquarters. Occupation forces have broken through our air defences. They are overhead and the bombing has begun.》Koga Liaison《Air superiority is with the enemy at present. It appears they mean to bomb away our defensive capability, then attack with the ground forces now approaching.》Koga Liaison《Sending troops to help Fudaraku is not possible from our side!》
ja:
古河連絡《こちら古河公方府。
　進駐軍は当方の防空網を突破、公方府上空
へ侵入し爆撃を開始している》古河連絡《現在、航空優勢は敵軍に有り。
　敵は空爆によって公方府の防衛能力を剥奪
したのち、接近中の陸上戦力をもって攻撃を
行う模様である》古河連絡《当方、普陀楽へ支援の兵を派遣し得る状況
にあらず！》

en: Fleet Adjutant"Bunkers and gun batteries almost entirely silenced. Shoreline obstacles cleared in the required areas also!"Fleet Commander"Good. Send in the LST tank-landing ships. Dragoons down. Suppress the positions still holding out."Fleet Adjutant"Yes, sir."Fleet Commander"Begin the landing!"
ja:
艦隊副官「防御点バンカー、砲台、ほぼ沈黙しました。
　水際障害物も所要範囲の駆逐は完了！」艦隊司令「よろしい。戦車揚陸艦ＬＳＴを出せ。
　竜騎兵ドラグーンは降下させろ。残存ポイントの制圧
だ」艦隊副官「はっ」艦隊司令「上陸を開始する!!」

en: Asahina Pass Soldier《Kanazawa road, Asahina Pass checkpoint! Occupation forces are attacking us!》Asahina Pass Soldier《Reinforcements, urgently! Send help!》Asahina Pass Soldier《Urgen—》
ja:
朝比奈峠兵《金沢街道、朝比奈峠関門！
　現在、進駐軍による攻撃を受けている！》朝比奈峠兵《至急来援を乞う！》朝比奈峠兵《至急

en: Chachamaru"Oho. Look at the full tamasha they're making."Raichou"Humiliating... To take Fudaraku's skies so easily! As though we had left them out for collection!"Chachamaru"Looks like they used those new stealth dragoons for a surprise attack and broke through the air defences. Kya karein, yaar."Doushin"Stealth Draco. Of their existence I was aware, of course..."Doushin"That the occupation army had assembled so many together, however... that was a little outside my expectations."Raichou"Yes—"
ja:
茶々丸「おーおー。
　派手にやりやがる」雷蝶「屈辱ね……。
　こんなにもあっさりと、普陀楽の空を押さ
えられるなんて！」茶々丸「隠形竜騎兵しんへいきの特性を生かした奇襲で防空網
を突破してきたみたいだからな、連中。
　どっしょもねえわ」童心「隠形竜騎兵ステルスドラコか。
　存在はむろん知っておったが……」童心「これだけの、まとまった数を進駐軍が用意
していたというのはちと予想外でしたのう」雷蝶「ええ――」

en: Raichou"—Ah, BAS! Our own dragoons are completely useless!"Raichou"How long will they let that enormous airship sit on our heads? Is it paying RENT?!"Chachamaru"What can they do? Enemy's above us from the start. Whichever way we fight, we're at a disadvantage."Chachamaru"Plus those Stealth Draco, apparently the radar response is so weak you can miss the fuckers even KNOWING they're there. One careless moment, bas."Raichou"Even so... Oh, this waiting is intolerable!"Raichou"I am going out MYSELF!!"Chachamaru"There, he has spoken. Doushin bhai, what now?"Doushin"...Well. Our own preparations are finally in order."Doushin"Let us take the lead ourselves and move the troops. Will that be agreeable?"Chachamaru"Chalo."Raichou"Of course!"
ja:
雷蝶「――ああ、もう！
　それにしてもこちらの竜騎兵は不甲斐ない
ったらないわね！」雷蝶「いつまで大型飛行艦あんなものを頭の上に居座らせて
おく気なのよッ！」茶々丸「仕方ねえだろ。
　最初から上を取られてる状況での勝負じゃ、
どうしたってこっちが不利だ」茶々丸「おまけにあの隠形竜騎兵ステルスドラコ、いるのがわかっ
ててもうっかりしてると見逃しちまうくらい
探査機能レーダーへの反応が悪いらしいかんな」雷蝶「それにしたって……
　ああ、じれったい！」雷蝶「麿が出るわ!!」茶々丸「ってさ。
　どうする、童心坊？」童心「……さようでござるな。
　こちらもようやく態勢が整ったところ」童心「我らが先頭に立ち、兵を動かすといたそう。
　よろしゅうござるか？」茶々丸「あいよ」雷蝶「勿論です！」

en: Doushin"The enemy struck Shichirigahama and Yuigahama. It appears they silenced the batteries by air bombardment and naval gunfire, then brought forward their landing ships and came ashore."Doushin"A short engagement, and our coastal defences were finished. That is the situation."
ja:
童心「敵は七里ヶ浜及び由比ヶ浜を強襲。
　空爆と艦砲射撃によって砲台を沈黙させた
後、揚陸艦を押し立てて上陸を実行した模様
でござる」童心「短時間の戦闘でこちらの湾岸防衛は壊滅」

en: Doushin"The force landed at Shichirigahama is moving north along the Fujisawa road. The Yuigahama force appears to be passing through Wakamiya Boulevard onto the Kamakura road, making for Fudaraku."Chachamaru"...Through Wakamiya Boulevard? That's straight through the middle of Kamakura!"Chachamaru"So they've reached 'fuck the citizens, we're taking Yamato anyway' now?"Doushin"No, no. Not so. They first sent dragoons ahead to secure Wakamiya Boulevard."Doushin"Meanwhile, it seems, the main force advanced and filled the whole boulevard at one go. With soldiers and armoured vehicles packed into the road, citizens would hardly approach it for pleasure..."Doushin"In consequence, no harm to civilians has occurred. The advance dragoons' calls to stay indoors, and the road closures, presumably also had their effect."Chachamaru"...Saale. So fucking efficient it's irritating."
ja:
童心「七里ヶ浜より上陸せし軍集団は藤沢街道を
北上。
　由比ヶ浜より上陸の部隊は若宮大路を抜け、
鎌倉街道へ出て普陀楽を目指すようでござる」茶々丸「……若宮大路を抜けてくるのか？
　鎌倉の市街地中央突破じゃねーか」茶々丸「奴ら、市民に憎まれても大和を分捕るって
とこまで開き直ったのかよ」童心「いやいや、さにあらず。
　進駐軍はまず竜騎兵を先行させて若宮大路
を確保」童心「その間に本隊を進め、一気に大路を埋めて・・・
しまった様子。
　となれば、兵や装甲車でぎっしりの大路に
好んで近付く市民もおらず……」童心「結果的に市民の被害は出ており申さぬ。
　先行した竜騎兵による市民への外出自粛の
呼び掛けと通行止めの措置も功を奏したので
ござろう」茶々丸「……ムカつくくらい手際のいいやっちゃな」

en: Doushin"Those two forces will shortly reach the outskirts of Fudaraku. Separately, a third has just broken through Asahina Pass. It appears to intend an attack on Kamakura by way of the Kanazawa road."
ja:
童心「二つの軍集団は間もなく普陀楽外縁に来襲。
　そしてこれとは別にもう一つの軍集団が、
先刻朝比奈峠を突破……金沢街道より鎌倉を
襲うつもりらしゅうござる」

en: Chachamaru"That one's the follow-up, na. Probably there to occupy Kamakura and secure the supply lines."Raichou"Yes. For the present, we may set that one aside."Raichou"Our difficulty is the TWO arriving immediately."Chachamaru"Oofuna and Fujisawa approaches, then."Doushin"Indeed. Now, what shall we do..."Raichou"Lord Doushin, please remain in the inner citadel. Take command of the Fudaraku Castle Corps and see to the air defence."Raichou"I shall lead the Oyumi contingent toward Oofuna."Chachamaru"Then apun and the Horigoe contingent take Fujisawa. Koga and Sasagawa stay in reserve."
ja:
茶々丸「こいつは後詰だな。
　鎌倉の占領と補給線の確保のための軍だろ」雷蝶「そうね。
　とりあえず、これは考えなくていいわ」雷蝶「問題は、すぐに来る二つ」茶々丸「大船口と藤沢口か」童心「うむ。
　さて、如何いたそうか……」雷蝶「童心様は本丸にお留まり下さい。
　普陀楽城衆を指揮して防空をお願いします」雷蝶「麿は小弓領衆を率いて大船方面へ向かいま
しょう」茶々丸「なら、あてと堀越領衆は藤沢口か。
　古河と篠川の領衆は予備」

en: Raichou"Yes. Lord Doushin, your view?"Doushin"...Very well. I entrust this to you both."Doushin"No comfortable duty I am giving you."Raichou"Leave it to me. The castle my father built, I am not handing over to foreign barbarians!"
ja:
雷蝶「ええ。
　童心様、いかが？」童心「……よろしゅうござる。
　御二方、お頼みいたしますぞ」童心「難儀な役目でござるが」雷蝶「お任せ下さい。
　お父様の築かれた城を夷狄の手に渡したり
するものですか！」

en: Chachamaru"Hmm-hmm."Raichou"...What?"Chachamaru"Nothing. Just thinking, Raichou, you've started looking properly alive."Chachamaru"This is more your line, isn't it? Politics-sholitics, conspiracy and all that headache—leave it. Nice simple war, everybody can understand."Raichou"........................"Raichou"Yes. Perhaps you are right."Doushin"Huh-huh..."Chachamaru"Good, good. Then apun should also put some josh into it."Chachamaru"Plan is like this, then? Hold the castle till Shishiku comes back. Reinforcements arrive, we counterattack—"Chachamaru"Kick the besiegers out, then hit Yokohama."Raichou"...That will do, won't it? Accomplish that, and we have won."Doushin"Indeed. I believe that course will serve."Chachamaru"Haan."Chachamaru(...Not that we actually need to go that far.)
ja:
茶々丸「ふふーん」雷蝶「……何よ？」茶々丸「いや。
　なんか雷蝶さん、生き生きしてきたなーと
思って」茶々丸「おめーやっぱり、こっちのが向いてんじゃ
ねえの？
　セージだのインボーだのより、単純明快な
わっかりやすいセンソーの方がさ」雷蝶「……………………」雷蝶「そうね。
　そうかもしれないわ」童心「ふっふぅ……」茶々丸「よしよし。
　あても張り切るとしよっかね」茶々丸「方針はこんな感じでいいのか？
　獅子吼が戻るまで城を支える。で、援軍が
来たら反攻――」茶々丸「攻城軍を蹴散らして横浜を討つ」雷蝶「……いいんじゃない？
　そうしてしまえば、こちらの勝ちよ」童心「で、ござるの。
　その方針でよろしかろうと存ずる」茶々丸「あぁ」茶々丸（……ま、そこまでやる必要はないんだけど）

en: Chachamaru went on, keeping her voice for my ears alone.
ja: 俺にだけ聴こえる声で、茶々丸は続けた。

en: Chachamaru(But look who we're up against, bhai. Fight meaning to do ALL that, and perhaps we only just get an even contest. Perhaps.)Kageaki(...Yes. True.)
ja:
茶々丸（相手が相手だ。
　そこまでやる気で戦って、やっとこ対等まともな
勝負になるかどうかってとこだと思うよ）景明（……そうだな）

en:
The League's occupation forces in Yamato.
More troops than Rokuhara to begin with. Better equipment in almost every branch except the dragoons.

A formidable enemy. Every time one counted, the answer remained inconvenient.
ja:
国際連盟大和進駐軍。
　まず兵力で六波羅に勝り、竜騎兵を除くほぼ全ての
兵科において装備面でも優越する――

　大敵である。

en: GHQ Spokesperson《Citizens of Kamakura, kindly listen. We, the occupation forces, have absolutely no intention of causing you any harm.》GHQ Spokesperson《We are here to liberate you.》GHQ Spokesperson《The Rokuhara shogunate is not a lawful government recognised by the International League for Universal Peace and Prosperity. It is an unlawful organisation of plunderers, using military force to rule over you and make you suffer.》GHQ Spokesperson《We, the occupation forces in Yamato, will remove Rokuhara and restore your rightful rights...》GHQ Spokesperson《Citizens, please follow the instructions of the patrolling soldiers. Kindly do not go out. Remain at your residence, place of work, nearest shop, or similar premises.》GHQ Spokesperson《If you go outside, you may become involved in the fighting. Going outside is therefore not advised. Please remain inside.》GHQ Spokesperson《With your cooperation, the occupation forces will certainly ensure the safety of Kamakura. Fighting with Rokuhara will be confined to the surroundings of Fudaraku Castle and should conclude in a very short time.》GHQ Spokesperson《Kindly bear with us for a little while. Citizens, your cooperation is requested.》GHQ Spokesperson《In case of shortage of food or other daily necessities, please inform the patrolling soldiers. The required quantity will be supplied...》
ja:
ＧＨＱ広報《鎌倉市民の皆様。
　我々進駐軍は、皆様に危害を加える意図は
一切ありません》ＧＨＱ広報《我々はあなた方を解放します》ＧＨＱ広報《六波羅幕府は、国際統和共栄連盟の承認を
受けた正当な政府ではありません。
　軍事力を背景にあなた方を支配し苦しめて
いる、不当な収奪集団です》ＧＨＱ広報《我々大和進駐軍は六波羅を排除し、あなた
方の正当な権利を回復します……》ＧＨＱ広報《市民の皆様、巡回中の兵士の指示に従って
下さい。
　外出を控え、自宅、勤務地、最寄の店舗等
で待機して下さい》ＧＨＱ広報《外出されますと、戦闘に巻き込まれる恐れ
があります。
　外出は控えて下さい》ＧＨＱ広報《市民の皆様のご協力を頂ければ、進駐軍は
鎌倉市の安全を間違いなく確保いたします。
　六波羅との戦闘は普陀楽城の周辺のみで、
ごく短期間の内に終結するでしょう》ＧＨＱ広報《皆様、しばらくのご辛抱をお願いします。
　市民の皆様、ご協力をお願いします》ＧＨＱ広報《食料等、生活必需品が不足している場合は、
巡回の兵士にお申し付け下さい。
　必要分を配給いたします……》

en: Chief"Those are not the troops that came up from the coast."Prince Maidono"Direct from Yokohama by land, you think?"Chief"Most likely."Prince Maidono"Not many of them, though. Equipment also looks light, na."Chief"Presumably they have sent the civilian-relations team ahead to settle people's nerves. The main force may be coming behind."Prince Maidono"So, Kamakura is getting occupied..."Chief"Very efficient work. They must have planned it in minute detail and practiced thoroughly somewhere."Chief"They seem to be avoiding confrontations with the citizens most skillfully."Prince Maidono"Achha. Well, that much is good. But..."Prince Maidono"What a situation we have landed in, yaar."Chief"Indeed. Though thanks to it, we ourselves were saved..."Prince Maidono"Can't exactly start celebrating, can we."Chief"No."Prince Maidono"Your station, everything all right there?"Chief"I sent a messenger earlier. Told them to follow the occupation forces' instructions."Chief"And if any troublesome cooperation is requested, they are to use my absence as protection and keep the answer pending. Very politely, very pending."Prince Maidono"Arre, good. Your absence is doing useful work."Chief"..."
ja:
署長「あれは海岸から上がって来た軍集団とは別
ですね」舞殿宮「横浜から、陸路で直接来た連中かな？」署長「おそらく」舞殿宮「数は少ないようやけど。
　装備も軽そうな感じやね」署長「市民の動揺を鎮めるための宣撫班だけ先に
寄越したのでしょう。
　後から本隊が来るのでは」舞殿宮「鎌倉は占領されるか……」署長「大した手際ですよ。
　余程に綿密な計画を立て、何処かで訓練も
積んでいたに違いありません」署長「市民との衝突は巧妙に避けられているよう
です」舞殿宮「そうか。ま、それは何よりや。
　けど……」舞殿宮「えらいことになったねえ」署長「全くです。
　お陰で救われもしましたが……」舞殿宮「喜んでもいられんなァ」署長「はい」舞殿宮「署の方はええんか？」署長「先程、使いをやりました。
　進駐軍の指示に従うよう」署長「何か厄介な協力を求められた場合は、私の
不在を盾にしてうまく返事を引き延ばせとも
言ってあります」舞殿宮「そらええな」署長「…………」

en: Prince Maidono"Kikuchi..."Chief"Yes?"Prince Maidono"It has started, hasn't it..."Chief"...Yes. Unfortunately."Prince Maidono"War starting—that one thing, I wanted to avoid."Chief"Now there is no helping it. The situation is what it is; we must accept it."Chief"Then do the best we can within it. That much remains in our hands."Prince Maidono"Haan. Same thing we used to do on the battlefield, long ago."Chief"Yes."Prince Maidono"You think those fellows will come to me also?"Chief"They probably will. We must anticipate what they will ask for, and decide how to respond."Prince Maidono"Hmm... By the way."Prince Maidono"Kuronose Douji and Ichijou, how are they?"Chief"They are receiving treatment inside. Both are armoured warriors, so recovery should not take very long."Prince Maidono"Achha, good. Then..."Chief"Yes?"Prince Maidono"...And our Muramasa didi?"Chief"..."
ja:
舞殿宮「菊池ぃ」署長「はい」舞殿宮「始まってもうたね……」署長「……ええ。残念ながら」舞殿宮「開戦だけは避けたかったんやけど」署長「今はもう、仕方ありません。
　状況は状況として受け入れましょう」署長「その上で、最善を尽くすのみです」舞殿宮「そやな。
　昔、戦場でもそうしとったもんな」署長「はい」舞殿宮「連中、わしんとこにも来るかな」署長「来るでしょう。
　向こうの要望を予測し、対応を考えておか
なくてはなりません」舞殿宮「うん……。
　ところで」舞殿宮「黒瀬童子と、一条さんはどうしてる？」署長「奥で治療を受けています。
　二人とも武者ですから、そう時間は掛けず
回復するでしょう」舞殿宮「そか、ならええ。
　で」署長「はい？」舞殿宮「……村正の姉ちゃんは？」署長「…………」

en:
After some hesitation, I decided to go in human form.

For concealment, the spider shape was better. But even that could not completely deceive an armoured warrior's senses. Found out like that, in the present situation, I might be shot down without the courtesy of a single question.

An armoured steel spider saying, 'Civilian, I am civilian'—who was going to listen?
ja:
迷ったが、結局は人型で行動することに決めた。

　蜘蛛の姿の方が隠形術には優れる。
　しかし武者の感覚まで騙し切れるものではないし、
そうして発見された場合、今の情勢下では問答無用で
撃墜されてしまいかねない。

　甲鉄造りの蜘蛛が自分は民間人だと言い張っても、
耳を貸す者はいないだろう。

en: Muramasa(Mido…)
ja: 村正（御堂は……）

en:
He should have returned to Fudaraku Castle.

Apparently something was changing the whole situation around Kamakura. Or Kanto? The whole of Yamato? How far this trouble extended, I did not know.
The shogunate troops surrounding Kenchouji had withdrawn like the tide. They had not even spared the time to arrest the people inside the temple.

Saved, yes. In that sense, we were saved.

...In my own case, nothing at all was settled.

I had to follow Kageaki.
Follow him—and do what I must, as his tsurugi.
ja:
普陀楽の城へ戻ったはずだった。

　何やらこの鎌倉を――この関東を？　この大和を？
――包む状況が劇的な変化に晒されているらしい。
　建朝寺を囲んだ幕府の一団は、潮が引くように去り、
去るに際して寺の面々を捕らえる手間さえ惜しんだ。

　助かったといえば、助かったのだが。

　……私としては何も解決していない。

　景明を追わなくてはならなかった。
　追い――彼の劒冑として、すべきことをせねばなら
ない。

en:
I kept off the main streets, moving from one narrow alley into the next.

The foreigners now filling Kamakura—neither Yamato people nor Emishi, this occupation army—wanted everyone inside their houses. Stay inside, stay inside. Such concern for my whereabouts. Unfortunately my master was not inside the nearest house, so the instruction was not helping.

Being found would lead to nothing pleasant. In this Emishi form, perhaps they would not attack immediately. But wave me through? Haan, certainly. One strange woman running through a military operation, obviously she must have important personal business. Let her go wherever she likes.

No. They would almost certainly detain me.

And I could not afford detention. Already I had been locked up once; no need to tour the enemy's facilities for comparison. Wait for a chance to slip away? This was a proper army, not a roomful of people who might become distracted if I pointed behind them. Escaping would be far too dangerous.

Better not to be found at all. No encounter, no explanation, no need to discover how much understanding could be squeezed out of a soldier with orders.
ja:
大通りを避け、路地の狭間から狭間へ移る。

　今、鎌倉を埋め尽くしつつある集団――進駐軍とか
呼ばれている、大和人ではなく蝦夷でもない異国人の
軍勢――は、どうやら民衆を家に閉じ込めておきたい
らしい。繰り返される放送がそう告げている。

　見つかると、面白くないことになりそうだった。
　この蝦夷の姿ならいきなり攻撃されることもないだ
ろうが、さりとて見逃してもらえるとも思えない。

　拘束されるのは避けられまいし、そうなっては困る。
　隙を見て抜け出すにしても、歴とした軍隊が相手で
は余りに危険が大き過ぎる。

　細心の注意を払って見つからないよう心掛けるに、
如しくはなかった。

en: Muramasa(This... is the Kobukuroya River, na.)
ja: 村正（これは……小袋谷川こぶくろやがわね）

en:
A river, not especially wide, ran beside the road. I checked it against the map in my head. I had run through this town enough times; getting properly lost would take some effort.

A tributary of the Kashio River, which ran around the outside of Fudaraku Castle.
If this river was here... the castle was close now.

I drove my legs harder and ran.
ja:
道路の傍らにさほど広くもない川が流れているのを
見て、脳裏の地図と突き合わせる。
　この町中は幾度も駆け巡ったから、そう迷うことも
なかった。

　普陀楽城の外周を覆う、柏尾川かしおがわの支流だ。
　ここにこれがあるということは……もう近い。

　足に鞭を入れて、走る。

en: Muramasa"…!"
ja: 村正「……ッッ」

en:
Then I stopped, unable to move.

Fudaraku Castle—
Right in front of me. I could see it. Almost under my nose.

In physical distance, so little remained.

But physical distance was not the whole matter.
In reality, it might as well have been endlessly far away.
ja:
そして、私は立ち竦すくんだ。

　普陀楽城――
　それはもう目前。そこに見えている。目と鼻の先だ。

　物理の上での距離はほんのわずか。

　けれど。
　現実・・の上での距離は、果てしなかった。

en:
Rows of infantry, guns ready.
Cannon with their mouths all facing the same way, spitting fire.
Iron vehicles waiting for their moment to charge.

From the castle walls, gunfire and shellfire came back at them.
Above the drifting smoke, armoured warriors on both sides moved freely through the sky. Clash, separate. Separate, clash again.

The sounds and flashes of steel and fire scattered and vanished. Lives went into that dazzling whirl one after another. One life finished, then the next. No pause between.
Already the Kashio River was taking red into its surface.
ja:
銃を構えた歩兵の隊列。
　筒先を揃えて火を吹く砲門群。
　突進の機を待ち構える鉄の車両。

　それらに向けて放たれる、城壁からの射撃、砲撃。
　噴煙たなびく先の空を見れば、両陣の武者が自在に
舞い、剣を交えては打ち離れ、離れてはまた打ち交え。

　鉄火の響きと輝きを儚く散らし、命を一つまた一つ
と、その繚乱の渦へ沈めてゆく。
　柏尾川の面おもは早くも、朱あけの彩いろを加えられつつあった。

en: Muramasa"...War..."
ja: 村正「……戦争いくさ……」

en:
It had begun.

The vast foreign army on one side.
On the other, the Rokuhara shogunate's forces—with Kageaki among them.

The war between them.
—Already begun. Whatever I still had to do, it had not waited for me.
ja:
始まっている。

　異国の大軍と、
　景明のいる、六波羅幕府の軍勢との戦争が。

　――もう、始まってしまっていた。

en:
The besieging army coming from Fujisawa was following the textbook with full devotion.
First, long-range shelling and bombing by dragoons. Once our defensive fire weakened, send the armoured units forward.

But ours was Fudaraku Fortress, quite shameless in declaring itself the greatest in all Yamato's military history. Between bombardments, it recovered its defences and poured crossfire from the batteries, pushing the enemy back.

Forward, back. Attack, defence. The argument continued, growing louder and fiercer all the time.
ja:
藤沢方面に押し寄せた攻城軍は、定石セオリーに対してごく
忠実であった。
　まず遠距離砲撃と竜騎兵による空爆とで攻め立て、
防御火力を弱らせたところで機甲部隊を前へ出す。

　しかしこちらも、大和戦史上随一を豪語して憚らぬ
普陀楽城塞である。
　爆撃の合間に態勢を回復するや、砲塁から十字砲火
を浴びせ掛け、敵の前進を押し戻す。

　一進一退の攻防が、時につれて激しさを増しながら
続いていた。

en: Kageaki"...The Horigoe contingent is doing good work."Chachamaru"You think so?"Kageaki"Hard to believe they have been away from actual combat for more than six years."Chachamaru"Arre, that much is natural. Not all these fellows spent the six years since the great war sitting idle."Kageaki"...Of course. So many rebellions. Experience putting them down, they would naturally have."Chachamaru"That also. But more the opposite, actually."Kageaki"The opposite...?"Chachamaru"Plenty of my junior officers are fellows who fought the previous Lord of Horigoe. Prison, exile, all that. After I killed the bastard, I gathered them up."Chachamaru"So a hopeless fight against some huge army? Bhai, they've been through that particular chutiyapa before."Kageaki"............I see."
ja:
景明「……堀越領衆はいい働きをするな」茶々丸「そう見える？」景明「実戦から六年以上離れていた軍とは思えん」茶々丸「あー、それは当たり前かな。
　大戦終わってから六年、ヒマしてたやつら
ばっかじゃないしね」景明「……そうか。
　反乱が幾度もあったのだから、鎮圧の経験
もあって当然か」茶々丸「それもだけど。
　どっちかってーと、その逆」景明「逆……？」茶々丸「先代の堀越公方に刃向かって投獄されたり
放逐されたりしてた連中が、尉官クラスには
多いんだ。
　あてが先代ぶっ殺した後で駆り集めたから」茶々丸「連中にしてみれば、大軍相手の絶望的戦闘
なんて、今が初めてじゃないってわけ」景明「…………成程」

en:
With men who had survived that kind of hell commanding the front as lieutenants and captains, the soldiers' lack of panic made sense.
A junior commander's temperament spread very thoroughly into his men. What the officer carried, the troops caught.
ja:
そんな修羅場上がりどもが中尉大尉の立場で最前線
の指揮を担っているのなら、兵に動揺の気配があまり
見受けられないのも頷ける。
　下級指揮官の性質は兵に色濃く反映するものだ。

en: Kageaki"Still—good work they are doing, but..."
ja: 景明「ただ――良くやってはいるが」

en:
I went on speaking without bothering about our difference in rank.
Other staff officers were around, of course, but the battlefield's symphony would hardly let them hear. Even if they did, who had time to investigate my manners now?
No need to worry about that.
ja:
俺は身分差を無視した口調で話を続けた。
　周囲には無論ほかの幕僚もいるが、どうせ戦場から
の交響曲で良く聴こえまいし、聴こえたとしてもこの
状況で追及する余裕はない。気にすることもなかった。

en: Kageaki"Up in the sky, the situation is bad."Chachamaru"Haan..."Kageaki"At this rate our entire air strength will eventually be wiped out."Chachamaru"Fully correct, bhai. Correctness is not the shortage here."
ja:
景明「上空うえの様子がまずい」茶々丸「うん……」景明「このままでは、いずれこちらの航空戦力が
壊滅する」茶々丸「全くその通りなんだけどさ」

en:
She had probably thought of it long before I spoke.
Chachamaru scratched her temple, looking troubled.
ja:
とっくに考えていた事なのだろう。
　茶々丸は悩ましげに、こめかみを掻いた。

en: Chachamaru"At present, solution is what we don't have."Kageaki"None at all?"Chachamaru"As long as THAT is there, what the hell can we do?"
ja: 茶々丸「現状、打開策が無いのよね」景明「全く、か？」茶々丸「あれ・・がいる限りどーにもならんわ」

en:
She pointed to the flying ship sitting far above us.

Not just an airship. Not merely a military airship either.
The largest flying vessel in the world. If being enormous was work, this thing was doing overtime.

A Galley Keep-class heavy airship.
Its bomb load was the largest too, in proportion to its huge body. Its capacity as a dragoon carrier was on the same unmatched scale.

A flying fortress. No exaggeration required.

Itna bada. At some point, surely, the ship had stopped being too large and the sky had become too small. A man should be able to look upward without having to look around a building. If this was permitted, why stop at a fortress? Send the whole country up. Borders, roads, everybody's auntie still watering the plants. Then the enemy could invade the empty patch underneath and we could both announce victory.
ja:
言って茶々丸が指差したのは、頭上遥かに鎮座する
飛行艦だった。

　単なる飛行船、単なる軍用飛行艦ではない。
　世界最大の飛翔する船である。

　ガレーキープ級重飛行艦。
　その巨躯に比例して爆弾積載量も最大、竜騎兵母艦
としての機能もまた同様を誇る。

　まさしく空飛ぶ要塞だ。

en: Chachamaru"That thing works as their base, na. Their dragoons keep the height advantage and come at us again and again. We beat them back, they come back. No end to the fucking service."Chachamaru"Try gathering our forces to storm that flying fortress, and those Stealth Draco come out and screw up the whole effort."Kageaki"..."Kageaki"Really no move left, then."Chachamaru"No move, sir. Full dead end. In modern war, starting late is a very effective way of ending early."Kageaki"In the air, are we losing about four for every one of theirs?"Chachamaru"Could be worse."Kageaki"...Not exactly a solution, but..."Chachamaru"Haan?"Kageaki"What if we bring all our dragoons down?"Chachamaru"...Stop fighting at a disadvantage, save our air strength? Haan, one option."Chachamaru"But then we won't be able to hold this defensive line."Kageaki"The huge fellow up there starts working as a bomber as well as a carrier?"Chachamaru"Exactly. We pull our dragoons down, why WOULDN'T they?"
ja:
茶々丸「あれが基地の役目を果たすから、敵さんの
竜騎兵は高度優勢を確保したまんま何度でも
攻めて来られる。
　こっちはいくら撃退してもきりがない」茶々丸「戦力を集中して城攻め・・・をやろうとすれば、
あの隠形竜騎兵ステルスドラコが出てきて引っ掻き回すしな」景明「…………」景明「本当に手詰まりだな」茶々丸「手詰まりっす。
　立ち上がりの遅れはほんと致命的ですよー、
現代戦だと」景明「航空戦の損害比キルレシオは一対四くらいか？」茶々丸「もっと酷いかも」景明「…………。
　打開策とは言い難いが」茶々丸「あい？」景明「こちらの竜騎兵を全て下ろしてはどうだ？」茶々丸「……分の悪い勝負はやめて航空戦力を保全
する？
　そら、一つの選択だけど」茶々丸「それやると、ここの防衛線を維持できなく
なるよ」景明「空のでかぶつ・・・・が竜騎兵母艦としてだけでは
なく、爆撃艦としても働き始めると？」茶々丸「うん。
　こっちが竜騎兵を下げたら、やらない理由
がないっしょ」

en:
There was a tactic called assault bombing.
With dragoons escorting it, an airship descended low and bombed the enemy positions accurately.

If it worked, the results were considerable. But there was also a serious danger of enemy dragoons or ground-based antiaircraft guns bringing the ship down. Considerable results could happen to the ship as well. The attacker had a serious decision to make.

Grounding our dragoons would reduce the danger for them.
Chachamaru's worry, I understood.
ja:
強襲爆撃という戦術がある。
　護衛竜騎兵に身辺を守らせながら飛行艦が低空まで
降下、敵陣に対して高精度の爆撃を行うというものだ。

　成功すれば戦果は大きいが、敵の竜騎兵による攻撃
や地上からの対空射撃を食らって飛行艦が沈められる
危険もまた大きい。
　行う側にも決断の要る戦法である。

　こちらが竜騎兵を下げれば、敵が強襲爆撃を行うに
当たっての危険を減らしてやる事になるだろう。
　茶々丸の懸念は理解できた。

en: Kageaki"Fair point. But in this particular case, they DO have a reason not to."Chachamaru"...Huh? What reason?"Kageaki"Have you forgotten? What do the occupation forces want?"Kageaki"They had superior strength, yet spent six whole years instead of starting the war at once. Why?"Chachamaru"————"Chachamaru"Oh."
ja:
景明「尤もだ。
　が、今回に限って言えば理由・・はある」茶々丸「……え？　どんな？」景明「忘れたか。
　進駐軍やつらの目的は何だ？」景明「戦力で優るにも関わらずさっさと開戦せず、
六年もの時間を費やしたのは何故だ？」茶々丸「――――」茶々丸「あ」

en: The Lord of Horigoe slapped her own forehead.
ja: 堀越公方は、平手で自分の額を打った。

en: Chachamaru"...Arre, shit. My brain had become pure military idiot."Kageaki"Yes. They are thinking of what comes after winning the war."Kageaki"How to rule with the citizens' support, instead of making enemies of them."Chachamaru"...Bomb Fudaraku's centre, one thing. Bomb the edges, and there's a good chance the damage spreads into the surrounding area. Their own troops, they can pull back."Chachamaru"The land won't get up and move, na. And this Fujisawa approach is closer to the city than much of Fudaraku's perimeter."Kageaki"They have probably evacuated the residents already... but some may not have got out. Fire could spread to districts not yet evacuated. Even if nobody is there, destroy people's neighborhoods and they will hardly think well of you."Kageaki"It would obstruct their postwar rule."Chachamaru"Then they won't do it. At least while they think they're so far ahead they can win without it."Kageaki"Yes. Besides, the advantage in the air is already quite clear. If they intended assault bombing, they would have done it by now."Chachamaru"Correct. ...Tch. My decision came late."Chachamaru"How many died for nothing while my brain was taking its time?"Kageaki"..."Chachamaru"Valuable fighting strength. Have to look after it, even starting now. Thanks, bhai."Kageaki"Yes..."
ja:
茶々丸「……いけね。
　頭が戦争バカになってたや」景明「そうだ。
　奴らは戦争に勝った後の事を考えている」景明「市民を敵に回さず、彼らの支持のもと統治
するためにはどうすれば良いのかをだ」茶々丸「……普陀楽の中心部ならともかく、外縁部
への爆撃は被害が周辺地域にも及ぶ危険性が
高いな。
　味方の軍は下げりゃいいだけの話だが」茶々丸「土地をどかすわけにゃいかねえ。
　で、この藤沢口は普陀楽の外縁でも比較的
市街地に近い」景明「住民は既に避難させているだろうが……
　逃げ遅れもいるだろうし、まだ避難してい
ない地区まで飛び火する事もあろうし、例え
無人でも市街地を破壊するのは心象が悪い」景明「戦後の統治に支障をきたす」茶々丸「となれば、やらねえわな。
　少なくとも自分てめーらが圧倒的に有利で、そこ
までせんでも勝てるって思ってるうちは」景明「ああ。
　大体、空の戦闘の優劣がこれだけはっきり
しているのだ。強襲爆撃をやる気があれば、
とっくにやっている」茶々丸「ごもっとも。
　……ちっ、判断が遅れちまった」茶々丸「この遅れで何人無駄に死んだかな」景明「…………」茶々丸「貴重な戦力だ。今からでも大事にせんとね。
　ありがと、お兄さん」景明「ああ……」

en:
Chachamaru called her staff over and gave them brief orders.
At first they looked surprised. Then, apparently understanding, they scattered in a hurry to carry them out.

Signalmen shouting, messengers running—the noise around us suddenly had still more to say.
ja:
茶々丸は幕僚を呼び寄せ、手短に指示を下した。
　命じられた側は初め驚いたものの、すぐ呑み込んだ
らしく、指示を実行に移すため慌しく散ってゆく。

　通信兵の叫びと駆け回る伝令兵の足音とで、周囲の
喧騒は俄かに厚みを増した。

en: Chachamaru"Still, once we pull the dragoons out, things here get a lot harder. Airship bombing, maybe not. But the bomb-carrying Fire Draco will come visiting in full numbers."Kageaki"Keeping our air strength intact matters more."Chachamaru"No argument there. Other thing to watch for... dropping in to attack, na."Kageaki"The Grapplers? Ground-combat dragoons?"Chachamaru"Haan. I don't think antiaircraft guns will keep those airborne assault fellows out. The dragoons we bring down need to be ready to fight them."Kageaki"Still a fight against the odds... but surely no worse than four of ours for one of theirs."Chachamaru"Our ground, our kind of fight. Some disadvantage we can handle, yaar."
ja:
茶々丸「ただ何にしろ、竜騎兵を引き上げちまうと、
こっちはだいぶ苦しくなるね。
　飛行艦での爆撃は無くても、爆装竜騎兵ファイアードラコは
大挙しておいでなさるだろうし」景明「航空戦力を保持しておく方が重要だろう」茶々丸「そいつは間違いない。
　あと気をつけておかなきゃならんのは……
降下襲撃か」景明「制陸戦用竜騎兵グラップラー？」茶々丸「うん。高射砲であの降下猟兵どもの侵入を
阻止できるとは思えんから。
　下ろした竜騎兵に応戦の用意をさせておく
必要があるな」景明「それも不利な勝負だが……
　損害比一対四より酷くなる事はあるまい」茶々丸「こっちの土俵でこっちの得意な喧嘩になる
からね。
　多少の不利はどーってことない」

en:
While Chachamaru and I talked, the battle kept moving.

Gunfire answered gunfire. Swords struck swords.
People died.

Just kept dying.
No end to it.

A life had the value of dust, of rubbish. Say no, shout no, say it as fiercely as you liked. Lives were still becoming dust and rubbish in front of you. Your objection could do nothing.

This was a battlefield.
A whole world called battlefield. Here, that was how the value was decided.
ja:
俺と茶々丸が話す間にも、戦況は進展してゆく。

　銃火が交わされ、刀剣が打ち合わされ――
　人が死ぬ。

　ひたすらに死んでゆく。
　際限もなく死んでゆく。

　生命の価値は塵芥であった。
　誰がそれに対して否定の叫びを上げようと、事実、
塵となり芥となって失われてゆく生命の前には無力で
あった。

　ここは戦場。
　戦場という世界なのだ。

en: Raichou《The wind has shifted a little, hasn't it?》Oyumi Dragoon A《The Horigoe dragoons seem to have gone down to the ground. Have they given up the air battle, sir?》Raichou《...I see. In its own way, not a bad decision.》Raichou《But MY way is my own! You understand, all of you?》Oyumi Dragoon A《YES, SIR!! LORD RAICHOU! NOBODY STRONGER, NOBODY MORE BEAUTIFUL!!》Oyumi Dragoon B《WE ARE WITH YOU, SIR!!》
ja:
雷蝶《風向きが少し変わったわね？》小弓竜兵Ａ《堀越軍の竜騎兵隊が地上へ降りたようです。
　航空戦を諦めたのでしょうか？》雷蝶《……なるほど。
　それはそれで悪くない判断よ》雷蝶《でも麿には麿のやり方があるわ！
　わかっているわね？　おまえ達》小弓竜兵Ａ《はァッ!!
　誰よりも強く誰よりも美しい雷蝶様!!》小弓竜兵Ｂ《御供いたします!!》

en: Airship Captain"Hmm... Our army is overwhelming, no? Absolutely overwhelming!"Airship Captain"A war this one-sided, where is the scope to distinguish oneself? My beloved ship, reduced to background decoration for that Galley Keep. A floating fortress one can depend upon, yes, and thoroughly resent..."Airship First Officer"Captain sir, I suggest we gain a little altitude. We are too close to where the dragoons are fighting."Airship Captain"Close, so what? Rokuhara's dragoons will break through our formation and reach all the way here, is it?"Airship Captain"Look at the situation."Airship First Officer"But... some enemy groups are putting up fierce resistance."Airship Captain"...Oh? Now THAT is interesting."Airship Captain"Let us see what faces these fellows have. Forward!"Airship First Officer"Captain!"
ja:
飛行艦長「ううむ……
　圧倒的だな、我が軍は！」飛行艦長「こうも一方的な戦争では手柄の立てようが
ない。
　我が愛艦を頼もしくも疎ましい浮遊城塞ガレーキープの
引き立て役で終わらせたくないものだが……」飛行艦副長「艦長、もう少し高度を上げた方がよろしい
かと。
　竜騎兵の交戦圏に近過ぎます」飛行艦長「近いから、何だと言うのだ。
　六波羅の竜騎兵が我が軍の布陣を突破して
ここまで来られるわけでもなかろう」飛行艦長「この形勢だ」飛行艦副長「いえ……
　一部、激しい抵抗を見せている敵騎集団も
あります」飛行艦長「……ほう？
　それは面白い」飛行艦長「面構えを見てやろう。
　前進する！」飛行艦副長「艦長！」

en: Airship First Officer"Th-they actually bloody CAME!"Airship Captain"The knight in front... is that a Blood Crus, a true tsurugi?"Airship Captain"You there, Intelligence. Identify it."Airship First Officer"Identification can wait, Captain sir! We should withdraw—"Airship Intelligence Officer"I have it. ...WHAT?!"Airship Captain"What is it?"Airship Intelligence Officer"L-Lieutenant General Raichou Imagawa! No mistake!"Airship Intelligence Officer"One of Rokuhara's four generals!!"Airship Captain"————"Airship Captain"Ohooo...?"Airship First Officer"Captain, withdraw—"Airship Captain"A general standing at the very front? I would call him brave, but... no. Foolish general."Airship Captain"No, no, I should THANK him! Such a chance for glory, and it has come flying to us without even being asked!"Airship First Officer"This is DANGEROUS! Raichou Imagawa is Rokuhara's strongest warrior!"Airship Captain"Strongest, invincible—give him any title you like. One knight can do only so much. His escort... hmph. A few knights, that's all."Airship Captain"First Officer, before becoming frightened, try doing arithmetic. How many knights have THEY got? How many dragoons aboard OUR ship? And if we fight, who wins? Count first, panic afterward."Airship First Officer"But..."Airship Captain"Orders to the shipboard dragoons! Every unit, sortie!"Airship Captain"Do NOT let this chance for glory escape!!"
ja:
飛行艦副長「ほ――本当に来やがったァ！」飛行艦長「先頭の騎士……
　あれは真打劒冑ブラッドクルスか」飛行艦長「おい情担、識別してみろ」飛行艦副長「そんなことより艦長、後退を――」飛行艦情報「出ました。
　……えぇっ!?」飛行艦長「どうした？」飛行艦情報「いっ、今川雷蝶中将です！
　間違いありません」飛行艦情報「あれは六波羅四将軍の一人!!」飛行艦長「――――」飛行艦長「ほーぉぉ……？」飛行艦副長「艦長、後退――」飛行艦長「将軍の身で最前線に立つだと？
　勇敢と言ってやりたいが……愚将だな」飛行艦長「いや、感謝せねばならんか！
　願ってもない手柄が舞い込んで来たぞ！」飛行艦副長「危険です！
　今川雷蝶といえば、六波羅最強の武人!!」飛行艦長「最強だろうが無敵だろうが、一騎の力など
高が知れているのだよ。
　護衛は……ふん、ほんの数騎か」飛行艦長「副長、怯える前に計算してみたらどうだ？
　敵は何騎で、我が艦内には何騎の竜騎兵が
搭乗していて、戦えば勝つのはどちらか？」飛行艦副長「しかし……」飛行艦長「艦載竜騎兵に命令！
　全騎出撃だ！」飛行艦長「大功を逃すな!!」

en: Raichou《Their days are numbered; even without wind, the blossoms fall—》
ja:
雷蝶《――かぎりあれば、
　吹かねど花は散るものを》

en: Raichou《How impatient... the spring wind in the mountains.》
ja: 雷蝶《心みじかき……春の山風》

en: Airship Captain"—Wha—"Airship Captain"What... did you say?"Airship First Officer"C-coming... Captain, coming here!"Airship Captain"..."Airship First Officer"ARRE! Your mouth was working perfectly! Give an ORDER, damn you!"Airship First Officer"Hisab lagao, bhosdike! CALCULATE us out of this! Your bloody arithmetic brought—"
ja:
飛行艦長「――な」飛行艦長「なん、だ……とォ？」飛行艦副長「く、来る……
　艦長、来ますよ！」飛行艦長「…………」飛行艦副長「おいっ！
　クソ、どうにかしろよっ、あんた！」飛行艦副長「あんたがバカだからこんなことに――」

en: Willow"Sunset, then. One day, and it still hasn't fallen... Not quite so obliging."Cannon"Rokuhara has strong troops, sir. Our own preparations were not exactly perfect either."Cannon"For today, taking Oyumi should be enough. We needn't reject the result because it isn't everything."Willow"Yes."
ja:
ウィロー「日暮れか。
　流石に一日では陥ちんな……」キャノン「六波羅は強兵ですよ。
　それにこちらの態勢も完璧ではありません
でしたしね」キャノン「今日のところは、小弓を沈めただけで良し
としておくべきでしょう」ウィロー「ああ」

en: Cannon"Let us confirm the present situation."Cannon"First Corps, Ousamequin, has moved into Kamakura."Cannon"Second Corps, Hiawatha, is attacking Fudaraku from Fujisawa. Third Corps, Thayendanegea, from Oofuna."Cannon"Fourth Corps, Wahunsunacock, has secured Oyumi. Fifth Corps, Sacagawea, is attacking Koga."Cannon"The fleet has control of almost all Sagami Bay. It is keeping the shogunate fleet in check while transporting supplies."Willow"Hmm..."Cannon"May I order Second and Third Corps—Hiawatha and Thayendanegea—to stop their attacks, sir? We need to withdraw the troops before dark and prepare for the night."Cannon"We want to take as many aboard the fleet as possible. For that also, sooner is better. Once the sun goes down, accidents become more likely."Willow"...Continuing the attack through the night is not an option, Lieutenant Colonel?"Cannon"Dangerous on several counts. One: our men do not know the ground well enough to fight smoothly at night. Two: night fighting is traditionally a specialty of Yamato's soldiers."Cannon"Three: we may attack civilian districts by mistake. That would be quite a contribution to the problem."Willow"...True."Willow"All right, Cannon. We shall not get impatient."Cannon"The war has only just started, after all."Willow"But the enemy may attack us at night. Make certain everyone remains thoroughly on guard."Cannon"Yes, sir."
ja:
キャノン「現状を確認します」キャノン「第一軍団オーサムクインは鎌倉市に進駐」キャノン「第二軍団ハイオワサは藤沢方面より普陀楽城を攻撃中。
　第三軍団タイエンダネギアは大船方面より普陀楽城を攻撃中」キャノン「第四軍団ワウンスナコックは小弓公方府を制圧。
　第五軍団サカ・ガェアは古河公方府を攻撃中」キャノン「艦隊は相模湾をほぼ制圧、幕府艦隊を牽制
しつつ物資の輸送を行っています」ウィロー「うむ……」キャノン「第二、第三軍団ハイオワサ、タイエンダネギアに攻撃中止を命じて宜しい
ですか、閣下？
　夜が訪れる前に兵を退かせ、夜営の準備を
整える必要があります」キャノン「艦隊に収容できる限りはしたいですから、
その意味でも急いだ方が良いですね。
　日が落ちてからでは事故の危険が増します」ウィロー「……夜間も攻撃を続行する選択はないか？
　中佐」キャノン「それは多くの意味で危険です。
　夜戦を支障なく行えるほど我が軍の兵士は
地理を把握していないのが一つ、大和軍人は
伝統的に夜戦を得意としているのが一つ」キャノン「誤って市街地を攻撃してしまう恐れもある
のが一つ」ウィロー「……そうだな」ウィロー「わかったよ、キャノン。
　焦らないことにしよう」キャノン「まだ始まったばかりですからね」ウィロー「だが、敵が夜襲してくる可能性もある。
　警戒は徹底させておいてくれ」キャノン「はい」

en: Cannon"Only... Major General Willow. Koga is a different matter."Willow"Yes. I understand that."Willow"Koga is Rokuhara's lifeline. Which makes it the place where WE can settle the contest."Cannon"Take Koga, and we can isolate Fudaraku."Willow"Night-fighting equipment is being sent there as a priority, yes?"Cannon"Of course. Even with it, we must be prepared for considerable losses..."Willow"The final account will balance. The price paid at Koga will buy us something substantial."Cannon"Yes."Willow"Send Fourth Corps, Wahunsunacock, to assist at Koga as well."Cannon"Understood, sir."
ja:
キャノン「ただ……ウィロー少将。
　古河方面は別ですよ」ウィロー「ああ。
　わかっているとも」ウィロー「古河は六波羅の生命線……。
　裏を返せば、我々の勝負所だ」キャノン「古河を奪えば普陀楽を孤立させられます」ウィロー「夜間戦闘用装備はあちらへ優先的に回して
いるんだな？」キャノン「勿論です。
　それでも相当の被害を覚悟しなくてはなり
ませんが……」ウィロー「最終的な帳尻は合うさ。
　古河で支払う犠牲には大いに意味がある」キャノン「ええ」ウィロー「第四軍団ワウンスナコックも古河の応援に向かわせてくれ」キャノン「了解です、閣下」

en:
For the time being, Fudaraku Castle still stood.
The occupation forces stopped attacking at sunset and pulled back toward the coast.

Some of the Horigoe staff proposed pursuit. Probably this was a little encouragement for the room; I doubted anybody really thought we could do it. At the Fujisawa approach, over one in ten defenders had been killed or wounded.

A serious loss. No improvement was available by choosing a happier word.
ja:
ひとまずのところ、普陀楽城は健在であった。
　進駐軍は日没に合わせて攻撃を停止し、海岸方面へ
撤収していった。

　堀越領衆の幕僚団からは追撃の意見具申もあったが、
おそらく一種の景気付け・・・・のようなもので、本当は誰も
そんな事ができるなどと考えてはいなかったろう。
　藤沢口守備隊の死傷率は一割を超えている。

　深刻な被害と言わざるを得なかった。

en: Chachamaru"...Hm? What is it, bhai?"Kageaki"Nothing..."
ja:
茶々丸「……？
　どったの、お兄さん」景明「いや……」

en:
I had stopped walking. Chachamaru asked what was wrong.

The hurried movements outside had caught my eye.

Wounded men carried on stretchers.
A soldier with one leg missing, on a comrade's back, heading for the medical station. Perhaps waiting for proper transport was more time than he had.

Things on stretchers that did not move.
Something else by the roadside, also no longer moving. Nobody noticed him. Or everyone noticed. Either way, there he remained, discarded...
ja:
ふと足を止める。
　茶々丸が訝しげに問うてきた。

　俺は外の慌しい動きに目を引かれていた。

　担架で運ばれる負傷者。
　搬送手段を待っていられなかったのか、僚友に背負
われて医療所へ向かう片足の無い兵士。

　担架で運ばれる動かないもの・・・・・・。
　道端に放置されている、やはりもう動かない何か。
誰もが気付かず、あるいは誰もが気付きながら、彼は
そこに捨て置かれている……。

en: Kageaki"Dead, aren't they."
ja: 景明「死んでいるな」

en: I said what was already perfectly obvious. As though the fact had been waiting for my announcement.
ja: わかり切った事実を、俺は口にした。

en: Kageaki"The smell of death. From here, from there. All over."Kageaki"The castle's air is going stagnant with it. This air, I know."Kageaki"It makes me want to vomit..."Chachamaru"Haan."
ja:
景明「死臭がする。
　あちらこちらから」景明「城の空気が死に澱んできた。
　馴染みの空気だ」景明「吐き気がする……」茶々丸「そうだね」

en:
Chachamaru smiled.

A girl's smile, and then she leaned to whisper at my ear.
ja:
茶々丸は微笑わらった。

　少女らしく微笑んで、俺の耳元に囁いた。

en: Chachamaru"But this much is nothing. Plenty more will die."Chachamaru"Keep on dying."Chachamaru"...In the end, everyone."Kageaki"..."
ja:
茶々丸「けど、こんなものじゃない。
　まだまだ死ぬ」茶々丸「死に続ける」茶々丸「……最後には、みんな・・・」景明「…………」

en: Doushin"Oyumi Palace appears to have fallen. An urgent report came a little earlier."Raichou"...I see."Raichou"Lord Doushin, I am sorry. As the lord entrusted with Oyumi, I must offer my apologies."Doushin"No, no, do not bow your head. Oyumi could not be helped. You were fighting with all your strength here at Fudaraku."Chachamaru"Arre, we knew from the start. If the occupation army got the first move, Oyumi would fall easily. Good place to attack from, bloody useless place to defend."Doushin"Quite so, quite so. Lord Raichou, do not burden yourself with it. The enemy in front of us requires our attention now."Raichou"...Yes..."Chachamaru"Doushin bhai, heard anything from Shishiku?"Doushin"Nothing. The enemy's signal jamming seems especially severe toward the northeast."Chachamaru"Achha... Never mind. He's probably only just reaching Sasagawa territory, if he's reached it at all."Doushin"Two more days... no, three. We shall have to endure at least that."Chachamaru"Even three days is a difficult business. Two difficulties, actually."Raichou"Can Shishiku bring reinforcements in three days? Can Fudaraku hold for another three days?"Raichou"...Those two?"Chachamaru"Haan."Raichou"Yes..."Doushin"The Oyumi contingent at Oofuna, and Horigoe at Fujisawa. How do your troops stand?"Raichou"The picture is not a cheerful one."Chachamaru"Mine also. One day, and they've scraped us down properly."Chachamaru"Can you send some of the reserves our way? Otherwise tomorrow we won't hold."Doushin"Understood. I shall make the arrangements shortly."
ja:
童心「小弓御所は陥ちた様子でござる。
　先刻、急報があり申した」雷蝶「……そうですか」雷蝶「童心様、申し訳ございません。
　小弓を預かる公方としてお詫びいたします」童心「いやいや、頭などお下げになるな。
　小弓の件は致し方なき事。雷蝶殿は普陀楽
で奮闘しておられたのだからのう」茶々丸「進駐軍に先手を打たれたら小弓はあっさり
陥ちるって、最初からわかってたじゃねえか。
　攻めるにはいいけど守るにはてんで不向き
だからな、あそこ」童心「さようさよう。
　雷蝶殿、気に病まれてはなりませぬぞ。今
は目の前の敵に集中せねば」雷蝶「……ええ……」茶々丸「童心坊主、獅子吼からの連絡はあった？」童心「ござらぬ。
　敵の信号妨害が特に北東方面は厳しいよう
でござっての」茶々丸「そーかぁ……。
　まぁいいや。どうせまだ篠川領に入ったか
どうかってところだろうしな」童心「あと二日……
　いや三日は耐えねばなりますまい」茶々丸「三日と見ても、厳しいところだな。
　二重の意味で」雷蝶「三日で獅子吼が援軍に来られるか。
　あと三日、普陀楽を守り抜けるか」雷蝶「……ということ？」茶々丸「うん」雷蝶「そうね……」童心「大船口の小弓、藤沢口の堀越、両御領衆の
状況は如何でござる？」雷蝶「あまり明るくはありません」茶々丸「うちも。
　今日一日でガリガリ削られましたよ」茶々丸「予備隊を一部回してくれない？
　でないと明日はもう保たねえわ」童心「承知いたした。
　後程、取り計らいましょうぞ」

en: Chachamaru"...They've pulled back on the ground. But the bombing from above, looks like that's doing the full night shift."Doushin"Even dropping blindly in the dark, aim for the castle's centre and something will be hit. Direct results may not amount to much, but merely keeping us from sleep is purpose enough."Chachamaru"What a fucking nuisance. Show some laziness, yaar. Thoda toh!"Raichou"Why not say it loudly enough for THEM to hear?"Chachamaru"What, ask nicely? If 'please stop' got us an 'okay,' bhai, we wouldn't be having a fucking war in the first place."Doushin"Huh-huh... quite, quite. I have one thought rather better than that. Would you hear it?"Raichou"What is it?"Doushin"Oh, nothing elaborate. I merely thought: taking a beating without returning any gets rather dull."Chachamaru"...Now you're talking. But whose troops are you sending?"Chachamaru"My Horigoe contingent has nothing to spare. The reserves?"Doushin"No, no. The reserves must be used with care."Doushin"There are others much better suited to this work."Chachamaru"...Ah. Haan. There are."Kageaki"————"
ja:
茶々丸「…………。

やるつもりらしいな」童心「闇の中の盲撃ちでも、城の中心部を狙って

en:
Chachamaru glanced back at me—no, farther behind me.
Having an inkling myself, I looked that way at the same moment.

...Not a sound. Not even the air disturbed.
The man had apparently been waiting there. Since when, no announcement had been made.
ja:

投げていた。

　その男はいつからか、そこに控えていたようだ。

en:
Today was December first.
Until December fourth, when Hikaru woke, Fudaraku Castle had to remain standing.

Three small steps for a calendar. For us, kindly drag an entire fortress through three more days of this chutiyapa without letting the walls, the soldiers or the plan fall down. The difference in military strength made it an extremely difficult requirement.

Still, if battlefield time would keep passing like this, perhaps the business might finish more easily than expected. The enemy's supplies, unlike its confidence, were not inexhaustible.

Fight until the fourth. Use up all the supplies immediately available to them. Leave Rokuhara inconveniently alive. Then the occupation army would have no option except its final weapon.

Exactly as Chachamaru and Wolf—as the Green Dragon Society—wanted. Their last resort, our required result. We were working very hard to make our own bombing necessary. A fine plan. From outside, one might have some questions.
ja:
今日は一二月一日。
　光が目覚める一二月四日まで、この普陀楽城を守り
通さなくてはならない。

　彼我の戦力差を考えればそれは至難だ。
　しかし、この調子で戦場の時間が過ぎてゆくなら、
案外と簡単に事は済んでしまうかもしれない。

　四日まで戦い、当座の物資をすべて使い尽くしても
なお六波羅を滅ぼせないなら、進駐軍は最後の武器に
頼る以外の選択を失うだろう。
　茶々丸、ウォルフ――緑龍会の望む通りに。

en: Chachamaru"...Hm? Their front line is pulling back?"Kageaki"Their morale is visibly low. Perhaps they're replacing them with a somewhat better unit."Chachamaru"Quick to give up on these fellows, na. Well, troops they've got to spare."Kageaki"We should move our wounded and finish resupplying while we have the chance."Chachamaru"Haan."
ja:
茶々丸「……？
　敵の前線が下がってる？」景明「見るからに士気が低いからな。
　もう少しましな部隊に替えるのではないか」茶々丸「見切りが早いな。
　ま、向こうは兵力余ってるしねー」景明「今のうちにこちらも負傷者の搬送や補給を
済ませるべきだろう」茶々丸「うい」

With the gunfire stopped, a loudspeaker on the occupation army's side took over the business of filling the battlefield.
The voice was not Yamato, but the speaker handled our language well.

銃声が途絶えた戦場に、代わって響き渡ったのは、

　声は大和人ではないが、大和語を上手く操っている。

en: Chachamaru"...Ab kya? What now?"Kageaki"Going to call for our surrender, perhaps."Chachamaru"Ah. Standard program. Timing's shit, though."Chachamaru"Do it when your own fellows look a bit more alive, na."Kageaki"I agree."
ja:
茶々丸「……何だぁ？」景明「降伏勧告でもする気か」茶々丸「あー。定番だね。
　でも時機を外してるよな」茶々丸「てめーらがもっと元気な時にやりゃいいの
に」景明「同感だな」

en:
Sure enough, the loudspeaker said what we expected. The appeal to surrender spread over the Horigoe contingent.

Nobody showed any sign of taking it to heart. Most laughed at it; their spirits rose instead.
A surrender announcement doing encouragement duty.
ja:
果たして拡声器の告げる内容は予想に違わなかった。
　降伏を勧める声が、堀越領衆の頭上に被さる。

　だが、露骨な反応を見せる兵はいない。
　嘲笑い、かえって勢いづく者が大半だった。

en: Surrender Envoy《People of Rokuhara. Put down your weapons and surrender.》Surrender Envoy《We will forgive you. You will not be treated as criminals.》Chachamaru"Arre wah. Such kindness."Surrender Envoy《Surrender, people of Rokuhara.》Surrender Envoy《If you keep fighting, you will lose. If you do not surrender, you will die.》Chachamaru"Achha, really..."Surrender Envoy《We are the ones who will win. This morning, Koga Castle became ours.》Surrender Envoy《There are no reinforcements for you. You cannot win.》

ja:
補佐「はッ！」茶々丸「各隊に伝令を走らせろ！

俺は付近に誰もいないのを確認してから、茶々丸の
耳元に囁いた。

Most likely Koga... really has fallen...)
ja:
景明（本当に進駐軍の捏造だと思うか？）茶々丸（そうならいいとは、本気で思ってるけど。
　……判断はお兄さんと同じかな）茶々丸（進駐軍が損害無視で古河を夜通し攻撃して

Koga lost.

Meaning the road was closed to the reinforcements from Sasagawa.

Meaning Fudaraku Castle was completely alone...◆
And Rokuhara's defeat was now very close. No clever wording could shift it farther away.
ja:
古河の失陥。

する。

en: Kageaki"..."Chachamaru"Not giving up."Chachamaru"Not giving up, bhenchod. NOT."

en:
Chachamaru glared ahead as though fate itself could be shot dead with that look.
The voice asking us to surrender was no longer audible.

Now there were battle cries.
The besieging army had recovered its spirit so completely it seemed to have become different men. The same army, a whole new appetite. It was turning into a torrent, ready to rush at us again...
ja:
運命そのものを射殺す視線で、茶々丸が前方を睨む。
　降伏を促す声は、既に聴こえない。

再び押し寄せて来ようとしている……。

en: Prince Maidono"...The occupation army has taken Koga?"Chief"Yes, Your Highness."Prince Maidono"Pakka? Certain?"Chief"Only rumours have reached us. Now it has gone the other way."Prince Maidono"..."Chief"The occupation troops are full of spirit.
