With that thought, I looked at the ground. The plants did not look like Yamato's. More like Europe's.

White Emishi. Europe. All these deaths.
...Something was almost joining up in my mind...
ja:
少し違う？
　蝦夷と……？

　西洋の蝦夷種族――白蝦夷ユーデア、か？
　
　そう思って足元を見れば、植生が大和らしくない。
欧州のそれに近かった。

　白蝦夷。欧州。大量死。
　……何かが繋がりそうなのだが……。

en: Kageaki"!!"

My thoughts stopped dead.
At the edge of sight, beyond wavering flames—◆a figure, for one instant.

A person STANDING.
...Still alive!
ja:
思索が急停止を余儀なくされる。
　視界の端、炎がゆらめいた向こうに――◆今一瞬だけ、
人影が見えた。

　つまり、立っていた・・・・・。
　……まだ生きている！

en: Muramasa《Wait, Mido!》Kageaki"What?!"
ja: 村正《待って、御堂！》景明「何だ!?」

en: Now, at a moment like this—what was it?
ja: この切羽詰っている時に、何を――

en: Muramasa《Don't forget our situation! This isn't our world!》Kageaki"————"Muramasa《Get deeply involved here and we won't be able to go back to our own time and place. Are you willing to do that?》
ja:
村正《状況を忘れないで！
　ここは私達の世界じゃないのよ！》景明「――――」村正《この世界に深く関わったら、元の時空間に
戻れなくなる。
　それでもいいの？》

en:
...Haan. Yes. That was right.

Do not interfere with anything around us. Wait for the corrective force. Waiting quietly in a fire was not easy, but with a tsurugi protecting me, it was possible.

I must not act carelessly.
And saving someone from this world—that was precisely the thing I must not do.
ja:
……そう、そうだった。

　修正力が働くまで、周囲との干渉を避けて待たなく
てはならない。
　火の中で静かに待つのは難しいが、劒冑の守りさえ
あれば可能だ。

　下手に動いてはならない。
　増してや、この世界の住人を救うなど以もつての外ほかだ。

en: Kageaki"…Kh."
ja: 景明「……く」

en:
I stopped and looked toward where the figure had been. The flames shifted widely again and showed her to me.

A small body. Exceptionally pale skin. Long ears—
It seemed I had guessed correctly. At least this one survivor had the features of the white Emishi.

She did not seem to have noticed us. Dazed, staring at the flames that were about to close around her.

—She.
ja:
足を止めて、人影のあった方向を見やる。
　炎がまた大きく揺れ、その姿を俺に晒した。

　小さな体。抜けるように白い肌。長い耳――
　読みは当たっていたらしい。少なくともその唯一の
生存者は白蝦夷の特徴を備えていた。

　彼女・・はこちらに気付いていないようだ。
　自失の態で、己を包み込もうとする炎の渦に視線を
注いでいる。

　――彼女。

en: Kageaki"That is…"
ja: 景明「あれは……」

en:
The moment I realised she was female, something flashed through my mind. I knew her. I had met her once.

At the Yokohama base.
Professor Wolf and Chachamaru had introduced her to me—the Forged Bomb.

That girl who had seemed hollow inside.
ja:
女性だと気付くと同時、脳裏に閃くものがあった。
　知っている。俺は一度、会った事がある。

　横浜基地で。
　ウォルフ教授と茶々丸が俺に紹介した――鍛造雷弾。

　空洞のようだった少女。

en:
Why was she here?

...No. That was not the question to be asking myself now. That mystery could wait.

Was I going to leave her? Truly leave her to die?

What did I know about her, in the end? Nothing. I was not even certain she had really been part of the Forged Bomb.

Not one proper reason for thinking it was all right to abandon her.

Only what I could see was certain. A white Emishi girl, caught in the flames, about to die.

Was I not going to save her?

If I did, I would not return to our own time and place. No one in that world would be left to stop the 'god'. How much would be lost then?
ja:
何故ここに？

　……いや、違う。
　いま自身の心に問うべきは、そんな緊急性のない謎
ではない。

　助けなくて良いのか。
　本当に見捨てて良いのか。

　結局のところ、俺は彼女について何も知らない。
　本当に鍛造雷弾の一部であったのか、それすら確信
はない。

　見捨てて良いと思える根拠は全くない。

　確かな事は、いま目に見えている事実のみだ。
　白蝦夷の少女が、炎に巻かれて死のうとしている。

　助けなくて良いのか。

　助ければ、俺は元の時空間へ戻れなくなる。
　あの世界で〝神〟を止められる者はいなくなり――
結果、どれほどのものが失われるだろうか。

en: But think about it.
ja: だが考えてみよ。

en:
One world. One life.
Who had decided that the world weighed more?

What was wrong with saving the life in danger right in front of me? Was that not the truly worthy thing to do...?

What was I going to do?

Choices
• Save the girl.
• Do not save her.
ja:
一個の世界と、一個の命。
　前者が重いなどと、誰が決めたのだ？

　今そこで危機に瀕している命を救って何が悪い。
　いや、それこそ真に尊い行いではないのか……？

　どうする？

選択肢
• 少女を助ける
• 助けない

en: Muramasa《Mido!》
ja: 村正《御堂！》

en:
Muramasa's voice no longer reached me.
No more hesitation. I would save her.

That fragile life—I would save it.
ja:
村正の声も、もはや俺の心には届かなかった。
　迷わない。俺は彼女を救う。

　あの儚い生命を救うのだ。

en:
Only a few strides for an armoured warrior. I crossed the distance in one rush and lifted her into my arms.

A faint breath touched my cheek. The girl's eyes found me.

I looked down into her face.

...Ah.

Such relief. Deeper than I could say.
The decision was right. Let anyone say what they liked; this decision was absolutely right.

I was glad I had saved her.

What I had lost, there was no measuring.
But what I had gained was here.

Look at her. This girl.

How had I ever thought she was hollow? Yes, her eyes were vacant. Yes, her face scarcely changed.

But look beyond that. Look at the fullness of the heart inside.

I had thought it empty because there was nothing missing. Not one empty corner. I had let the resemblance between zero and a hundred fool me.

She was not nothing. She was everything.

With that full heart, she was blessing me. Yes, this was good. Yes, I had chosen rightly.

She looked so happy————
ja:
武者の足にはほんの数歩の距離。
　一息に駆け抜けて、その体を抱え上げる。

　微弱な息遣いが、頬に触れた。
　少女の双眸が、俺を認める。

　俺も彼女の顔を見下ろした。

　……ああ。

　俺は深く、深く安堵した。
　決断は正しかった――誰が何を言おうが断じて正し
かったのだ。

　助けて良かった。

　失ったものは計り知れない。
　しかし、得たものがここにある。

　見よ。
　この少女を。

　空洞のようだと感じた、嘗ての自分の気が知れない。
　確かに少女の瞳は虚ろだろう。表情は常に一様で、
変化に乏しいだろう。

　だがその奥を見よ。
　豊穣なる心を覗け。

　空虚と思えたのはそれが何の欠けもなく、隅々まで
満ち満ちていたからだ。
　〇と一〇〇の類似性に惑わされたに過ぎない。

　少女は無ではなく全であった。

　豊かな心でもって、彼女は俺を祝福している。
　それで良い。その決断で正しいと。

　こんなにも嬉しそうに――――

en:
A moment of possession, perhaps. That thought had risen like a bank of clouds and filled my chest. I hurriedly shook it off.

No. I must not.
The right to interfere in this world's affairs belonged to the beings of this world.

I was an outsider. Given one extraordinary chance to peep inside, bas. That did not give me permission to meddle.

If my decisions and actions were to change anything, it had to be what happened in MY world...
ja:
魔・が差したとでも云うべきか。
　不意に群雲の如く湧いて胸中を満たしたその考えを、
俺は慌てて振り払った。

　ならぬ。
　この世界の事象に干渉を許されるのは、この世界の
存在のみ。

　俺は部外者であり、稀有な機会を得て覗き見ている
に過ぎない。
　手を出す資格などない。

　俺の決断そして行動によって変えられるものがある
とすれば、それは俺自身の世界の事象だけなのだ……。

en: Muramasa《...Don't scare me like that.》Kageaki"Sorry. The heat seems to have gone to my head."
ja:
村正《……焦らせないでよ》景明「済まん。
　どうも熱にあてられたらしい」

en:
I did not look at the girl again. Look, and who knew what thoughts would come back?

I concentrated on the corrective force and let it take me.

...Could we return to our own time and place now? Soon, at least?
ja:
もう少女の姿は見なかった。
　見ればまた何を思うかわからない。

　修正力の働きに意識を集中させ、身を任せる。
　
　……そろそろ元の時空間に戻らないだろうか？

en:
Quiet.
Small waves coming in, that was all. For once, nothing else was insisting on entering my ears.

Some night. Some stretch of shore.
No sinister presence here. No wind trying to turn the world upside down. No fire roaring away.
Here, the world was keeping quiet.
ja:
静かであった。
　小波の打ち寄せる音のほかに、耳を煩わせるものは
何もない。

　いつかの夜、どこかの浜辺。
　妖しい気配も、逆巻く風も、炎の猛りも、ここには
なかった。穏やかな世界だった。

en: Kageaki"...Still not back. But at least here we can take one breath."Muramasa《Haan. And whatever YEAR we've reached, the place looks like Yamato, at least.》
ja:
景明「……まだか。
　しかし、一息つけるな」村正《そうね。
　それに時間はともかくとして、ここは大和
みたいだし》

en:
On that point I agreed with her. This was Yamato's sea. Probably the Pacific side.

The stars were giving the same answer. The constellations I knew. And the moon—
ja:
村正の見解に、首肯する。
　これは大和の海だ。おそらく太平洋側。

　空を見れば、星空の様相もその仮定を裏付ける。
　慣れ親しんだ星座が見え、月も――

en: Kageaki"........................"Muramasa《Kya hua? What is it?》Kageaki"The moon."Muramasa《What about the moon?》Kageaki"...It has broken."Muramasa《Huh? Arre, what nonsense are you suddenly talking?》Muramasa《First calm down. The moon becomes full, becomes a crescent. It doesn't just BREAK—》
ja:
景明「……………………」村正《？　どうしたの？》景明「月が」村正《月？》景明「……割れている」村正《は？
　……ちょっと、突拍子もないこと言わない
でよ》村正《落ち着きなさい。
　月は満ち欠けするけど、割れたりなんて》

en: Muramasa《NYAAAAAGH—?!》
ja: 村正《にゃがーーーーーー!?》

en:
Broken only.
I looked again. Still broken. I decided firmly that my eyes were playing tricks, and looked once more. My decision made no difference to the moon.

Earth's treasure, our beautiful satellite, was in pieces.

A full moon... I supposed that was what it ought to have been. Only now it had achieved the condition of a plate dropped on the floor.

...There was one theory about the moon's birth, wasn't there?
All the matter floating around the earth had gathered under gravity, gathered and gathered until, finally, there was the moon—
ja:
割れていた。
　何度見ても。錯覚と決め込んで見直しても。

　地球の至宝、美しき衛星は完全に割れて砕けていた。

　満月……なのだろう。本当なら。
　それが、床に落とした皿の如き惨状を呈している。

　……月の誕生についての一説を思い出した。
　地球周辺に漂っていた物質が引力の影響で集積し、
やがて月を形成したのだと云う――

en: Muramasa《A-arre ch-ch-CHAAND kya-ka-ka-MOON—》Kageaki"Calm down."
ja: 村正《ちょっ、なっ、ながにゃんでつつつつき》景明「落ち着け」

en: Muramasa had become so thoroughly confused that she was now speaking a language from another world. I cut in before she could continue in it.
ja: 錯乱して異界の言語を喋り始めた村正を遮る。

en: Kageaki"Is it possible we've reached the earth of tens of thousands... no, that won't do... hundreds of millions of years ago, or even earlier?"Muramasa《Eh? Uh...》Muramasa《We were supposed to be moving within a few hundred years, roughly. So I don't THINK that's it... And look around, no? Does any of this look that ancient?》
ja:
景明「ここが数万年……どころではないか……
　数億年以上昔の地球上という可能性はある
か？」村正《え？
　えーっと……》村正《だいたい数百年の枠の中で動いていたはず
だし、それはないと思うけど……。
　周りも、そんな風には見えないし》

en:
True enough.
The moon was born, if I remembered what I had heard—◆almost at the same time as the earth. Not hundreds of millions of years ago, then. Billions. Even my wildly excessive figure was not excessive enough.

No, however I looked at this place, that ancient earth was not fitting.

Then what was the explanation?
If we had not come to the time when the moon was still being assembled...

...The future?
Was something going to break it in the future?

Humanity goes to develop the moon and commits such a world-record blunder that there is no proper moon remaining? Or we choose it for the final battle against aliens—?
ja:
同意できる。
　月が生まれたのは、確か――◆地球とほぼ同時と聞く。
そうなると数億年前ですらない、数十億年前だ。

　とてもではないが、ここがそんな太古の地球上とは
思えない。
　
　すると……どういう事なのか。

　ここが月の生成過程にあたる時代ではないなら。

　……未来？
　将来、月は何らかの理由で割れるのか？

　人類の月面開発が未曾有の大失敗を犯すのだろうか。
　あるいは異星人との決戦場に――？

en: Muramasa《…………》Kageaki"…………"Muramasa《Ah!》Kageaki"…Hm?"

Muramasa was still recovering from her confusion. My own head had already gone off to write science fiction. Probably that was why we took so long to notice.

Someone was there.

A figure walking away, leaving footprints one after another in the sand. I could see only the back, and in this darkness there was not much to go by. A woman, it seemed.

She was going farther from us. Then something must have reached her senses.

Suddenly she turned.
Not good. That much I understood, but what could I do now?

We stood facing one another, some distance between us.
ja:
村正は混乱が尾を引き、俺は頭がＳＦ方向へ進んで
いたせいだろう、それに気付くのが遅れた。
　
　人がいる。

　足跡を点々と残しつつ、歩いてゆく影。
　俺から見えるのは後姿であり、暗くもあって、良く
判然としないが――どうやら女性か。

　彼女は離れていこうとしていた。
　しかし、何かを感じたのだろう。

　不意にこちらへ、振り返る。
　まずい――と思ったが、どうにもできなかった。

　幾許かの距離を置いて対面する。

en:
...I did not know this woman.

Never met her. On that I could give a definite answer.
And still, something was pulling at my memory.

Not the whole face. That was unknown. But one part here, another there—why were those catching?
Those eyes, for instance—
ja:
……知らない女性だ。

　俺は彼女に出会った事はない。
　それは断定を下せる。が……何か、記憶を刺激する
ものがあった。

　全貌には覚えがないのに、部分部分が引っ掛かる。
　例えば、あの双眸――

en: Ichijou"…………"

An armoured warrior suddenly appearing from nowhere—that must have been how it looked from her side. Even so, not the slightest alarm showed in her eyes.
They were quiet like the shore itself. Just that small movement beneath the quiet, like a ripple.

Was she looking far back into the past?
Or looking into her own heart?

From her, not one word. From me, also, nothing would come.
ja:
忽然と現れた武者――だろう、彼女にすれば――を
見て、そこには動揺の片鱗も湧かなかった。
　この景色のようにただ静かで、
　ほんの小さく波立っている。

　遠い過去を見る眼差しだった。
　あるいは、己の心を見詰める眼。

　彼女は何も言わず、俺も、何一つ口にできなかった。

en:
For a few seconds only, she had stopped. Then she began walking again.
Away from us.

Straight ahead.

After that, no more stopping. Not once did she turn back.
ja:
数秒だけ止まったその足取りが、再び前方へ向かう。
　歩き去ってゆく。
　
　真っ直ぐに。

　彼女はもう止まる事も、振り返る事もなかった。

en: Kageaki"…"
Muramasa《Mido.》Kageaki"Yes."
ja: 村正《御堂》景明「ああ」

en:
Space-time was beginning to distort.
From this place too, it seemed we would get away safely.
ja:
時空間の歪みが生じている。
　ここからも無事、抜け出せるようだ。

en: Muramasa《Who was that just now?》Kageaki"I don't know."Muramasa《...Sach mein?》Kageaki"What reason have I given you to doubt me?"Muramasa《...Achha, leave it. More importantly, careful now.》Muramasa《This should probably take us back—》
ja:
村正《今の、誰？》景明「知らない」村正《……本当？》景明「なぜ疑う」村正《……まぁいいけど。
　それより、気をつけて》村正《多分、これで元に――》

en:
Above Mount Fuji—
Our own world. Our own time!


Below us, the Metal God.
And what was it doing? Gathering a wave of gravity, ready to fire straight at us.
ja:
富士山上空――
　元の世界。元の時間だ！


　眼下には金神。
　集束させた重力の波動を、今こちらへ撃ち出そうと
している。

en: Kageaki"...Of course. Coming back to our own space-time also means coming straight back to the fight with that god. That part I had neglected."Muramasa《THAT'S why I was telling you to be careful—》
ja:
景明「……そうか。
　元の時空間へ戻るということは、すぐさま
あの〝神〟との戦闘が再開されるということ
だったな」村正《だから気をつけてって――》

en:
Not even one moment to appreciate our return.
I twisted, beat my wings, and practically rolled through the sky to get clear of the gravity wave's killing path.

Breathing room? Not even the dust of one particle of it. But somehow the direct hit missed us.
ja:
感慨に浸る暇も貰えない。
　身を翻し母衣はねを打ち、空を転がるようにして重力波
の迸る壊滅領域から脱出する。

　余裕の欠片の塵滓もなかったが、危うく直撃だけは
逃れた。

en: Muramasa《...Bola tha na. I did tell you.》Kageaki"Yes. But... gravity waves, bending space, and then bending TIME as the crowning achievement."Kageaki"Is this fellow's supply of tricks never going to finish?"Muramasa《Tricks, who knows! His supply of AMMUNITION certainly isn't finishing!》
ja:
村正《……言ったでしょうに》景明「ああ。しかし……
　重力波に空間歪曲、極めつけの時間歪曲」景明「そろそろ種切れにならないのか？」村正《種はともかく、弾数ならまだまだ尽きない
みたいよ！》

en:
...Correct.
Our god went on bending space-time and firing waves of destruction with an enthusiasm that was exhausting ME.

On its own side, not the slightest sign of tiredness.

But—
ja:
……確かに。
〝神〟はこちらが辟易する精力ぶりで、時空間を歪め、
破壊の波動を撃ち放ってくる。

　消耗の様子などまるでない。
　
　だが――

en: Kageaki"A few things are clear now. It cannot do two things together."Kageaki"And after doing one thing, it cannot immediately do the next."Muramasa《Haan.》
ja:
景明「幾つかわかった。
　あれは同時に二つの事はできない」景明「そして、立て続けに行動する事もできない」村正《ええ》

en:
Always one kind of power at a time. Then a gap before the next use.
If it was only bending a small area of space, apparently it could manage a fairly quick succession. But those gravity waves and such—there, it seemed the gap was compulsory.
ja:
能力行使は必ず一種ずつ、また一度行使すると次の
行使まで時間間隔が空く。
　限定範囲の空間歪曲のみなら短い間隔で連打も可能
のようだが、重力波などはそうもいかないらしい。

en: Muramasa《The total power may be practically endless. But how much it can USE at once, that must still have a limit, no?》Kageaki"An unexpected mercy. Without even that much restriction, where would we find a chance of winning?"
ja:
村正《力の総量は無限に近い程あっても、それを
無制限に扱えるわけではないんでしょうね》景明「物怪もっけの幸いだ。
　せめてその程度の条件が付かなくては勝算
も立たん」

en: Give me even one condition in our favour, though, and making a plan was no difficulty. One condition only. I could work with that.
ja:
そして一つでも有利な条件があるなら、作戦の立案
に難は無い。

en: Muramasa《So, just after that torrent of gravitational energy—that's when we go in?》Kageaki"Yes. In through the opening, one strike, and out again."
ja:
村正《狙い所は、辰気の激流を使ってきた直後？》景明「ああ。
　その隙をついて一撃を加え、離脱する」

en:
Any delay on our side and a gravity wave fired in all directions would blow us away.
The whole plan could be explained in one sentence. Doing it was a different department altogether.

But so long as we did not get careless...
ja:
こちらの動きに遅滞があれば、重力波の全周囲放射
で吹き飛ばされるだろう。
　まとめれば一言で済んでしまう事だが、容易い行為
とは言えない。

　だが、油断さえしなければ……

en: Muramasa《...It's getting irritated.》Kageaki"Its attacks achieve nothing, and meanwhile we keep going round giving it these little pricks. Not enjoying that? Good."Kageaki"When our god loses its temper and tries an even bigger attack, THAT will be our chance."Muramasa《Bigger attack... bigger opening afterward.》
ja:
村正《……苛立ってる》景明「攻撃が成果を上げない事に加え、ちくちく・・・・
刺して回られるのが気に食わないか。
　それでいい」景明「〝神〟が怒りに任せ、更に大規模な攻撃を
仕掛けてきた時がこちらの勝機だ」村正《大きな攻撃を行えば大きな隙が生じる……》

en:
Exactly.
Then I would have my chance to drive in Kotetsu's electromagnetic draw.
ja:
そう。
　野太刀〝虎徹〟の電磁抜刀を打ち込む機が来る。

en: Muramasa《But we KNOW there's a snake in this bush, and here we are poking it, no?》Kageaki"That is an accurate description."
ja:
村正《けれどこれ、蛇がいるってわかってる藪を
つつくようなものよね》景明「違いないな」

en:
If the snake then bit us and we died, what specimens of stupidity we would be. Worth preserving for future generations: children, look properly, this is how NOT to use the brain.
And that ending was not some remote possibility, either.

Even now, the margin we were surviving on was hardly a margin.
ja:
それで蛇に噛まれて死ぬ結果にでもなろうものなら
俺達はまさしく愚者の標本だ。教訓とするため後世に
伝え残したい程の。
　そして、その末路を辿る可能性は決して低くない。

　現状でもぎりぎりの線を渡っているのだから。

en: Kageaki"Let us at least try to survive long enough to regret our own stupidity."Muramasa《Understood! Regret is a luxury only the living can afford, after all!》
ja:
景明「せめて、己の愚かさを後悔はできるように
努力するか」村正《諒解。
　後悔は生き延びた人だけの贅沢だものね！》

en:
Get clear of those hair-raising breakers of gravity—
and in, close to the body!

Like that. Steadily. One strike, then another—
ja:
身の毛もよだつ重力の波濤から逃れ、
　懐に入る！

　こうして、着実に一撃一撃を積み重ねて――

en: Muramasa《…Huh? …That—》
ja: 村正《……え？　……今の》

en: Muramasa《Mido, ruk! Don't!》Muramasa《Something's wrong—this could be a trap—》Kageaki"—?!"
ja:
村正《御堂、待って！
　いけない！》村正《何か変、罠かもっ――》景明「ッッ!?」

en:
A trap?
This god? This thing that did not seem to have even a properly functioning thought in its whole bloody body—?
ja:
罠？
　この、まともな思考装置を備えているとも思えない
〝神〟が――？

en: Gravity waves... one straight after another?!
ja: 重力波を……連続で!?

en: Muramasa《DODGE, Mido!》Kageaki"Kh—"
ja: 村正《避けてっ、御堂！》景明「くッ――」

en: Ab kya—why this sudden change?!
ja: 何故、急に！

en: Kageaki"...So all this time you were taking it EASY on us?!"Muramasa《Nahin! It's reducing the power of each shot so it can fire one after another!》Kageaki"Reducing the power—?"
ja:
景明「……今までは手加減していた、とでも言う
のか！」村正《違う！
　一発の威力を抑えて、連射ができるように
してきたのっ！》景明「威力を――？」

en:
...Haan. Thinking back, that fitted.
Those last two blasts had been smaller than the earlier gravity waves.

But from where had this bhosdike suddenly obtained that much sense...?
ja:
……そうか。思い返してみれば頷ける。
　今の二発は前の重力波に比べて小規模だった。

　しかし、そんな小知恵が何処から……

en: Muramasa《Another one—it's still firing!》
ja: 村正《まだ来るっ！》

en: Kageaki"—We're pulling back for now!"
ja: 景明「――ひとまず離脱するぞ！」

en:
At this rate, coming within striking distance was out of the question.
Nothing to do but dodge until even our mobility reached its limit, and then get shot down. That was the entire future on offer.

We had to withdraw first and get ourselves into a position to fight again.
ja:
これでは到底、近接攻撃の範囲へ踏み込めない。
　防戦一方、機動力の限界と撃墜死を待つばかりだ。

　一旦退き、戦闘態勢を再建する必要がある。

en: Muramasa《Understood—》
ja: 村正《諒解っ――》

en: Muramasa《—Arre, wait—》Muramasa《NO! Behind us—》Kageaki"...?!"
ja:
村正《――ってっ――》村正《だめ！
　後ろにっ――――》景明「……ッ!?」

en:
Space bending!!

—Exactly where we were retreating to!

By chance?!
Or was chance getting credit for something it had not done?

Had that god actually laid a trap and driven us into it...?!
ja:
空間歪曲!!
　
　――俺達の、退避した先・・・・・に！

　偶然か!?
　それとも、そうではないのか？

　罠を張り、誘い込んだという事なのか!?
　あの〝神〟が……

en: Kageaki"Tch...!"
ja: 景明「ちィ……！」

en:
Too close.
Somehow we got away with only minor damage to the right-leg armour.◆
Except—
ja:
危うい。
　どうにか右脚甲鉄に軽い被害を受ける程度で済んだ、◆
が。

en: —ONE MORE, ON TOP OF THAT!!
ja: ――――更にもう一段!!

en: Muramasa《MIDOOO!》Kageaki"————"
ja: 村正《御堂ぉっ！》景明「――――」

en:
No more manoeuvring left.
Nowhere to dodge.

So much sky, without end—and not one place for us in it.

The power that would end everything,
finish the whole of it,
was coming straight at us.

Coming.
ja:
機動力限界。
　回避不可能。

　無限の空の雪隠詰め。

　全てを終わりにする、
　終わらせてしまう力が迫る。

　来る。

en: Kageaki"NGAAAAH!!"
ja: 景明「ぬがァ!!」

en:
...Somehow, the idea that came to me at that instant worked. Probably with a completely unreasonable amount of luck carrying it.
I amplified the nodachi's gravity and swept the incoming wave aside with one stroke—

A hair's difference, and all I would have done was wave my sword uselessly before dying. But that difference did not happen.
There had barely been time even to aim. What else was I supposed to call it but a miracle?
ja:
……咄嗟の思い付きは、おそらく膨大な量の幸運に
助けられて成功した。
　重力増幅を施した野太刀の一閃で、押し寄せた重力
波動を打ち払う――

　寸毫の差で惨めな空振りとなったろうが、その差は
生じなかった。
　ろくに狙いを合わせる間もなかった事を思うにつけ、
全く奇跡としか表現しようがない。

en: Muramasa《...I'm feeling like I could start a whole new religion now.》Kageaki"Later. All the support you need, I will give. First, however—"Kageaki"What the hell is happening here?"Muramasa《............》
ja:
村正《……何だか新しい宗教を開けそうな気分よ》景明「後でやれ。幾らでも応援してやる。
　だがその前に」景明「――どういう事だ？」村正《…………》

en:
Not that I expected an immediate answer.
Muramasa was not all-knowing, either. Same problem as me. When the situation itself refused to make sense, where were the words supposed to come from?
ja:
即答は元より期待していなかった。
　村正とて全能ではない。俺と同様。理に合わぬ事態
と直面すれば、言葉を失って当然だろう。

en:
...From outside, it did not seem to have changed.

In the beginning, calling that god intelligent would have been an act of charity. A child swinging a toy about—that was a fair assessment.

But what it had just done...

Cut down those pointlessly overpowered gravity blasts and switched to rapid fire, each shot carrying just enough force.◆
When I withdrew, bent space exactly where I was going.◆
Then sent one more gravity wave to finish us.

If that was coincidence, coincidence had become a master artist.

No. Those were tactics.
However many ways I went over those last few seconds, the same problem remained. Something was THINKING in there. And the thinking had a very human smell to it.
ja:
……外観に変化は無いようだ。

　あの〝神〟の行動は当初、知的と云うに遠かった。
　玩具を振り回す子供、そう評価を下して差し支えは
ない。

　しかし。
　今、〝神〟がとった行動――

　無意味なほどの破壊力があった重力波を絞り、単発
から必要充分な威力による連射へ切り替え。◆
　俺が撤退すれば、退避点に空間歪曲を仕掛け。◆
　更に、詰み手となる重力波一射。

　偶然にしては、芸術の域まで出来過ぎている。

　あれは戦術的行動であった。
　過去数秒間の出来事をどう反芻しどう考察しようが、
極めて人間臭い・・・・思考の介在なしには説明がつかない。

en: Kageaki"Why has it changed so suddenly...?"Muramasa《I can think of exactly one answer that makes sense. Want to hear it?》Kageaki"Somehow I already dislike it. But go on."Muramasa《God hai na. It's a god.》Kageaki"Yes, that explains it! How does it HELP us?!"Muramasa《...It doesn't, no.》
ja:
景明「何故、急に変化した……？」村正《その疑問、納得のいく回答が一つだけ思い
つくんだけど、聞く？》景明「妙に嫌な予感がするが聞こう」村正《神だから》景明「納得はできるが解決策になっていない！」村正《そうよね……》

en: 〝—Hmph. Such a deep mystery you are making of a simple matter.〟
ja:
〝――ふん。
　そう奥深い謎があるわけではないのだがな〟

en: Muramasa《...》Kageaki"..."Muramasa《Did you hear something just now?》Kageaki"Hear... or was it more that I FELT something...?"
ja:
村正《……》景明「……」村正《今、何か聴こえた？》景明「聴こえた、というより。
　感じた……？」

en:
A voice with no sound.
Was that... a thought?

Coming to us from the Metal God—
ja:
声なき声。
　今のは……思念？

　金神から送られてくる――

en:
〝This god is a thickheaded fool. Yet somehow it managed to understand that things were going badly BECAUSE it was a thickheaded fool.
So it went looking for something to supply the missing intelligence. And among the flotsam it had already swallowed, it found ME, with precisely the qualification required—〟

〝Breathed life into me. Set me working again.
...Brought this man back from the dead, and put him in charge of the head!〟
ja:
〝この神は低能だが、不思議にも、どうもうまくいか・・・・・・・・
ない・・理由が自分の低能さにある事は悟れたらしい。
　補うものを求め……以前に取り込んでいた漂着物おれが
その素質を備えていると感付き、〟

〝そこへ息吹を吹き込んで、活性化させた。
　……この身を黄泉帰らせ、頭に据えたのよ！〟

en: Kageaki"————"

I knew this.
A thought has no colour, no shape—what was there to recognise? A fair question. But still, that wave of will was pulling at my memory.

...I knew him.
Whoever was sending it, I had met him before.

Somewhere—
ja:
覚えがある。
　色も形もない思念に覚えというのも妙なものだが、
しかし事実、この意思の波は俺の記憶を刺激する。

　……知っている。
　俺は思念の主を知っている。嘗て出会っている。

　何処かで――

en:
〝Tch... In this ungainly shape, even getting a word out is such a bloody effort.〟

〝I am changing the shape.〟
ja:
〝ちィ……
　この不恰好な形なりでは声を出すのも億劫でたまらん〟

〝姿を変えるぞ〟

en:
A noise like an earthquake and a thunderclap arriving together. The god's body began to change.
That forest of crystal was becoming something with a completely different structure.

There was a head.
Arms were there.
Legs.
ja:
地震と落雷が同時発生したならさもあろうかという
轟音を響かせ、〝神〟の体が変容する。
　水晶の森のようであった形が、全く別の構造を持つ
ものへ。

　頭がある。
　腕がある。
　脚がある。

en: Muramasa《Human?》Kageaki"…No."
ja: 村正《人間？》景明「……いや」

en:
Armour, too.
Wings.
And a sword hanging at the side.
ja:
装甲がある。
　母衣つばさがある。
　佩刀がある。

en: Kageaki"A dragoon."
ja: 景明「竜騎兵」

en:
Not a human body. An armoured warrior.

And this shape, I definitely knew.

THAT man.
ja:
それは武者だった。

　確かに見覚えのある姿だった。

　あの男・・・だった。

en: Kageaki"UKYO NAGASAKA!!"Nagasaka《Hah! Now you recognise me... Your blood takes its own sweet time reaching the brain, you young fool!!》
ja:
景明「長坂右京!!」長坂《はッ！　ようやく気付きおったか……
　血の巡りの悪い若造め!!》

en: Muramasa《...That MAGISTRATE?!》
ja: 村正《……あの代官っ!?》

en:
After that one cry, Muramasa had no words left. Fair enough. Reality was giving me the same difficulty.

Why was Ukyo Nagasaka appearing here?
What connection did he have with the Metal God? No, leave that question for later—◆first explain how a DEAD MAN—!
ja:
短く叫んだきり、村正は絶句した。
　無理もない。現実を疑う思いは俺とて同じだ。

　何故、長坂右京がここで現れるのか。
　彼と金神の間に何の接点がある？　いやそれ以前の
問題だ――◆死んだ筈の男がどうして！

en: Nagasaka《Oho... WHAT a feeling! I can feel it boiling in me! This is life, is it? THIS is power!》Nagasaka《I have come back to the world of the living! And with the mountain's Metal God supplying the power...》Nagasaka《What happiness! Can there BE any greater happiness?! KAAHAHAHAHAHAHAH!!》
ja:
長坂《おお……良い心地よ！
　感じるわ。滾るわ。これが命、これが力か》長坂《俺は現世うつしよに戻ってきたのだな！
　お山の金神かみの力を持って……》長坂《愉快よ！　これほど愉快な話もないわ！
　かァはははははははははッッ!!》

en:
The man I had sent over the edge into death with these very hands was standing in front of me and laughing.
And what a size he had chosen for doing it. A giant reaching into the clouds.

If this was not a nightmare, what was?
Only, there was no warm bed waiting underneath it. No waking up and finding it had all been a dream.
ja:
この手で確かに死の淵へ堕とした男が、いま眼前に
立って大笑する。
　しかもその姿たるや、雲を衝つく巨人。

　悪しき夢でなくて何であろう。
　だがこれは決して、暖かい寝床で微睡まどろみの内に見る
幻影などではなかった。

en: Kageaki"Muramasa... can such a thing happen? Bringing the dead back through gravity manipulation?"Muramasa《Nahin! Dead means DEAD! Coming back to life is absolutely impossible!》
ja:
景明「村正……有り得る事か？
　重力操作による死者の蘇生というのは」村正《有り得ない！
　死んだものが生き返るなんて、絶対にない
ことよ！》

en:
Her certainty came out almost as a scream.
Then, in a much smaller voice, the qualification arrived.
ja:
悲鳴のような声音で村正は言い切った。
　それから、小声で言い添える。

en: Muramasa《...But something resembling it... maybe THAT could be done...》Muramasa《Taking the dead body as a foundation, and building something close to what the person was when alive...》Kageaki"Is that what we're looking at?"
ja:
村正《……でも。
　擬似的なことなら……できるのかも……》村正《死骸を基礎にして、その生前に近い存在を
造り上げることなら……》景明「それがあれか？」

en:
Even if it was, one question was still sitting there.
How had his corpse come into the god's possession?

...That mountain I had brought down when I cut down Ukyo Nagasaka. There had been a legend about a curse-bringing god there, hadn't there—?
ja:
としても、やはり疑問は残る。
　その死骸がどうして〝神〟のもとにあったのか？

　……そう言えば、長坂右京を斬るおり諸共に崩した
あの山には、祟り神の伝承があったが――

en: Nagasaka《I can smell her. Yes... that scent...》Nagasaka《Ichihime is nearby! Ah, so you have come to welcome me!》Nagasaka《Naturally! You promised your devotion to a god, and now who is the god? ME! Your exclusive god, no other fellow need apply!》Nagasaka《NOW, AT LAST!!》
ja:
長坂《匂う。
　匂うぞ……》長坂《一媛が近くにおる！
　そうか……俺を迎えに来たか》長坂《であろう。お前は神に嫁ぐと言った女。
　即ちお前を娶るのは、この俺に他ならぬ！》長坂《今こそ!!》

en: Kageaki"Whoa…!"
ja: 景明「うぉっ……！」

en:
The enormous dragoon took one step.
Bas, one step only. The whole of Mount Fuji shook, and even the air trembled.

Apparently he intended to leave the summit and go somewhere.
ja:
巨おおきな竜騎兵が一歩、足を進める。
　ただそれだけの事で大富嶽は震撼し、空気までもが
戦慄わなないた。

　あれは山頂を離れ、何処かへ向かう気でいるらしい。

en: Muramasa《…Mido!》
ja: 村正《……御堂！》

en:
The metallic ring of my armour's voice warned me of danger.

Danger. Haan, that was the point I needed to remember.
I shoved all the questions into a corner of my head and forced it to attend to the present problem.

If THAT thing went down among human settlements, what chance did anyone have of coming through unharmed?
This was no Gulliver out of a fanciful travel book. The man was drunk on godhood. Expecting him to mind where the little people lived would be optimism beyond all reasonable limits.

And the shape had changed, but the thing inside was still the god. Still the source of the contamination waves spreading across the world.

One job for me. The same job as before.
ja:
劒冑の金打声が危険を告げる。

　危険――そう、これは危険！
　俺は異常事態への疑問を頭の隅に追いやり、思考の
切り替えを己に強要した。

　あんなものが人里へ降りて、無事に済む筈もない。
　空想旅行記の巨人ガリバーとは違う。〝神〟の力に酔う風の
あの男に小人・・の世界への配慮を期待するのは、希望的
観測が過ぎている。

　加えてあれは形こそ変われど〝神〟、全世界に蔓延
してゆく汚染波の源なのだ。
　
　俺のやるべき事は一つだった。

en: Kageaki"NAGASAKA!!"Nagasaka《Still here, mosquito? Whether you exist or not is no concern of mine.》Nagasaka《Tuck that tail between your legs and go bark from a safe distance!》Kageaki"Personally, I would be delighted. Unfortunately, my position seems to require the mosquito to fly INTO the fire!"
ja:
景明「長坂!!」長坂《まだいたか羽虫。
　貴様など、別にどうでも良いわ》長坂《尻尾を巻いて遠吠えしておれ！》景明「そうしたいのは山々だが、立場上、飛んで
火に入らねばならぬらしい！」

en:
I went for the neck.
Human weak points might mean nothing to this enormous thing. Still, at least it was a plan—
ja:
狙うは首元。
　人体急所があの巨兵に適用されるとも考え難いが、
無策よりはまし――

en: Nagasaka《GHOAAH?!》Kageaki"Ngh."
ja: 長坂《ごぉァ!?》景明「ぬぅ」

en:
—Same result as having no plan!

The impact was like hitting a rock with a wooden sword. My teeth ground together.

Before, I had at least felt a wound going in. Now, nothing.
I had thought the dragoon shape was Nagasaka dressing himself up. But the surface had actually become as hard as warrior armour—harder, even?!
ja:
――同じ事か！
　
　木刀で岩を叩くにも似る強硬な手応えを味わわされ、
俺は歯噛みした。

　先刻と違い、全く傷を負わせた感触がない。
　竜騎兵姿は単なる長坂の伊達かと思えば――実際に
体表は武者甲鉄と同等、いや凌駕する硬度を獲得して
いる!?

en: Nagasaka《STOP MAKING ME ITCH, YOU PEST!!》
ja: 長坂《痒い真似をォ!!》

en:
He swung an arm as though brushing off an insect. I turned my armoured body and fled from its path.
The great blast of air that followed told me how absurdly much that arm weighed.

The Inch-High Samurai. Now I understood what the poor fellow had been up against.
ja:
虫を払う仕草で振られた腕から、騎体を転じて逃れ
去る。
　吹き寄せる太い風は、敵の桁違いの重量を物語って
いた。

　一寸法師の心細さが今なら良くわかる。

en: Nagasaka《You bloody young bastard! Again today you have come to obstruct me?!》Kageaki"Due to certain personal circumstances."Nagasaka《And that way of talking! Same as ever, making my blood boil. Achha. I will deal with you.》Nagasaka《Now that I consider it, leaving my account with YOU unsettled would also be intolerable. Let me clear this grievance first. There will be time enough to go to Ichihime afterward...!》
ja:
長坂《面憎い若造め！
　今日もまた俺の邪魔をするかッ！》景明「一身上の都合により」長坂《相変わらずの言い草も忌々しいわ。
　良し……相手してくれるぞ》長坂《考えてみれば、貴様への借りを置き捨てて
おくのも業腹だ。
　一媛のもとへ赴くのは遺恨を晴らしてから
でも遅くなかろうよ……！》

en:
The warrior was a rumbling mountain. The sword he raised was a great river frozen solid.
Acala Natha, wrathful and ready to cut down evil—that was exactly the sight before me.

A threat? Such a small word for it.
Fear had taken the form of stomach acid and was climbing into my throat.

With every bit of strength I had, I pushed it back down where it belonged. Then I muttered:
ja:
鳴動する山のような武者が凍れる大河のような太刀
を構える。
　憤怒し魔を断たんとす不動明王アチャラ・ナータ――まさにそれその
ものであった。

　脅威、などという言葉では足りない。
　胃液の形をした恐怖が喉元まで迫せり上がってくる。

　全身全霊の力でそれを腹へ押し戻し、俺は呟いた。

en: Kageaki"Good. Here is our chance."Muramasa《...I can see how much effort went into saying that. I WANT to praise you, but first I have to put in the same amount of effort just to agree with you.》Kageaki"No need to trouble yourself. So long as you understand what I intend."
ja:
景明「良し。好機だ」村正《……ものすごく努力してその一言を言った
のがわかるから、褒めてあげたいんだけれど、
その前に私も同じくらい頑張って今の言葉に
頷かないといけないのね》景明「いや別にいい。
　俺の意図が通じてさえいるなら」

en:
On that point, there was no need even to check.
While her metallic voice was busy making light of things, Muramasa was already getting her functions ready.
ja:
そこは確かめるまでもなかった。
　軽口の金打声を飛ばしながらも、村正は既に機能の
準備を整えつつある。

en:
The god's fighting ability had increased enormously. No doubt about that.
All because, by whatever means, it had acquired Ukyo Nagasaka for a brain.
ja:
〝神〟は戦闘能力を飛躍的に増強した。
　間違いなく――如何なる所以ゆえんによってか長坂右京を
頭脳に得た一事で。

en:
No longer a monster throwing gravity about any which way.
All that immense power now had an experienced warrior directing it. And he had even remade the body into a dragoon—the shape he knew best how to handle. A demon-god.

Where there had been no tactics, now there was cunning.
Where power had gone everywhere wastefully, now it was being put exactly where it could do its work.

No doubt about either point. And comparing our strengths had become very simple.

In the beginning, the god had the entire advantage in power. I had the entire advantage in tactics.
Once Nagasaka became its brain, tactics came close to equal. Even then, it seemed he still had the disadvantage of operating that unfamiliar body.
ja:
既にあれは重力操作を放漫に駆使する怪獣モンスターではない。
　その膨大を極める力量エネルギーを、老練なる武人の制御下に
置かれ、しかも彼が最も操りやすい竜騎兵型かたちへと変貌
すらしている――魔神サターンなのだ。

　皆無であった戦術構想は狡猾な進化を、
　粗雑であった力量使用は劇的な効率化を、
　
　遂げているとみて疑いない。
　戦力比較は今や単純化されている。

　最初は力量で〝神〟が、戦術で俺が完全優位だった。
　長坂を頭脳とした時点で戦術は互角に近くなったが、
それでもまだ慣れぬ異形を操る不利は〝神〟側に存在
したと思われる。

en:
And now?◆

...¦
If Ukyo Nagasaka's skill and¦
Kageaki Minato's were equal, all that remained was the difference in power. Earth here, sky there!

Huge on his side. Tiny on mine.
That was the whole calculation.
ja:
今はどうか。◆
　
　……¦
長坂右京と¦
湊斗景明の戦闘技量を互角とするの
なら、後は力量における天地の隔絶のみがある！

　巨と小の絶対的格差。
　それだけだ。それしかない。

en: And STILL, this was our chance.
ja: 而しかして、今は好機なのだ。

en:
Because now it was sword against sword.
The calculations that worked against a human being, against a trained warrior, would work here too.

Yes, the difference in weight and power was ridiculous.
But those were conditions of the fight. Not its result.

If the bodies were unequal, then I needed a technique that would overturn that inequality.
ja:
何故なら剣と・・剣・の勝負になる。
　人間相手、武人相手の計算が通用する。

　体重、力量の不利は余りにも大きい。
　だが、それはあくまで戦闘条件の一つだ。

　体格差があるならば、その差を覆す技法を用意する
までの事だ。

en:
Such a technique had to exist.◆

Otherwise, what were martial arts FOR?¦
What was swordsmanship for?
ja:
技法、それは必ず存在する。◆

　そのための武術、¦
そのための剣術なのだから。

en:
I looked at the demon-god's guard and read the swordsmanship it expressed.

...Same as before. This old soldier Nagasaka could rage and shout all he liked, but not one scrap of that temper came into his actual fighting.

Drunk on the Metal God's power, thinking me no better than a miserable insect—and still, his sword showed no intention of coming at me in some thoughtless rush.
One mind. One blade. Quietly waiting for the chance that would kill.
ja:
魔神の構かまえに、そこへ捧げられた剣理を観る。
　
　……以前と同様、この長坂という老兵は、激情家で
ありながら戦いの場には欠片もそれを持ち込まない。

　金神の力に酔い、俺を屑虫と侮り、しかしその剣先
は無思慮な突進の愚を冒す気色もなかった。
　一心一刀、必殺の勝機を沈静に窺っている。

en: Kageaki(Rokuhara Shinkage School... Katsunintou. The inner principle of the Life-Giving Sword.)
ja: 景明（六波羅新陰流……活人刀カツニントウの奥理おうり）

en:
I recognised it and named it to myself.
Not my school. Still, Rokuhara Shinkage and I kept meeting. Some people meet relatives this frequently. I meet people explaining, by demonstration, how they intend to cut me into pieces. A little knowledge accumulates.

The demon-god's guard was solid.
Look properly, though: one opening. Thin as a thread.

Haan. That was the trap.

Make your defence completely perfect and the enemy gets time to think. Thinking is dangerous. Some fellow who has no business being clever may suddenly become clever, and now your perfect defence is lying on the floor asking what happened. Why take this trouble? Leave him one little hole yourself.

There, bhai. See? An opportunity. Yours only. Attack here.

And the grateful fellow spends his strength, his skill, his precious moment—all inside the little dance you have prepared for him. He thinks he is taking the initiative. You are deciding even the direction in which his stupidity will travel.

Give the enemy room to live and act, and through that, bring him down. The Life-Giving Sword. Very generous. Life is being given strictly on the understanding that it will shortly be taken back.

With a god's power behind it, Nagasaka's method became stronger still. Suppose he misjudged a parry and my blade got through: that body could bear it. Mine, on the other hand, could be slaughtered by one graze of his returning sword.

He could afford a mistake. I could not afford the edge of a mistake passing nearby.

A formula for certain victory.

—And my answer was:
ja:
見て取って、俺は胸腑に呟いた。
　他流儀だが、六波羅新陰流とは奇妙に関わりを持つ
事が多く、多少の知識を持っている。

　魔神の剣形は如何にも堅牢なもの。
　だが詳細に目を凝らせば、糸筋程度の隙が見える。

　それこそが陥穽わな。

　完璧に防御を固めれば、対敵は考えを巡らせたすえ、
思いもよらぬ手管を用いる事もあろう。
　そうさせぬため、あえて攻め入る穴をつくる。

　我が想定の範囲内で敵を踊らせ、力と技と機を無為
に費えさせるのだ。さすれば勝利はいとも容易い。
　
　――敵を活いかして斃す、これぞ活人刀。

　長坂が得た〝神〟の力は剣理を補強するだろう。
　受け誤って敵刃を浴びようと堪こたえる体躯ではない。
そして返す太刀は掠める程度で充分、敵を虐殺する。

　必勝の術式。
　
　
　――対するに、俺は、

en: Nagasaka《…Khuhu…》
ja: 長坂《……クク……》

en:
The demon-god seemed to smile with complete satisfaction.
He had probably understood my intention.

—Go along with his swordsmanship.

Take the bait he was offering.
Poison included. Eat the whole thing.

Take the initiative and attack exactly where he had deliberately left room for me.

Against his deep, elaborate principle, put one very crude and simple principle.

—Strike first. Kill first. Win before he does.

Setsunintou. The Life-Taking Sword.
Of course the demon-god sneered.
ja:
魔神長坂は会心の笑みを浮かべたようであった。
　俺の企図を汲んだのであろう。

　――敵の剣理に、乗る。

　差し出された餌を喰らう。
　毒仕込みのそれを貪ろう。

　先手を取り、故意に作られた隙へ攻め入ろう。

　深遠精緻なる剣理に、単純粗雑の剣理で挑む。
　
　――先手必勝。先に攻め先に斃して勝を取れ。

　即ち殺人刀セツニントウ。
　魔神の嘲りは当然であった。

en: Kageaki(But, Ukyo Nagasaka...)
ja: 景明（しかし長坂右京）

en:
You may not be getting careless. Even so, there is one thing you have not understood.
The right to kill is not exclusively yours. I also have it.

God or no god.
ja:
油断こそ無いにしても、やはりお前は知るまい。
　殺害権は俺にも有るという事実を。

　例え御身が神であろうが。

en:
Turn the clock of blood around the centre in my lower abdomen.
Faster. Gather it. Put it in order.

Shift the heat.
The necessary amount, exactly where it is needed.

Build the engine inside my own body.
For Kageaki Minato and Third Uemon-no-jou Muramasa to bring our whole destructive power to bear. Maximum scale. Absolute limit. The full quantity. Nothing kept aside.
ja:
丹田を軸に血の時計を回す。
　加速し収拾し編成する。

　熱量を偏移。
　必要箇所に必要量を。

　我が体内に機関を造れ。
　湊斗景明と三世右衛門尉村正の最大規模・極限値・
絶対量・完全武力の破壊行使のために。

en: Muramasa《Begin the end.》Muramasa《Enact death.》Muramasa《Reveal the void.》
ja: 村正《蒐窮開闢おわりをはじめる》村正《終焉執行しをおこなう》村正《虚無発現そらをあらわす》

en: Nagasaka《————————》

A sharp little prickle of alarm reached into my brain.

You will understand now.
By now, even you will understand, Ukyo Nagasaka.

What I—Muramasa—am doing.

So? What will you do?
Will you stop it?

All that godly power of yours. Will it stop this one sword?
ja:
ちり、と警戒の気配が俺の脳髄を刺した。

　悟るだろう。
　今となれば悟るだろう長坂右京。

　村正おれが何をしているか。

　どうする。
　止めてみせるか。

　神なる力で、この一剣を止めるか。

en:
The basic method was the same as Magatsu, one of the electromagnetic draw forms.
Muramasa, the armour, produced a tremendous magnetic repulsion between sheath and blade. I, the wielder, guided that torrent into the drawing cut.
The method had not changed. Only the quantity.
The scale. The speed. The force.

If the ordinary sword could hold a hundred units of fighting power, Kotetsu, the nodachi, could hold ten thousand.
ja:
基本となる術式は、電磁抜刀の一、禍マガツの型と変わり
ない。
　劒冑むらまさは鞘と刀身の間に強激な磁力反発を生じさせ、
仕手おれはその激流を操って抜刀斬撃と成す。
　異なるのは式ではなく量。
　規模――速度――威力の。

　武力の容器として太刀が一〇〇であったとすれば、
野太刀〝虎徹〟は一〇〇〇〇に届く。

en: Nagasaka《CHERAAAAAAAH!!》
ja: 長坂《ちぇらぁぁぁァァァァァァァ!!》

en:
At the very last moment, the demon-god finally made the right decision.
Threw away the Life-Giving Sword's principle and brought his blade down in a desperate rush—

Frightening.

Ukyo Nagasaka. What a warrior this man was.

None of this had been expected on my side. On his, it must have been still worse. Suddenly brought back to life, handed this absurd divine power that made no sense...◆
And even through all that, right to the end, he had not forgotten how to be a warrior.
ja:
土壇場、魔神は遂に正しい決断を下した。
　活人刀の剣理を振り捨て、闇雲に太刀を落とす――

　恐ろしい。

　何という兵つわものか、長坂右京。

　この一幕は俺にとっても不測だが、長坂にとっては
尚の事だろう。突如として再生させられ、わけのわか
らぬ巫山戯ふざけた神威ちからを与えられ……◆
　だが最後まで武人としての己を見失わなかったとは。

en: Kageaki(That was close.)
ja: 景明（危うかった）

en:
I felt relief, and there was nothing noble about it.

He had made the correct decision. Bas, a little too late. That was what I was so grateful for.

Because now,
I
was faster.
ja:
俺は卑屈にも安堵する。

　長坂の正しい決断が、正しい機よりほんの少しだけ
遅れてくれた事に。

　今ならば、
　俺の方が、
　速い。

en: Kageaki"A variation on Thunderclap, of the Yoshino Style Rules of Engagement."
ja: 景明「吉野御流合戦礼法〝迅雷〟が崩し」

en: Kageaki"Railgun."
ja: 景明「電磁抜刀レールガン」

en: Kageaki"Ugachi."
ja: 景明「穿ウガチ」

en: Nagasaka《GYOOOOOOOOOOOOOOH?!》
ja: 長坂《ぎぃぃおおおおオオオオオオオオオオオ!?》

en:
It shattered.

Where the nodachi had passed—
there was a void.

The void spread.
Where there had been something, it put nothing.

It ate through blood and soul, bone and flesh. Through life itself.

God? Demon-god?
Hollow out the core that holds the whole structure together, and what is left for it to do?

Collapse.
ja:
砕け散る。

　野太刀が疾はしった軌道――
　そこには虚空が現れた。

　虚空は領域を広げ、
　無をもって有を侵食し、
　
　血魂骨肉セイメイを食い破った。

　神であろうと。
　魔神であろうと。
　構造核芯を刳くり貫ぬかれたならば、後は崩壊を遂げる
のみ。

en: Kageaki"............"Muramasa《...It's over...》
ja: 景明「…………」村正《……終わりね……》

en:
We watched it through to the end.

What had been the god of smithing.
What had been Ukyo Nagasaka.

And what had been—.

We watched them go.
ja:
結末を見届ける。

　鍛冶の神であったもの。
　長坂右京であったもの。
　
　そして、――であったもの。

　その果てを見送る。

en: Nagasaka《O————gh, ghu…》Nagasaka《NUUUUUUUUUUGH!!》
ja: 長坂《お――――が、ぐ》長坂《ぬぅぅぅぅぅぅぅぅぅ!!》

en:
The collapse—◆

—WAS GOING BACKWARD?!
ja:
崩壊が――◆
　
　　　　　　――逆転した!?

en: Muramasa《...It's trying to put itself BACK TOGETHER?!》Kageaki"Impossible!"Nagasaka《TWICE?! TWO TIMES YOU WILL DO THIS TO ME?!》Nagasaka《ME—AT THE HANDS OF A BLOODY BASTARD LIKE YOUUUU?!》
ja:
村正《……復元するつもり!?》景明「馬鹿な！」長坂《二度までも！
　二度までもォォォォォ!!》長坂《貴様などにィィィィ、この俺がァァァァ!!》

en:
What power a god had.
And what an obstinate bastard Nagasaka was.

Even in the middle of complete annihilation, still struggling, still trying to come out the other side...!◆

No. We could not let him.

One more strike should surely finish him.

Did the struggling god understand that too?
He sent the power whirling, no care now whether it ran out of control. At the centre of that vast melting pot of chaos, he roared and howled.
ja:
何という〝神〟の力。
　何という長坂の執念。

　絶対浄滅の渦中にあって尚も足掻き、乗り切ろうと
している……！◆
　
　させてはならない。

　あと一撃を打ち込めば、確実に滅びるだろう。

　足掻く〝神〟もそれを悟っているのか。
　暴走も厭わず力を渦巻かせ、混沌の大坩堝の中心と
なり吼ほえ哮たける。

en: Nagasaka《OOOOOOOOAAAAAAAH!!》
ja: 長坂《オオオオオアアアアアアアアアアア!!》

en: Hikaru《Shabash. A fine duel. Thanks to you, I have woken in an excellent mood.》
ja:
光《良き立合であった。
　お陰で寝覚め・・・が至極いい》

en:
...I heard it.

Just now.
No mistake about it.
That voice—
ja:
……聴いた。

　今、
　確かに、
　声を、

en: Hikaru《But this graceless business at the end, that I cannot approve. Such a martial reputation, and now you are spoiling it yourself.》Hikaru《Among flowers, the cherry; among men, the warrior! Even when you fall, do it GLORIOUSLY!!》
ja:
光《だが往生際の悪さは頂けぬ。
　折角の武名を自ら汚してはなるまいぞ》光《花は桜木人は武士！
　散り様までも華々しくあれ!!》

en: Nagasaka《—What—?》Nagasaka《Ah, oh, GYEEEEEEEEH?!》
ja: 長坂《――何――？》長坂《あ、お、げいいいいいいいいイイイイ!?》

en: Hikaru《Life or death: I ask myself the question I must answer.》Hikaru《Then raise the curtain of comedy upon the delighted whirlpool of mockery.》
ja:
光《生と死の選択を
　己に課す命題として
　自ら問う――――》光《されば嘲笑の歓喜する渦に
　喜劇の幕よ、いざ上がれ!!》

en: Kageaki"HIKARU!!"Hikaru"Your answer, Kageaki—is it ready?! At last, here we are at the end of the world—"Hikaru"And the clown's sophistry and the devil's mask are standing on your very shadow!!"
ja:
景明「光!!」光「答は用意したか、景明!?
　ここは終ついに世界の果て――」光「道化の詭弁と悪魔の仮面が、おまえの影を
踏んでいる!!」

en:
After seeing this, who could still doubt that the world was ending?
Who would look at it and say, no, bhai, this is one temporary difficulty, everything will be becoming normal?

Fuji's beautiful shape was gone. Lava poured from it like thick, dirty blood.
Here, nothing was allowed to live. Nothing allowed to continue. Nothing new allowed to come into being. Ruin only; everything else refused. The whole world reduced to one answer, and that answer was NO.

Who was supposed to live here?
Who COULD live here?
ja:
世界の終熄を誰が疑おう。
　この光景に至って、誰が。

　美しい形を失った富士が、濁血のような溶岩を噴き
流している。
　それは生命を許さぬ、存続を許さぬ、創造を許さぬ、
破滅以外を許さぬ虚界。

　誰がここで生きるのだ。
　誰がここで生きるのだ？

en: Hikaru"The winner only."Hikaru"One winner. At the very end, that one alone will stand."Hikaru"And that one we shall call God. Above the human limit, with the authority to permit himself what no human is permitted—"Kageaki"............"
ja:
光「勝者のみ」光「唯一人の勝者のみが、涯はてに立つ」光「その者をこそ上カミと呼ぼう。
　人に許されざるを自ら許す、超越の権能者
と――」景明「…………」

en:
I had prepared myself for this meeting.

Expected it. Decided exactly what I would do.

Hikaru.
My little sister.

—Hikaru Minato, sunk into her own dream.

When I met her, I would kill her. That was decided.

...Decided, no? So now,
straightaway,
ja:
覚悟していた邂逅だった。

　出会いを期し、為すべき事も決めていた。

　光。
　我が妹。
　
　――自らの夢に沈んだ、湊斗光。

　会えば殺すと、決めていた。

　……決めていたのだから。
　今、すぐに、

en: Kageaki"Hikaru."Hikaru"Haan."
ja: 景明「光」光「うむ」

en:
Even that murmur, Hikaru did not let go unanswered.
A nod. A little smile with it.

Hot air was blowing up from the burning ground, and there she was, almost peaceful.

But me. What I had to do was—
ja:
呟きさえ聞き流さず、光が応じる。
　頷いて。微笑を含めて。

　燃える地上から熱気流が吹く中、その様子は穏やか
ですらある。
　
　しかし、俺は。俺のすべきは、

en: Kageaki"Is it... really you?"Hikaru"Arre, what Zen riddle have you brought me now?"
ja: 景明「お前……なのか？」光「何だ、その禅問答は」

en: She chuckled.
ja: くつくつ、と笑う。

en: Hikaru"No, I understand. Nearly getting blown away, buried under the earth, meeting something peculiar down there—quite a number of developments. Did I make you worry...?"Kageaki"..."Hikaru"No need. It happened to ME and I still cannot tell you what exactly happened. But Hikaru is Hikaru. Nobody else."Hikaru"As you can see, alive and in excellent condition!"Kageaki"...I see."
ja:
光「いや、わからんではない。何やら吹っ飛ば
されかけたり地底に埋没したりそこで変なの
に出くわしたり、色々とあったからな。
　心配をかけたか……？」景明「……」光「案ずるな。
　結局なんだったんだか我が事ながら未だに
さっぱりよくわからんが、光は光。他の何者
でもない」光「見ての通り、健在だ！」景明「……そうか」

en:
—No.
This conversation was not what I had come for.

I had to—
ja:
――違う。
　こんな会話は要らない。

　俺は、

en: Kageaki"You spoke of God..."Hikaru"Yes."Kageaki"Is that what you want? To become the god of this world?"Hikaru"WANT to become God? ...Hm. That question I have never considered."Hikaru"But that I MUST become God, I know. Otherwise Hikaru's wish cannot be fulfilled."Hikaru"This is the road you and Muramasa the Second showed me."Kageaki"............ But you are already practically a god, aren't you?"Hikaru"...Hm?"
ja:
景明「神と言ったな……」光「あぁ」景明「お前は、この世の神になりたいのか」光「神になりたいか・・・・・・・？
　……ふむ、それは考えたこともない」光「だが、ならなくてはならぬ・・・・・・・・・と知っている。
　ならねば、光の望みが叶わぬ」光「これはおまえと二世ムラマサが教えてくれた道」景明「…………。
　だがお前は、既に神も同然だろう」光「……うん？」

en:
—No.
Not more words. Not searching for an escape route inside the conversation—
ja:
――違う。
　こう、逃げ場を探すように言辞を弄するのではなく、

en: Kageaki"I can see it... That god shattered, but its power has not disappeared."Kageaki"It is inside you."Hikaru"...?"Muramasa II《Mido, he must be referring to THIS.》
ja:
景明「見ればわかる……。
　あの〝神〟は砕けて散ったが、神威ちからは失わ
れていない」景明「おまえの中にある」光「……？」二世村正《御堂、これ・・のことであろう》

en: Hikaru"Ah... THIS thing!"Muramasa II《It is quite something.》Hikaru"Feels as though I have grown about ten extra livers."Kageaki"...Then surely that is enough. You have the power to call yourself a god."Kageaki"What more do you want on top of that?"Hikaru"Heh. You know the answer perfectly well, but still you ask. This is the strange thing about you."Kageaki"..."Hikaru"No—first of all, Hikaru has not yet earned that seat."Hikaru"This mysterious power was already mine before I even noticed. Enormous power, certainly..."Hikaru"But power alone makes a god? Then shall we call the dinosaur God? The tidal wave God? An eighty-centimetre heavy railway gun—God also?"Hikaru"You cannot say yes to that, no?"Kageaki"..."Hikaru"Power is power only. It is the cause. Not the result."Hikaru"Many conquerors in the past called themselves gods. Was it because they possessed power? No. They USED it to subdue nations. That achievement made the kings believe they carried divinity. Their subjects believed it too."Kageaki"...Then you—"
ja:
光「ああ……これか！」二世村正《なかなか、大したものではある》光「肝臓が十個くらい増えた感じだな」景明「……それで、もう充分だろう。
　お前は神と名乗れるだけの力を持っている」景明「このうえ更に、何を望む」光「ふふ。
　わかり切ったことをあえて訊く……そこが
おまえの不思議なところだ」景明「……」光「いや――そも、光は未だ神の座に値せず」光「気付けば手に入れていたこの謎の力。
　なるほど、確かに強大だ……」光「しかし、力さえあれば神たるのか？
　では恐竜は神か。海嘯は神か。八〇センチ
重列車砲は神か――」光「頷けまい？」景明「……」光「力は、力に過ぎぬ。
　因であって果ではない」光「過去、幾人もの覇王が神を自称した。
　それは彼らに力があったからか。否。力を
もって国々を切り従えたからこそ、王は己に
神性宿るを信じたのだ。臣民もまた」景明「……なら、お前は」

en: Even now. Still determined to go through with it.
ja: あくまで。

en: Hikaru"Hikaru respects history. So I shall follow the road it shows. However much fighting power I possess, first let the world see the RESULTS. Until then, no claiming a title I have not earned!"Hikaru"And no repeating their mistakes, either!"Hikaru"All those old conquerors went rotten halfway. Before every human being in the world was conquered, they became satisfied. Drowned themselves in their own power. Gods with the work still unfinished!"Hikaru"And that is why they were overthrown..."Hikaru"I will not do that. The road of conquest, I will walk to the very end."Hikaru"Hikaru Minato will challenge all three hundred crore human beings and make every one of them submit. THEN, on that achievement, I shall take the seat of God!"Kageaki"Whatever happens, you will not let go of this delusion?!"Hikaru"I CANNOT! Delusion, yes! Stupidity, yes! Call it what it is! This one thought is what keeps Hikaru alive!"Hikaru"First, let us prepare the stage. This ridiculous power inside me... there is enough to share with everybody under heaven!"Kageaki"—WHAT are you—?!"Hikaru"For one personal wish, Hikaru demands the defeat and death of all humanity. Then humanity must have the means to resist and reject me. Otherwise where is the FAIRNESS?"Hikaru"So I grant it! The law of martial power! The strength and the will to kill, to fight, to seize!"Hikaru"MARTIAL RULE BENEATH HEAVEN! HERE AND NOW, HIKARU MINATO DECREES IT!!"
ja:
光「光は歴史への敬意のもと、その示す道筋に
従おう。
　いかに大きな武力を持とうが、成果を世に
顕すまでは決して僭称すまい！」光「そして過ちの轍も踏むまい！」光「かつての覇王は皆、中途で堕落した。
　世界人類悉くを征服する前に満足し、力に
溺れ、不完全な神となった」光「ゆえに打倒された……」光「おれは、そうはならぬ。
　覇道の終端までを踏破する」光「湊斗光は三〇億人類全てと勝負し屈服させ、
その事実をもって神座へ至ろう！」景明「お前は、どうしても、
　その妄念を捨てられないのか!?」光「捨てられぬ！
　いかにも妄念、いかにも愚念、されどこの
一念が光の命脈！」光「まずは舞台を整えよう。
　今、光に宿るこの戯けた力……天下万民と
分かち合うにも充分だ！」景明「――――何を!?」光「光は一身の願いから全人類の敗死を求む。
　ならば諸人もろびとは光の意思に抗い拒絶するため
の能を持たなくてはなるまい――でなくては
不公正・・・！」光「ゆえに授ける！
　武の一法！　殺伐争奪の力と心を！」光「天下布武ッッ!!
　今ここに、湊斗光が発令した!!」

en:
Her silver right hand pointed at the heavens and fired a flash of light.
Like lightning going the wrong way, upward.

A hole opened in the dark sky. A bullet wound in it.

—And all around that hole, the air began to writhe.
ja:
銀の右手が天を指し、閃光を撃ち出した。
　あたかも逆上さかのぼる稲妻。

　暗空に銃創を思わせる孔が開く。
　
　――その周囲で、大気がうねった。

en:
Round and round.

Clouds tore apart and scattered. The sky had been like a sea in the stillness of morning. Now that sea was turning rough.

A furious whirlwind around the eye at its centre...
A typhoon, almost—but—
ja:
渦を巻く。

　雲が引き裂かれて散った。
　朝凪あさなぎの海に似た空は時化しけの海へ模様を変えた。

　中央の目・を軸に荒れ狂う旋風……
　まるで台風のようだ――が、

en: Kageaki"Muramasa, that is—"Muramasa《...A mass of contamination waves! The concentration is unbelievable...》Muramasa《If THAT hits us, surely even the armour won't stop it!》
ja:
景明「村正、あれは――」村正《……汚染波の塊よ！
　途轍もない濃度の……》村正《あんなのを浴びたらきっと、甲鉄でも防げ
ない！》

en:
—Mental contamination that would not spare even armoured warriors!

Was that what this storm would bring...?
ja:
――武者をも逃さない精神汚染！
　
　あの嵐が、それをもたらす……？

en: Muramasa《And... is that not the only thing...?》Hikaru"Correct, spider. This is a storm of martial power."Hikaru"It will pour silver wind and rain over the earth. Give people the strength and the spirit of warriors. Make them the equals of this Hikaru."Kageaki"—Wha...?!"Hikaru"Humanity, fully armed! Body AND mind! Fight your way to victory among them, and then you have a warrior worthy of godhood!"
ja:
村正《しかも……それだけじゃ、ない……？》光「そうとも、蜘蛛。
　これは武の嵐・・・だ」光「白銀の雨風を地上に注いで回り……
　人々に武の力と魂を与え、この光と同等の
武人に仕上げる」景明「――な……ッ!?」光「これで人類は心身共に完全武装!!
　この中で勝ち抜いてこそ、神たる武人!!」

en:
That meant—
No, surely not—
She meant—
ja:
それは、
　まさか、
　つまり――

en:
That same catastrophe, now on a still greater scale?!

Drive people into pointless slaughter and struggle—
AFTER giving them power equal to the Silver Star's.

Was that the plan?
How much of anything would be left after THAT much destruction?!
ja:
あの惨劇の拡大再生産か!?

　人々を無為の殺戮闘争へ駆り立てる――
　銀星号と同等の力・・・・・・・・を与えた上で。

　そういう事なのか？
　それは――どれほどの破壊破滅を成し遂げる!?

en:
There was no confusion in the way Hikaru stood. No sign that she was joking, either.
First make all humanity as strong as herself. Then destroy all humanity. She said it, and she was already doing it.

Not one doubt about what she was doing.

—Another storm took shape.

Not just the one.
Two. Three. One after another.
ja:
光の佇まいには迷妄も諧謔も、どちらの色彩も存在
しない。
　全人類を滅ぼすと云い、それに先立って全人類を己
と同じ最強者にすると云い、そして実行に移しながら。

　己の行為への疑念が一切無い。
　
　――嵐が創られる。

　一つではない。
　二つ、三つと、次々に生成されてゆく。

en: Hikaru"The Russian Empire!"
ja: 光「露帝ロシア！」

en: Hikaru"The Great Han Empire!"
ja: 光「大漢カン！」

en: Hikaru"Europe! The Middle East!"
ja:
光「欧州！
　中東！」

en: Hikaru"The New Continent! The Dark Continent!"
ja:
光「新大陸！
　暗黒大陸！」

en: Hikaru"Yamato!"
ja: 光「大和！」

en:
...One command from the Silver Star, and the storms went charging in the directions she gave them. Obedient generals, every one.

Darkness and wind scattered before them.
ja:
……銀星号の号令一下。
　嵐たちは忠実な部将のように、示された方角へ突き
進んでゆく。

　闇と風を蹴散らして。

en: Kageaki"...Muramasa..."Muramasa《...》Kageaki"Can you tell how long those will take to contaminate the whole world?"Muramasa《Probably... not even an hour—》Hikaru"Roughly forty-five minutes, I should say."
ja:
景明「……村正……」村正《……》景明「あれが全世界を汚染するのに、どの程度の
時間が必要かわかるか」村正《多分……一時間とは》光「およそ四五分だろう」

en: The person doing it kindly supplied the clarification herself.
ja: 親切な注釈が、実行者から入った。

en: Kageaki"..."Kageaki"How do we stop them?"Muramasa《Cut off the source.》Muramasa《Those storms aren't independent. They're still connected to the thing producing them, so—》
ja:
景明「……」景明「止める方法は？」村正《元を断つ》村正《あの嵐は独立してない。
　発生源と繋がったままだから――》

en:
Destroy the source.
Destroy the Silver Star, and the contamination storms would break up too.
ja:
根源を、
　銀星号を滅ぼせば、汚染の嵐も散る。

en: Kageaki"…………"

I had to kill her.

I had known that long ago. Now the same fact stood in front of me, with still less time left for me to accept it.

Kill Hikaru.
Now. Abhi.

While I stood here hesitating, time was still passing.
While I went back and forth in my head, still passing.
Draw the sword. Now.
ja:
殺さなくてはならない。
　
　――とうにわかりきっていた事は、更に差し迫った
現実と化して俺の前に据えられている。

　光を、殺さなくてはならない。
　すぐに。すぐに。

　迷う間にも。
　逡巡する間にも。
　太刀を抜き、今すぐに。

en: Kageaki"—"Kageaki"What do you WANT... Hikaru?!"Kageaki"Doing all this—what do you want from it?!"Hikaru"Very well. Ask as many times as you like. Each time you ask, Hikaru will shout the same answer. My resolve is not changing."Hikaru"MY FATHER!!"Kageaki"...!"Hikaru"Hikaru wants ONE thing! GIVE ME BACK MY FATHER!!"
ja:
景明「――――」景明「何を望む……光！」景明「そこまでの事を為し、何を!!」光「良い。幾度でも答えてやる。
　おまえが問いを重ねるなら、光も同じだけ
変わらぬ決意を叫ぼう」光「父を!!」景明「……ッ……」光「光の望みは唯一つ！
　我が父を返せ・・・・・・!!」

en: The being that was Hikaru Minato's hidden self—her dream—shouted the longing at the bottom of that dream.
ja: 湊斗光の深層ゆめである存在は、湊斗光の悲願ゆめを叫んだ。

en: Hikaru"The source that brought me into this world—I want to know my father's love is real!"Hikaru"For that, Hikaru will destroy Mother and destroy the world. Destroy everything that takes Father away and holds him captive. For that I shall become God. What human morality forbids, divine authority shall accomplish: I shall have my father back."
ja:
光「おれをこの世に生み落とした根源を――
　父の愛を確かめたい！」光「そのために光は母を滅ぼし、世界を滅ぼす。
父を奪い束縛する全てを滅ぼす。
　そのために光は神となる。人倫ひとのみちに許されぬ
父の奪回を神権によって成し遂げる」

en:
A pearl has fallen into the sea. How will you find it?
Burn the whole sea away with hellfire. That was the sort of answer she was giving.
ja:
それはあたかも――
　海に落とした一粒の真珠を探すという難題に、業火
をもって海を焼き溶かすと解くかのよう。

en: Hikaru"You ask why? Why I want it so badly?"Hikaru"Because it has been TAKEN FROM ME!!"
ja:
光「何故、と問うか？
　何故、かくも求めるのかと」光「それが奪われているから・・・・・・・・だッッ!!」

en:
〝This child has no father.〟

〝This child is not your daughter.〟

〝You must not… love this child.〟
ja:
〝この子に父親はいない〟

　
　　　　　〝この子はあなたの娘ではない〟

　
　　　　〝この子を……愛してはならない〟

en: Hikaru"I remember. Those words Mother said to Father when she took him from me. That very instant. My soul remembers it."Hikaru"So how can I leave it like that?! I HAVE TO TAKE HIM BACK!!"
ja:
光「おれは覚えている。
　母が父に告げた強奪の言葉を、その瞬間を、
魂に懸けて記憶している」光「だから取り戻さずにはいられないッ!!」

en:
Not something thought out in the brain. A hunger in life itself.

Someone steals your heart. Can you simply leave it with them? That was what she was saying.

An urge she could not endure. Not by any amount of enduring.
ja:
脳ではない。それは命の渇望。
　
　心臓を盗まれた人間が取り返さずにいられるものか
と、そう云っていた。

　断じて堪こらえられぬ衝動が有るのだと。

en: Kageaki"............"Kageaki"...Your father..."Kageaki"That father of yours—"
ja: 景明「…………」景明「……父は……」景明「お前の、父は」

en: Patriarch〝Kageaki! Come here!〟Patriarch〝Against you, I have no grievance. To order you to do this also pains me. But now, you can only curse the fate that had this fool take you in.〟Patriarch〝You will bring this matter to its conclusion.〟
ja:
本家『景明！　ここへ参れ！』本家『貴様には何の恨みもない。かような真似を
命じるのが心苦しくもある。
　だが今となっては、この愚か者に拾われた
運命を嘆いてもらうよりないわ』本家『貴様が事の決着をつけよ』

en: Kageaki"...He is not there. Nowhere in this world."Kageaki"Your father gave up being your father. He was ordered to give it up... and he obeyed."Hikaru"............"Kageaki"You know that, don't you?"Hikaru"I know."Hikaru"That is why she gave up... The Hikaru Minato on the surface."Kageaki"..."Hikaru"But underneath, she was raising me. The hope that, even so, Father might love her..."Hikaru"One dream. Me."
ja:
景明「……いないのだ。
　この世の、何処にも」景明「お前の父は、父たる事を捨てた。
　捨てるよう命じられ……従った」光「…………」景明「知っているのだろう」光「知っている」光「だから、諦めていた……。
　表の・・湊斗光は」景明「……」光「しかしその陰で、おれを育てた。
　それでも父に愛されたいという希望を……」光「おれという、一つの夢を」

en:
Not with grief.
With pride.

She spoke of the fiction that was herself.
ja:
悲痛にではなく。
　誇るように。
　
　それは己の虚構を語った。

en: Kageaki"...You..."Hikaru"If the human world has hidden Father away, then turn the whole human world upside down. Perhaps he will fall out, no?"Hikaru"Heh..."Kageaki"............"
ja:
景明「……お前は……」光「人の世に押し隠された父なら……
　人の世を引っくり返してやれば、出てくる
やもしれんだろう？」光「ふふ……」景明「…………」

en:
Hikaru laughed, plainly amused.
From me, no reply came.

Until the laughter ran out, I stood silent as a stone.
ja:
光はおかしそうに笑う。
　俺は何も返せなかった。

　笑いが尽きるまで、ただ石の沈黙を守る。

en: Hikaru"…"Kageaki"…"Hikaru"Kageaki…"Kageaki"Hikaru."
ja: 光「……」景明「……」光「景明よ……」景明「光」

en: Her call was as tentative as a touch with the little finger. I spoke over it.
ja: 小指で触れてくるような呼ばわりに、上から被せる。

en: Kageaki"Then... suppose your father came back and acknowledged you as his daughter. Would that satisfy you?"Kageaki"Would you give up destroying the world?"Hikaru"...That question also, I have answered before."Hikaru"Hikaru does not want a body offered up as a sacrifice. I want the heart to be true."Hikaru"Father respected society and order. For that reason he would not acknowledge Hikaru as his daughter. So, to protect this present world, yes—perhaps he would grant my wish."Hikaru"But that will NOT do! Where is the truth in it? The shape is correct, and inside it is a fake. I don't want that!"Hikaru"To get the truth, there is only one way. Everything Father respects—my mother Subaru, this human society—destroy it all. Then ask him."Hikaru"Can you love Hikaru even AFTER THIS? Ninety percent hatred is fine. Ninety-nine percent is fine. But that last one percent... just a little, one fragment of a parent's love—"Hikaru"That is enough."Kageaki"............"Hikaru"With that, I will be satisfied."
ja:
景明「なら、お前は……
　父親が戻り、お前を娘と認めさえすれば、
それで満足するのか？」景明「世界の破壊を、思い留まるか？」光「……その問いも、以前に答えたな」光「光が欲しいのは生贄の肉ではない。
　真実の心」光「父は社会と秩序を重んじ、それゆえに光を
娘と認めて下さらなかった。
　だからこそ、現世界を守るためとあらば光
の願いを聞くやもしれぬ」光「しかし、それでは駄目なのだ！
　真実が無い。形ばかりの偽物に過ぎない。
そんなものは欲しくもない！」光「真実を得るには……
　父が尊ぶもの。我が母統を、今の人間社会
を、全て滅ぼし尽くした上で問うのみ」光「これでも・・・・光を愛してくれるか、と！
　九割が憎しみでも構わない。九割九分でも。
残りの一分、ほんの少しだけ……一欠片だけ、
肉親の愛情を示してくれるなら、」光「それでいい」景明「…………」光「それでおれは満ち足りる」

en:
Perhaps she was picturing it.
A soft breath escaped her.

Hikaru sighed as though dreaming.
ja:
その光景を思い描いたのか。
　ほぅ――と。

　光は、夢見るような吐息をこぼした。

en: Kageaki(————)

I thought of threads.

A whole bundle, tangled together. Pull this one and that one tightens. Try that side and the first knot acquires children. Eventually you cannot even remember what the threads looked like before they made this lifelong commitment to ruining one another.

To untangle it properly, you would sit with it. Give it time. Find where each thread went, gently work it loose. Haan. That would be the proper way.

But suppose there was no time?

Then all that patience, all that understanding—what would I do with it? Stand here being a very understanding man while the world ended?

One method remained.
Take scissors. Cut.

Cut through the knot and set the threads free.

For this tangle, now, nothing else remained.
ja:
糸の存在を想う。

　絡まり合った糸の束。
　複雑過ぎて、何処がどうしてこうなったのか、最早
まるでわからない。

　これを解きほぐすなら、時間を掛けて取り組むのが
正しいやり方だろう。
　
　だが、その時間が無ければ――

　手段は一つだ。
　鋏を使って切るしかない。

　結び目を断ち切って、糸を解放するしかない。
　
　この絡まりを解くには、もうそれしか。

en: Kageaki"I see."Hikaru"...Kageaki?"Kageaki"Then, Hikaru—"Kageaki"You will have no father from me."Kageaki"Here... die."
ja: 景明「そうか」光「……景明？」景明「ならば、光」景明「お前に父など与えない」景明「ここで……死ね」

en:
Cold pushed back the swirling heat.
Not winter's doing. Not the weather at all.

It was coming from the spirit of one person.
ja:
熱波の渦を、冷気が押し退ける。
　それは冬の気象の生んだものではなかった。

　一個人の心気が発しているものだった。

en: Hikaru"So that is your answer, Kageaki."Kageaki"..."Hikaru"I knew it. Yes. Right to the end, you are on Mother's side. Not mine."Hikaru"Mother was my enemy."Hikaru"If you follow what Mother wanted, then you too are Hikaru's enemy, my brother Kageaki!"Kageaki"...That is correct."Hikaru"I will bring you down."Hikaru"That life, that soul, everything in you that serves Mother—I will take it all."Hikaru"EVERYTHING Mother had, this Hikaru will take!"Kageaki"............"Hikaru"And then I will overthrow the world."Hikaru"When it is all finished... with the power inside this body, I shall bring Father alone back to life."Hikaru"Stop me, then! IF YOU CAN!!"
ja:
光「それが答か、景明」景明「……」光「わかっていた。
　そう、おまえはあくまでも母上の味方……
おれではなく」光「母こそはおれの敵であった」光「母の遺志に従うなら、
　義兄あに景明、おまえも光の敵！」景明「……その通りだ」光「斃す」光「母に従うその生命魂魄、奪い尽くす」光「母のものは何もかも、この光が奪う！」景明「…………」光「そして世界を打倒する」光「全て終わった後で……
　この身に宿る力を使い、我が父のみを生き
返らせよう」光「阻めるものなら阻むがいい!!」

en:
The Silver Star's intent to kill. Hikaru Minato's.

At last, it had turned toward me.
ja:
銀星号――湊斗光の殺意。
　それは遂に、俺へ向けられた。

en:
...One hit would decide it.

That was how I read the situation.

The Silver Star could destroy me—Muramasa—with a single blow. No need to explain that part.
But the reverse was true too. She was no longer that enormous god. This body was small enough for one sweep of a sword to cut through.

Whoever landed the hit, won.

Not a fight on the ground, but close enough to one. We were floating under gravity control, near enough to speak in our own voices. That was where the fight would begin.

To change over to flight now would be the same as turning my back on her and running. A fatal opening, handed over personally.

Don't move.
When you move, attack.

One blow that puts the enemy down. Nothing less.
ja:
……勝負は一撃。
　
　そう、見て取る。

　言わずもがな、銀星号は村正おれを一打で撃破可能だ。
　そして逆も然り。銀星号は既に大巨躯の〝神〟では
なく、剣の一薙で裁断される規模サイズに過ぎない。

　一撃、当てた方が勝つ。

　戦闘状況は、地上戦ではないが、地上戦に近い。
　互いに重力制御で浮遊したこの格好、肉声の対話が
できるこの間合を、始点としたためだ。

　今から騎航に移るのは、敵前で背を見せて逃げるも
同然。
　致命的な隙となる。

　動いてはならない。
　動く時は、攻める時。

　必倒の一打を対敵に放つ時。

en:
The Silver Star held her left hand forward, right hand drawn back.

Enju. One of the unarmed guards of the Yoshino Style Rules of Engagement.
A little altered to suit herself.

The left hand defends or makes a feint, neutralizes the enemy's attack; then the right hand wins the exchange. That is what Enju is meant to do.
But this particular user was hardly going to obey the guard's instruction manual.

Most likely...
ja:
銀星号は左手を前に送り、右手を引いて構えている。
　
　吉野御流合戦礼法、無手構の一つ――槐えんじゅ。
　やや我流の崩れ有り。

　左手で防御又は仕掛けフェイントを行い、敵の攻め手を無効化
して、右手にて打ち勝つ。それが槐の構の本意である。
　しかし、この使い手はそこに囚われまい。

　おそらく……

en:
The same thing she had done above Hachiman Shrine.
No little tricks. Come straight at me, with speed alone to depend on.

Ordinarily, such a headlong rush hardly deserves to be called a tactic.
But when the fighting speed goes beyond what you can even perceive, all your clever tactics may stand aside. That rush is more frightening than any of them.

And then a punch—or a kick.
Either would do. That strength, that skill, and now anger and the intent to kill behind them: fist or foot, she could scatter me together with my armour.
ja:
八幡宮上空で戦った時と同じように。
　小細工は弄さず、ただ速度のみを恃みに襲う。

　本来、戦術とも呼べない猪突猛進。
　だが認識不可能・・・・・という域まで達するあの戦闘速度ファイティングスピードが
あれば――如何なる巧緻の戦術よりもなお恐ろしい。

　そうして、拳――それとも蹴りか。
　どちらでも良いのだろう。あの力と技量にいま怒り
と殺意が加わるなら、どちらであろうが確実に、俺を
甲鉄ごと四散させられる。

en:
...Hikaru stood so naturally that she might dissolve into the wind.
Only her eyes did not belong to that calm. Red and sharp, they watched for the moment to come at me...
ja:
……光は、ともすれば風に溶けゆくかとさえ思える
自然の態タイで居た。
　その中にあって唯一、双眸だけが紅蓮に尖り、進撃
の機を窺っている……。

en:
On my side,
I raised the nodachi above my right shoulder.

The orthodox high guard of an armoured warrior. Looks simple, contains a thousand variations, ends in the same thing: the enemy comes within reach, you cut.

Bas. That much.

I could put a trick into it, certainly. Against this opponent, better not to show my cleverness.
If it merely went to waste, that would be good luck. It could eat up time worth more than gold and make losing a certainty.

When we crossed, there would be no allowance for some extra achievement. Assume I could do one thing only: cut.

Catch the Silver Star at the instant she enters reach. Cut.

...That was all the technique I should attempt.

Reach, at least, was in my favour.
She had no weapon. I had the nodachi. My striking distance was much greater.

I could wait for her to move and STILL strike first.

—Provided.

Provided I caught the exact instant she entered my range. Provided her speed did not leave me behind before I could act.

That was where winning and losing separated.
Could I seize that instant? This thing I had never managed, not once—could I do it NOW...?
ja:
対して。
　俺は、野太刀を右肩上に構える。

　武者正調、上段の太刀取り。
　単純と見えて千変万化の幅を持つが、その帰結する
ところはやはり単一である――間合に入った敵を斬る。

　それだけだ。

　細工を仕込むのも可能だが、相手を思えば、やらぬ
方がましなくらいであろう。
　無駄、で済むならむしろ僥倖。千金より貴重な時間
を食い潰し、敗北を決定付ける要因となり得る。

　やがて訪れる交錯の間、ただ斬る・・・・以上の何かをする
余裕など無いと見るべきだ。

　銀星号が間合に踏み込む瞬間を捉えて斬る。
　
　……俺が行使する術技は、これのみとするが正しい。

　此方こちらには間合の利がある。
　無手の敵に対し、野太刀を扱う俺は攻撃範囲の点で
大きく優っている。

　敵が動くのを待った上で先制する事ができるのだ。

　――但し。
　
　間合に入る瞬間を、確しかと掴めるのならばである。
　銀星号の速度に振り切られてしまうことなく。

　ここが勝敗を分ける最重要点。
　俺はその機をもの・・にできるか？　嘗て一度たりとも
成功していない大難業を、今こそ果たせるのか……？

en:
The Silver Star's breathing remained perfectly calm.

As though asleep—
No. She WAS asleep.

She was a dream.

And a dream's stillness of spirit could reach the realm of gods and immortals.

—True dream-swordsmanship.

How was I to catch that first instant and take control of it?

Three conditions. If I wanted to succeed, to win, all three.

One.
Do not forget that the enemy is the Silver Star.

One.
Forget that the enemy is Hikaru Minato.
ja:
銀星号の呼吸は何処までも鎮静である。

　恰あたかも眠れる者の如し――
　否、眠れる者そのもの。

　あれは夢である。

　夢なれば、心気の静謐なるは神仙の域に届く。
　
　――正真の夢想剣。

　この機先を、如何にして掴み制するか。

　成功と勝利の条件は三つだ。

　一つ。
　敵は銀星号・・・である事を忘れない。

　一つ。
　敵は湊斗光・・・である事を忘れる。

en: Kageaki(————)

One.
Put the mind in no-self.
ja:
一つ。
　心境は無我に置く。

en:
When my mind was contaminated...
I had used a sword stroke I could never ordinarily manage.

Split armour without relying on a tsurugi's power. That impossible thing, I had done it.

The stroke had come from the state of my mind. The contamination had forced it into one rigid purpose.
Not no-self. The opposite of no-self. But all other thoughts had been driven out, and in THAT respect it was the same.

From that state, the stroke had come.

...Yes. And even before that, long ago—when I had used the same stroke, my mind had been like that too.

If I could reach no-self, or something close to it, then that level of technique was within my reach.
Defeating the Silver Star, also.

If I could get my mind there...
ja:
精神汚染されていたあの時……
　俺は普段なら決して成し得ぬ剣を揮ふるった。

　劒冑の力に依らず、甲鉄を断ち割る暴挙を果たした。

　あの剣は心の在様に由来するものだった。
　精神汚染に強いられた一徹の心。無我ではなくその
対極であったが、雑念をすべて排除した点においては
無我にも等しい心境――

　そこから生まれ出でた一剣。
　
　……そう。あれよりも前、ずっと昔に――同じ剣・・・を
使った時も、やはりそうした心境にあった。

　無我ないし近似の心位へ至れば、俺はあそこまでの
技を使える。
　銀星号を斃す事も、できる。

　あの心境へ至れば……

en:
Get it there.

Remember.
That narrow, cramped, rigid, sick state of mind.

Remember.
The principle of no-self.

Kill the self.

Kill every stray thought.

...No-self.
ja:
あの心境へ。

　思い出せ。
　あの狭く小さく固く病んだ心理。

　思い出せ。
　無我の理。

　我を、殺す。

　あらゆる雑念を、殺す。

　……無我。

en: Doushin"Exactly. No-thought makes nothing of the outer universe—the world. No-self makes nothing of the inner universe—your own self."Doushin"Another way that leads to the All."Doushin"Once you reach no-self, where is your private business? Where is private desire? Both are gone."Doushin"Only the world's greater cause. Only the world's will, desiring that enemy's destruction."Doushin"Even when your will disappears... the world's will shall drive you forward and strike down your enemy."
ja:
童心「さよう。
　無想が外の宇宙せかいを無とする理念であれば、
無我は内の宇宙おのれを無とする理念」童心「これもまた、全ゼンに通ずる法であろう」童心「無我に至らば、私事も私欲も既に無い」童心「有るのは世の大義のみ。
　その敵を討てと欲する、世の意志のみ」童心「おぬしの意思が消え去ろうとも……
　世の意志がおぬしを衝き動かし、敵を討つ
であろう」

en:
No-self.

Kill the self.

Every distracting thought.
Every feeling I had as Hikaru Minato's brother—
ja:
無我。

　我を、殺す。

　あらゆる雑念を、
　湊斗光の兄としての思いを、

en: Kill.
ja: 殺す。

en: Kageaki"————"
Kill.
ja: 殺す。

en:
When she comes,
catch the moment. Cut.

...She may dodge the first stroke.

Then catch that moment too.

See exactly when she evades.
See exactly which way she goes.

Send the blade back after her. Cut.

—Tsubame-gaeshi. The Swallow's Return.
ja:
敵が攻め来る時、
　その機を捉えて、斬る。

　……初太刀は、躱される可能性もある。

　その時は、
　その機をも捉える。

　敵が躱した刹那を見切り、
　敵が躱した方向を見切り、

　返しの一撃を送って、斬る。

　――燕返しツバメガエシ。

en: Hikaru"Kageaki."Kageaki"..."Hikaru"Answer one question for me."Hikaru"The souls of the dead. Where do they go...?"Kageaki"............"Kageaki"The dead have nowhere to go."Kageaki"...But... if there is somewhere—"Hikaru"If there is?"Kageaki"Perhaps they fall beneath the earth and sleep."Hikaru"I see."Hikaru"I think they rise to heaven and shine."
ja:
光「景明よ」景明「……」光「一つ、問わせろ」光「死せる者の魂は、何処へゆくか……？」景明「…………」景明「死んだ者に行先などない」景明「……だが……
　もし、あるとすれば」光「あるとせば？」景明「地の底へ落ちて、眠るのだろう」光「そうか」光「おれは、天へ昇って輝くと思う」

en:
I caught it—

That silver trail.
At last, I caught the charge at that impossible speed.

Not through the senses. Through deeper perception. At last, I understood.

Not even time for the thought,
Cut—

my body was already answering.

The nodachi came down,
to split the enemy armour and send her falling onto the burning ground.

Cut...
ja:
見切った――――

　白銀の軌跡、
　神速の突進を遂に捉えた。

　感覚ならぬ観格を以て、遂に悟った。

　斬る、
　などと、思う間も置かず、

　俺の肉体は応じている。

　野太刀を打ち下ろし、
　敵騎を両断、灼熱の地へ落とさんと。

　斬って……

en:
Air. The blade split air.

The best stroke I could possibly make,
and no blood on it.

Because—

That Silver Star. Frightening.
Even my very best was not enough.

The stroke that should have killed her—◆

—SHE HAD DODGED IT!

But.

I knew.
ja:
空を裂く。

　最善を成し遂げた我が一剣が、
　血汐ちしおを得ず。

　何となれば――

　白銀、畏るべし。
　最善を極めてなお届かず。

　必殺の筈の一剣を、◆
　
　
　　　　　　　　　――――躱してのけた！

　だが。

　俺は、知っている。

en:
She had dodged.
UPWARD. That was where she had gone.

I knew it while her attack still had not reached me.

Which meant—

I had not lost her.

I still had her.

The Silver Star was inside my perception. Inside my Kan.
ja:
敵が躱した事、
　上へ・・逃れた事を、知っている。

　敵の攻撃がまだ届かぬ今この間に、悟っている。

　つまり。

　俺は、逃していない。

　捉えている・・・・・。

　白銀、我が観カンの内にあり。

en:
The sword came back.

Reversed its path. Upward.

The shape waiting there—

cut,
ja:
剣は返る。

　軌道を反転し、上方へ。

　そこにある影を、

　斬る、

en: But that first instant—◆she took it before I could.
ja: その機先を、◆制された。

en: Hikaru"—"Kageaki"—"

Face to face. No more than a breath between us.

The time a needle takes to pass through one thin sheet of paper. That was all.
Our eyes met.

The fight was decided.

I had taken the moment as far as it could go.
Made the fastest cut, by the shortest path.

And still it was not enough.

This speed.
Still I could not get beyond it.

One thousandth of an instant more would have done. Only that much. I could have cut her before she reached me.

But that much also, the Silver Star would not give.

Already inside my guard.

Too close for the long nodachi to cut, however much I wanted it to.

Close enough that her fist could not miss. Close enough to kill for certain.

From here, there was no turning it around.

Winning and losing were decided.

—Decided, no?

Then—◆
what was my body STILL DOING?
ja:
接吻を交わす程の間で、見合う。

　薄紙一枚を針で貫く――それだけの時刻。
　視線と視線を交わす。

　勝負は決した。

　戦機を極めに極め。
　最速の剣、最短の剣を為し。

　遂に及ばぬ。

　この速度。
　遂に超えられぬ。

　あと一瞬の千分の一、時間があれば良かった。
　それだけあれば、敵が襲う前に斬れた。

　だがその寸暇を、この白銀は与えなかった。

　間合は既に懐。

　長尺の野太刀では斬りとうても斬れぬ距離。

　敵の拳打は決して外さぬ必殺の距離。

　かくなれば趨勢、もはや覆らぬ。

　勝敗は決した。

　――決したのだ。

　ならば、◆
　俺は・・、何をしているのか・・・・・・・・。

en:
My right hand was moving.

That was strange.
It was supposed to be holding the nodachi.

Why had it let go?

What did it think it was doing?

It went toward my waist.

Reached to seize something there.

There—◆
the short sword.
ja:
右手が、動いている。

　おかしい。
　この手は、野太刀の柄にあった筈。

　何故、離れているのだ。

　何をしようというのだ。

　右手は、我が腰へ向かう。

　そこにある何かを、掴み取ろうとする。

　そこにある、◆
　脇差を。

en: Kageaki(Ah. So that was it.)
ja: 景明（そう、か）

en:
This was a technique I had practiced until it had soaked into my own flesh.

Yoshino Style Rules of Engagement—

—Hiyoku. Paired Wings.

The instant the long sword cuts down, the right hand leaves it, draws the short sword, and cuts upward.

For the enemy who reads the long blade and jumps inside its reach, there is the answer waiting.

I was using it.
Without deciding to.

Why?

How was I managing this?
ja:
これは。

　俺が鍛錬し、肉体に染み込ませた術技の一つ。

　吉野御流合戦礼法、
　
　――――比翼ヒヨク。

　太刀を斬り下ろしたその刹那、
　右手を太刀より離し、脇差を抜き斬り上げる。

　太刀を見切って懐へ飛び入った敵に報いる術法。

　俺は、それを使っているのだ。
　意図せずに。

　何故？

　何故、こんな事ができている？

en: Kageaki(The condition for victory.)Kageaki(Do not forget that the enemy is the Silver Star.)
ja: 景明（勝利の条件）景明（敵が銀星号である事を忘れない・・・・・・・・・・・・・・）

en:
Yes.
I had remembered.

The enemy was the Silver Star.

Pile one chance of winning on top of another, and still she could upset the whole pile.

More than anything, my body remembered. These bones, this flesh—how many times had they been made to learn the hard way?

So.
This time, at least.

Prepare for the worst. Then for the worst after THAT. Then for the worst of that also. Have the movement ready to answer it.

Yoshino Style. Paired Wings.

...I,

faster than the Silver Star,

—drew the short sword...
ja:
そう。
　俺は覚えていた。

　敵は銀星号なのだと。

　勝算に勝算を積み重ねて、それでも裏切られる相手
なのだと。

　何よりも、体が記憶していた。
　幾度となく煮え湯を飲まされたこの肉が、骨が。

　だから。
　今度こそは、と。

　最悪の最悪の最悪を予測して、それに応じるための
動作わざを用意した。

　吉野御流、比翼。

　……俺は、

　銀星号よりも、

　――――――――――――迅はやく、

　脇差を抜いて……

en: Cut.
ja: 斬った。

en:
I tried to understand.

—In that instant—

My body had performed the winning technique.
Before her blow reached me,
I had cut.

And yet—◆
this right arm—◆not the slightest feeling of contact.
ja:
理解に努める。

　――この瞬刹――

　我が肉体は必勝の術を成し、
　敵の打撃に先んじて、
　斬った。

　そして、◆
　この、◆何も響かぬ右腕。

en:
It had cut empty air.

Empty air only.

Understand it. I tried.

...What had happened?
ja:
虚空を斬っている。

　虚空、だけを。

　理解に努める。

　……何が、起きた？

en: Muramasa《————》

Muramasa cried out.

A signal sent straight into my brain. No taking the long route through words.

The information was:
ja:
村正が叫ぶ。

　脳へ送られる信号。
　言語のように迂遠ではない情報伝達。

　それは云っていた。

en:
Spatial
                         distortion.
ja:
空間
　　　　　　　　　　　　歪曲

en: Kageaki(————)

Spatial distortion.

Yes.
The ability that god had shown us.

Use gravity to bend space.

The Silver Star's skill, joined to the god's power.

She had inherited that power. Then why on earth should she NOT be able to use it...?

So she had.

The smallest distortion,
for the smallest instant,

to turn aside the blade that could not be avoided.

And then—
ja:
空間歪曲。

　そう。
　あの〝神〟が使って見せた能力。

　重力により空間を屈折せしむ。

　銀星号の技能に〝神〟の力を合わせて成された芸。

　それを、〝神〟の力を引き継いだ銀星号に成し得ぬ
道理はない……。

　故に使った。

　極小規模の歪曲を、
　極小時間で生じさせ、

　不可避であった刃を、退けた。

　そして。

en: Hikaru"To heaven—"Hikaru"RISE."
ja: 光「天へ」光「昇れ」

en: Hikaru"REVERSE ENOSHIMA IMPACT!!"
ja: 光「逆転・江ノ島大蹴撃リバース・エノシマインパクト!!」

en:
............

......................................

My body... so hot.

As though it were burning.

Every bit of skin burned raw. Not one part spared.

Breathing was difficult too...

Where was this?

Where had I reached?

Had I... fallen into hell...?
ja:
…………

　………………………………………………

　体が……熱い。

　燃えるようだ。

　皮膚という皮膚が焼け爛れている。

　息も苦しい……。

　ここは何処なのか。

　俺は何処にいるのか。

　俺は……地獄に堕ちたのか……？

en:
Dark.

Black, deep darkness.

Hell, then?

But if this was hell, the darkness was not doing its job properly...

Little lights were shining all over it.

Not complete darkness at all.

...Where was I?
ja:
闇だ。

　黒く、昏い。

　やはり地獄か。

　だが、それにしては不純だ……。

　小さな輝きが幾つも見える。

　完全な暗黒ではなかった。

　……ここは、何処だ？

en: Muramasa《…Mido.》Kageaki(…Muramasa?)
ja: 村正《……御堂》景明（……村正か？）

en:
My throat would not let a voice through.
The thought reached her anyway.
ja:
喉が詰まり、声は出せない。
　それでも思念は伝わった。

en: Muramasa《Haan. How is the body? I've tried giving you some emergency treatment.》Kageaki(Hurts... But I can still move. Not completely finished.)
ja:
村正《ええ。
　身体はどう？　応急の処置はしてみたけど》景明（痛むが……
　全く動かせない程ではない）

en:
I tested the muscles.
Nothing seemed completely torn apart. On the other hand, not one thing could move without hurting.

The chest was particularly bad.
It seemed my breastbone had cracked.
ja:
筋肉の動きを確認する。
　完全に断裂している箇所は無い――そして痛まずに
動かせる箇所も無い。

　特に胸の周辺は酷かった。
　胸骨が割れているらしい。

en: Muramasa《I put up a magnetic wall just before the kick landed... Even that couldn't stop all of it.》Kageaki(...I see.)
ja:
村正《蹴りを受ける直前に磁気の壁を張ったんだ
けど……それでも防ぎ切れなかった》景明（……そうか）

en:
But probably that repulsion was the reason I had got away with only THIS much damage.
Being shattered to pieces would have been quite a reasonable result. That kick had the strength for it.
ja:
しかし磁気障壁の反発効果があったればこそ、この
程度の負傷で済んでいるのだろう。
　砕け散っていても不思議はなかったのだ。あの一蹴
にはそれだけの威力があった。

en: Muramasa《And, Mido...》Kageaki(Hm?)Muramasa《...The kick, the magnetic repulsion, and the space distortion just before it—something strange happened when they all came together. It seems we've been thrown... quite some distance.》Kageaki(Whereabouts?)Muramasa《Hmm... just look over there, will you?》Kageaki(There?)
ja:
村正《それでね、御堂》景明（うむ？）村正《……蹴りと磁気反発、あと直前の空間歪曲
も変な感じに作用して、なんか結構遠くまで
飛ばされたみたいなのよね》景明（どの辺りだ）村正《うーん……あれを見てくれる？》景明（あれ？）

en: I looked in the direction the metallic voice inside my head indicated.
ja: 脳裏に響く金打声が示す方向へ視線をやる。

en: Muramasa《Far enough that our world looks like THAT.》
ja: 村正《私達の世界があんな風に見える辺り》

en: Kageaki(...Outer space. Bloody hell...)Muramasa《You know, quite casually, haven't we just taken one great step in human history?》
ja:
景明（……宇宙かよ……）村正《これってさりげなく人類史上の偉大な一歩
だったりするんじゃないかしら》

en:
If I had taken the step myself, perhaps I could have felt something about the achievement.
Since someone had supplied it with a kick, I was having difficulty finding a suitable comment.

Who would history congratulate? The man who went, or the foot that sent him? At the very least, let the record show that I had not become an explorer voluntarily. Ask a pioneer what lies beyond the horizon and he points forward. Ask me and I point to the place that hurts. Same direction, perhaps. Entirely different qualification.

But how blue it was.
And how far away.
ja:
その一歩を自ら踏み出したのなら感慨も湧こうが。
　蹴り飛ばされての事では、何とも感想の述べようが
ない。

　しかし青い。
　しかし遠い。

en: Kageaki(I'm not FALLING toward it... Does that mean I've escaped the earth's pull? At what speed did she kick me?)Muramasa《Not completely escaped, I think. I can still feel a little gravitational energy coming from the earth.》
ja:
景明（あの方向へ落ちて・・・いかない……という事は
つまり、俺は地球の引力圏外へ脱出したのか？
　どんな速度で飛ばされたのだ）村正《完全に脱出したわけでもないみたいよ。
　まだ少し、地球からの辰気を感じるもの》

en:
Then somewhere near an orbital path?

Even so, it would take an outrageous speed to reach here—◆ah. So that explained the burns.

The price of speed. Friction with the atmosphere. If this was the bill, it made sense.
...Though perhaps the question I ought to be asking was how I had failed to burn up completely.

Magnetic barrier, strong armour, all of it included—even then, surviving the kick and the heat of that passage through the air was extraordinary luck.
Or had Kotetsu's performance boost helped...?
ja:
では衛星軌道の近辺か？
　
　それにしても相当な速度でなければ到達できない筈
――◆そうか、それで全身の火傷か。

　速度の代償、大気との摩擦の結果がこれなら納得は
いく。
　……いやむしろ、ここは燃え尽きなかった事にこそ
疑問を抱かねばならないのかもしれないが。

　磁気障壁、甲鉄の強度、全てを考慮に入れても蹴り
の威力と大気の摩擦熱に耐えられたのはまったく僥倖
と言いようがない。
　それとも〝虎徹〟による性能強化が働いたか……。
